data.value: Ikoranabuhanga riteganyijwe: ukurikize Connect API nyuma yo gushyiraho no gutangiza seriveri. Ibikoresho bisanzwe byo kugenzura Synix biracyakora nta tandukaniro.

data.name: Satisfactory.StartFirst
data.value: Tangira seriveri ishyizweho na Synix, hanyuma uyisabe muri Server Manager ya Satisfactory ??s mu mukino. Subira hano uhuze na API.

data.name: Satisfactory.ConnectedHint
data.value: API ihuriye na {0}. Jya usubiramo amakuru y'ubu.

data.name: Satisfactory.SetupSteps
data.value:
Kurangiza igenamigambi rya mbere muri Satisfactory ??s Server Manager no gukomeza seriveri ikora na -NewConsole.
Kanda hasi aha. Synix yohereje itegeko, isoma ikimenyetso gishya, iracyemeza, kandi iririnda neza. Nta gukoporora cyangwa gupimisha.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.AmbiguousToken
data.value: Iyo porogaramu yasubizaga ibimenyetso bitandukanye. Nta kintu na kimwe cyaba cyarakoreshejwe.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleUnavailable
data.value: Synix ntishobora kugera kuri console ya Unreal ya seriveri. Tangira ukoresheje -NewConsole maze ukoreshe uburenganzira bwa Windows bumwe na Synix na seriveri.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleTokenMissing
data.value: Iryo tegeko ryaroherejwe, ariko Synix ntiyashoboye gusoma ikimenyetso gishya cyuzuye cyaturutse kuri iyi seriveri. Reba niba seriveri irasubiza kandi ko inyandiko zayo zishobora kwandikwa. Ibikorwa byose by'itumanaho byagaragaraga; Amategeko ntiyongeye kugerageza.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleBusy
data.value: Iyo porogaramu ntiyishyira ahagaragara cyangwa hari ikiganiro kirimo gukorwa. Ngaho gerageza kongera. Iryo tegeko ntirigera ritunganywa.

data.name: Satisfactory.TokenSafety
data.value: Ibi biha umukozi wa Synix uburenganzira bwo kwinjira. Ikimenyetso cyashyizwe kuri konti yawe ya Windows kandi ntabwo cyongera ku mikino yo gutangiza cyangwa gutangiza. Satisfactory irabigaragaza muri console yayo bwite na log; Jya ubishyira mu mwanya wawe. Iyo ukuraho umurongo w'amajwi wari warakoreshejwe, ntushobora kuvanaho icyo kimenyetso.

data.name: Satisfactory.SecurityHelp
data.value: Nyuma yo gushyiraho muri Satisfactory, tangira seriveri na -NewConsole. Muri Synix: Amahitamo ya seriveri → Satisfactory Ikigo cy'ubuyobozi → Huriza API → Huriza byikora. Uwo mwumvikano w'amahitamo ntuzigera uhagarika imikorere isanzwe ya seriveri.

data.name: Settings.Transfer.NormalWarning
data.value:
Ubucuruzi busanzwe ntibwashyizwe muri za code. Umuntu wese ubona iyo filimi ashobora gusoma imiterere y'umukino, amakuru yabitswe n'amagambo yose y'ibanga yanditse muri iyo filimi.
Amagambo y'ibanze akoreshwa na Synix n'urubuga rwa Discord bikomeza kurindwa uyu mukoresha wa Windows. Iyo ibyo bicuruzwa byinjijwe mu wundi mudasobwa, bishobora kuba ngombwa ko byongera gushyirwa muri iyo modoka.
Ipakiti rizakomeza gusuzumwa niba hari ibyangiritse mu buryo bw'impanuka igihe ryinjirwa.
Mbese, wifuza gukora ibyoherezwa mu mahanga bitamenyekanye?

data.name: Updater.AutomaticUpdateFailed.Body

Synix ntiyashoboye kurangiza ubuvugurura bwikora. Synix yagerageje kugarura porogaramu ya mbere igihe cyose bishoboka.
Niba Synix itazongera gufungura, kora porogaramu yawe ya Synix iriho cyangwa ukande verisiyo yanyuma kuri GitHub. Amakuru y'ibikoresho byawe bya C:\Synix ntiyahindutse.

data.name: GameDefinitions.Builder.Guide
data.value:
Gutangira vuba 1. Andika izina ry'umukino n'umubare wa seriveri AppID ya Steam. 2. Andika inzira yo gukora seriveri ihuje n'ifolda ya seriveri ishyizweho. 3. Andika gusa umurongo w'iryo tegeko uherekejwe n'igikorwa. Koresha tag zifashishwa hepfo aho Synix igomba gushyiramo imiterere y'umukoresha. 4. Hitamo uko umukino uhabwa dosiye yawo. Uburyo buyobowe bukenera dosiye yuzuye y'imiterere ikora, ntabwo ari urugero rw'igice. 5. Hitamo Gushyiraho Amategeko n'Icyitegererezo. Jya ukemura ibibazo byose byavuzwe mbere yo kubika. 6. Kurinda, kongera kubaka Synix, gukora ibizamini byikora, hanyuma kugerageza kwinjiza / gutangira / guhagarika / kugenzura umukino.
INKURU zisabwa • Izina ry'umukino: izina abakoresha babona muri Synix. • ID y'isobanuro: ID idasanzwe iri mu nyuguti nto; Synix yakuremye ikoresheje izina ry'umukino. • Steam AppID: AppID ya seriveri yihariye, si ko buri gihe ari AppID y'umukino w'umukiriya. • Gushyiraho porogaramu ya SteamCMD: ubusanzwe nta kintu gihari. Imikino ya GoldSrc AppID 90 yahurijwemo ikoresha inyandiko yemejwe "90 mod folder", urugero nka "90 mod cstrike". Synix yemera iyi fomu y'umutekano gusa. • Ishobora gukoreshwa: urugero: Binaries\Win64\Server.exe. Ntuzashyiremo dosiye yo gushyiramo. • Ibirindiro: byemejwe nk'umukino wemewe n'amategeko n'ibirindiro by'ibibazo. • Amakarita n'uburyo bwo gukina: shyiraho igiciro kimwe cy'umukino ku murongo. Ibyo bihugura amahitamo yerekanwa mu gihe urema cyangwa uhindura seriveri.
IBIBAZO byo gutangiza Ntukinjize muri iyo modoka ubwayo. Jya urinda ibendera ry'umukino nk'umwandiko usanzwe kandi ushyireho amakarita gusa ku biciro bigenzurwa na Synix. Urugero: -port {port} -queryport {query} -name "{ServerName}" -maxplayers {MaxPlayers}
INKURU z'impaka zishyigikiwe [LAUNCH_ARGUMENT_TAGS]
RCON RECIPE Shyira {rcon} mu biganiro byo gutangiza aho itegeko rya RCON ryemewe riherereye. Muri RCON syntax, ukoreshe: [RCON_ARGUMENT_TAGS] Urugero RCON syntax: +rcon.port {rcon_port} +rcon.password "{rcon_pass}"
IMYITwarire • Kugeza ubu ntabwo byemejwe: Synix ntitegeka dosiye yo gutangiza. • Umukinnyi ayirema nyuma yo gutangira bwa mbere: koresha ihuriro ryuzuye ryafashwe nk'igishushanyo cyo guhindura no gusana. • Synix irayishyiraho hakurikijwe icyitegererezo: Synix ishyiraho imiterere yuzuye mbere yo gutangira. • Intambwe zo gutangiza gusa: umukino ntukeneye uburyo bwo gutegura ibyo bisobanuro.
Ibirango by'ibishushanyo mbonera {ServerName}, {Password}, {HasPassword}, {AdminPassword}, {MaxPlayers}, {Port}, {QueryPort}, {RCONPort}, {RCONPassword}, {EnableRcon}, {Identity}, {WorldName}, {WorldSeed}, {WorldSize}, {AppPort}, {LocalIP}, {PublicIP}, {IsPvp}, {IsPve}, {GameMode} {HasPassword} yandika agaciro k'ukuri k'isobanuro igihe ijambo ry'ibanga rya seriveri rihari n'agaciro kabyo k'ikinyoma igihe ijambo ry'ibanga ari ubusa. Koresha Add configuration files igihe seriveri ikeneye dosiye zirenze imwe. Hitamo dosiye yose yuzuye, hanyuma uhindure aho yashyizweho muri table kugira ngo inzira igere kuri folder ya server. Synix yemeza, ishyira hamwe, yandika, yongeraho, kandi ihinduraho dosiye zose ziri ku rutonde.
AMAFOTO asabwa n'umukoresha Andika inzira imwe y'umutekano ku murongo, ugereranyije n'ifolda ya seriveri yashyizweho. Ibikoresho bikenewe bihagarika gutangiza kugeza ubu; dosiye z'amahitamo zizajyanwa iyo zibonetse ariko ntizigere zihagarika gutangiza. Iyo dosiye zikenewe ziturutse ku mukino usanzwe, bisobanure buri ntambwe y'umukoresha mu mabwiriza yo Gushyiraho. Synix ntizigera ikuraho dosiye z'umukinnyi zifite uruhushya, ntizigere irengaho ubwenegihugu cyangwa ngo zisubirane. Ibaruramari ry'amakuru ryo hanze ni izina ry'ibaruramari Synix ashobora gushakisha munsi y'ibaruramari ry'ibaruramari ry'umukoresha. Jya uyisigira ubusa igihe umukoresha agomba gukoporora dosiye mu buryo bw'amaboko.
Gutanga umuburo wa mbere n'ikimenyetso Shyiraho umuburo igihe abakoresha bagomba kurangiza imyitozo mbere yo gutangira. Andika intambwe zigomba gufatwa, maze umenye ikintu cyose umukoresha agomba kubona ku mikino ye. Urubuga rwa URL rw'ikimenyetso ni rwo rwemewe kandi rugomba gukoresha HTTPS. Synix isubira kuri icya icyangombwa cy'umukozi cyiyashyiriweho igihe kitariho.
IGITEGURWA N'UBUZIMA Tangira ibisobanuro bishya n'ibishushanyo mu gusubiramo 1. Jya wongera ibisobanuro byo gusubiramo igihe cyose ibisobanuro by'umukino bihindutse. Jya wongera isesengura ry'igishushanyo cyakozwe mu gihe uburyo bw'ikoranabuhanga bugenzurwa buhindutse. Synix yanze gusubiramo idafite impinduramatwara ikomeye kandi irinda kopi z'ububiko zo kuzamura.
GUTEGEKA nyuma yo gushyirwa mu bikorwa Jya ukora kopi y'igihe cyo gukora Steam gusa igihe seriveri yemejwe ko igusaba. Intego igomba kuba ari dosiye imwe iri muri iyo seriveri. Synix yandika gusa DLL zayo eshatu zemewe za Steam.
IBIGENGE by'igihe Gushyiraho uburyo bworoheje RAM kuri 0 igihe umukino udafite ubunini bwerekanwe. Ibikoresho bya Hardware na Windows byo kugenzura igihe cyo gukora bisobanura ibisabwa bidahari mbere yo gushyiraho no guhagarika gutangiza bidakwiriye; ntibihindura imiterere ya Windows. Hitamo .NET Framework cyangwa Visual C ++ igihe cyo gukora gusa igihe ibisabwa n'umukino byemeza. Synix ireba inyandiko ya Windows ariko ntiyigera ishyiraho cyangwa ngo yikuremo ibisabwa mbere y'igihe. Hyper-V ikenera Windows Professional cyangwa hejuru, bityo guhitamo Hyper-V na byo bihitamo ibyo Windows isaba.
IMYITwarire yo gutangiza Jya ukoresha uburyo busanzwe bwo gukurikirana imikorere y'ibikoresho bya seriveri zihariye. Gushyira mu bikorwa mu buryo bw'ububanyi n'amahanga ni ukwishyira mu bikorwa gusa kuri launcher, imashini nyayo, cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo gushyiramo imbaraga bufite ubuzima bwa seriveri; Gukurikirana ibibazo by'ibisubizo bihagarikwa mu buryo bwikora. Jya ushyiraho Umuyobozi ugaragara ukenewe ku mikino ifite umuyobozi ushinzwe seriveri agomba gukomeza gufungura. Ibi birenga ku byifuzo by'umukoresha ku rwego rw'isi yose byo guhisha igikoresho cya console gusa kuri iryo shingiro. Gushyiraho igitaramo cyo hejuru bishyigikiwe gusa kuri dosiye zo gutangiza .exe, .bat, na .cmd. Gufasha kohereza dosiye yo gutangiza gusa mugihe umukoresha ashobora kurema no gutangiza dosiye yo gutangiza isuzumwe mu mutekano hanze ya Synix. Ubutumwa bwiteguye bugaragazwa nyuma y'aho imikino yihariye yo kureba niba umukino witeguye igaragaye neza. Iyi mirima ihitamo imyitwarire Synix yubatswe, yemerewe kandi ntishobora gukora inyandiko cyangwa plugins yihitiyemo.
INKURU Y'IBIBAZO Andika inzira z'umutekano ugereranyije n'ifatabuleti y'umukoresha yashyizweho. Gukoresha * ku gice kimwe cy'inzira cyangwa izina ry' dosiye na ** ku ma folda yashyizweho. Abafite umwanya bashyigikiwe ni {Identity}, {ServerName}, {WorldName}, {Port} na {QueryPort}. Ingero: logs\latest.log, Saved\Logs\*.log, profiles\{Identity}\logs\**\*.log. Synix ishakisha izi nzira gusa igihe umukoresha asaba gufungura igitabo gishya cyumukino.

data.name: Text.ED08E4C207A6FC2493D7
data.value: ◇ Imbuga zirangwa n'ibyiyumvo zikurikiza imiterere y'imikorere ya Synix.

data.name: Text.4234688FB477D9CF1421
data.value: ◇ Ibikoresho byo kuyobora imiterere y'umukino: imiterere itariho ihita ikurwaho mu buryo bwikora ku mukino watowe.

data.name: Text.1B0142C80D27A3442046
data.value: ⚠ Guhindura aho uherereye si byo bihanagura kopi z'ububiko zo muri dosiye yabanjirije iyo.

data.name: Text.A9B62C4456D11AE0550C
data.value: 🔒 [REQUIRED] Andika Izina rya seriveri hanyuma uhitemo inyandikorugero yumukino.

data.name: Text.1A759326BD5A56996BF1
data.value: 1 IBIBAZO byawe bikomeza gutandukana Seriveri, imiterere, ububiko, ibihe byo gutangiza, na SteamCMD bibikwa munsi ya C:\Synix bityo ubuvugurura bw'inyandiko ntibubasimbura.

data.name: Text.CD33F03B524794FFF78C
data.value: 2 ADD A SERVER Hitamo umukino, andika imiterere y'abakunzi, maze ureke Synix uyishyiremo. Steam login isaba gusa iyo umukino ubyifuza.

data.name: Text.61A00FCEB996AF15FF21
data.value: 3 START, STOP, AND VERIFY Synix yerekana imvugo nyayo yo gutangiza, ikagenzura gutangira, ikoresha imyitwarire yo guhagarika umutekano aho byemewe, kandi ikomeza ibitabo bya vuba aha.

data.name: Text.CA9A7AA7C8AF17BABA8C
data.value: 4 Kwinjira mu mitwe Windows Firewall uruhushya n'umuyoboro wo kohereza porote ni bitandukanye. Synix ireba amakimbirane yo mu karere, ariko ntirigera ihindura umuyoboro wawe.

data.name: Text.C638A97009ED3C9CCB29
data.value: 5 GUSOKA N'UBUZIMA Koresha Imikorere > Iterambere > Igikoresho cyo gukemura ibibazo kugira ngo ukore ibizamini by'ubuzima n'ibikorerwa. Kora backups mbere yo kwimuka Synix cyangwa ugakora impinduka zikomeye.

data.name: Text.7417BB0A663AE981F77C
data.value: Kuri ubu hari umukozi ukorera kuri seriveri

data.name: Text.2B2D3EED7C841FFB78AA
data.value: Ibikoresho byo kugenzura, imyitwarire yo gutangiza no guhuriza hamwe

data.name: Text.74ECEE4668229DC04361
data.value: Izina rya konti, si izina ry'igishushanyo cyawe cya Steam

data.name: Text.C404A6A32FD8F56893D3
data.value: Ongeraho inyandikorugero zose umukino ukeneye. Hindura ahantu hashyizweho kugira ngo buri nzira igire isano n'urubuga rwashyizweho rwa seriveri.

data.name: Text.1B1883FE46A693283181
data.value: Kwemera kohereza hanze dosiye yo gutangiza

data.name: Text.8F2ED817BE8BBE23D64C
data.value: Ibimenyetso byikora bituruka ku bikorwa bya Synix; ibimenyetso bisaba ikigeragezo cya seriveri nyayo.

data.name: Text.BC489FF2DAD82D69C258
data.value: Urutonde rwo kugenzura umutekano rwikora n'intambwe zikurikira

data.name: Text.A8BC53DE427A5E93DAED
data.value: Ubusanzwe yubaka dosiye y'umukino / seriveri ifite umutekano munsi y'inzira y'imikino yashyizweho.

data.name: Text.1232008495CAD0B69745
data.value: Iyo igihe cyo gukora gitakiriho, blocks zitangira gukurikiza ubuyobozi busobanutse neza bwa Microsoft.

data.name: Text.AAFE71EF1584DE2CA4E2
data.value: Gushyiraho blocks ufite ubutumwa busobanutse igihe processeur idashyigikiye AVX2.

data.name: Text.ED928782624AFCE2078E
data.value: Gukuraho icyemezo cyo gufungurwa mu buryo bw'umutekano...

data.name: Text.95E3AA6BFFB7545B20EF
data.value: Reba igihe cyo gukoreramo gisanzwe, dosiye za seriveri, imiterere, inzugi, Firewall ya Windows, umwanya wa disiki, ibikorwaremezo byahagaritswe, inyandiko ziheruka, n'ubuzima bwo kuvugurura Synix bivuye ahantu hamwe.

data.name: Text.37923AD83E636BE4C27F
data.value: Suzuma SteamCMD kugira ngo umenye amakuru y'ibanze mbere yo gutangiza seriveri.

data.name: Text.6B1DD744008E1B4658A6
data.value: Reba SteamCMD, igihe cyo gukora, dosiye za seriveri, gahunda, imbuga, Firewall ya Windows, umwanya wa diski, ibikorwaremezo byahagaritswe, inyandiko ziheruka no kuvugurura ubuzima.

data.name: Text.1DF3BE2046D08A780F73
data.value: Gusuzuma icyuho cyo gusohora koko nta kongera kubaka Synix, gutangira kurekura, cyangwa kugera kuri C:\Synix.

data.name: Text.52A32013E2D94B00DBF7
data.value: Gusuzuma verisiyo yishyiriweho ya Windows .NET Framework mbere yuko seriveri itangira.

data.name: Text.445F89C824FEC1E5E372
data.value: Kugenzura niba ubufasha bwo gushushanya bwemewe kandi buhari kuri Windows.

data.name: Text.B28F2358A90FE65BFCC8
data.value: Hitamo urutonde rwo gufungura imikorere ya seriveri

data.name: Text.58ECD5D931201294DE1E
data.value: Hitamo ubwoko bwa seriveri igaragaza amateka y'ubugenzuzi bwo mu karere.

data.name: Text.C9F72F8A6A3B6CC20F72
data.value: Hitamo gusa imyitwarire yo gutangiza yubatswe yagaragajwe kuri iyi seriveri yihariye.

data.name: Text.22FCE0291808752AD7BC
data.value: Hitamo kopi y'ibanze yagombye gusimbura dosiye zisanzwe za seriveri.

data.name: Text.30F3BBCB43AC48EBFD1C
data.value: Hitamo ururimi rukoreshwa na Synix. Imiterere y'umukino n'ibiciro by'imiterere bikomeza kuba mu cyongereza.

data.name: Text.54FE09AF7E87A247A21A
data.value: Hitamo igihe Synix igomba gukora igikorwa cyo kongera gutangiza seriveri.

data.name: Text.7FF6D10F94CC3274F62A
data.value: Amategeko yo guhanagura umuriro wa seriveri z'imfubyi Synix

data.name: Text.FC61CB13704E7289E632
data.value: Jya ucungura imiterere y'umukino wakozwe ubu

data.name: Text.B09F5332EE858BE57F71
data.value: Amategeko aguma kuri orudinateri keretse ugiye guhuza Java RCON kugira ngo ugere kure.

data.name: Text.82A8EB3A96D059596D55
data.value: Jya wuzuza dosiye ukeneye mbere y'uko seriveri yihariye ishobora gutangira.

data.name: Text.F0CDBB393CA93D39DF05
data.value: Inzira yo gutangiza igendana n'ububiko bwashyizweho bwa seriveri

data.name: Text.1315F512F1E9EDAD63BC
data.value: Kwemeza gukuraho amategeko y'urukuta rushinzwe kurinda

data.name: Text.C2BD3BDCD4926716C67B
data.value: Mukomereze aho nyuma yo gusuzuma intambwe zisabwa zo gushyiraho.

data.name: Text.07754DEE7F94A6CA31B1
data.value: Gukoporora dosiye z'igihe cyo gukora Steam zateganyijwe nyuma yo kuzishyiraho

data.name: Text.DA14A0D982E06E70BB06
data.value: Kopi yemewe Steam runtime dosiye nyuma yo kwinjiza

data.name: Text.A388F0CE16C067DFA8C5
data.value: Ikora ku gihe cy'imikorere ya Microsoft cyunze ubumwe gikoreshwa na seriveri zisanzwe za 2015, 2017, 2019 na 2022.

data.name: Text.2196E21E8E2F8ABE522B
data.value: Kora kopi y'ibikoresho birindwa mbere yo gutangiza buri gikorwa.

data.name: Text.5D45286D0F2A822299E8
data.value: Kora igishushanyo cy'umukino cyujuje ubuziranenge nta plugins cyangwa inyuguti. Ibisobanuro byandikwa muri uwo mushinga kandi biboneka nyuma y'aho Synix yongeye kubakwa.

data.name: Text.DA09D7E8BF4A3670094C
data.value: Verisiyo ya none n'uburyo bwo gushyiramo

data.name: Text.1F9D51EC4BA893F84146
data.value: Ibitekerezo by'ibanze byo gutangiza (byose nyuma y'igikorwa)

data.name: Text.692AE6A41D7574B63232
data.value: Raporo y'igeragezwa ry'isobanuro yanditswe kuri clipboard.

data.name: Text.9F67BB0F58790841820E
data.value: Umurimo uteganyijwe ukorwa gusa igihe Synix ikiriho.

data.name: Text.84A9F83EFC6F8A9F3401
data.value: Discord yafunguwe. Hitamo Ikiganiro gishya mu kiganiro cyo gutanga raporo y'amakosa maze ushyireho raporo yandikishijwe intoki.

data.name: Text.0BB9D8B879FB1885FD71
data.value: Ntugahambire amagambo y'ibanga, webhooks, aderesi za IP, imiterere bwite cyangwa amategeko yuzuye yo gutangiza. Synix ikuraho amabanga asanzwe mbere yo kohereza.

data.name: Text.E32BFB60FF5B5AA7759C
data.value: Inkomoko y'ibitabo by'imfashanyigisho z'ibitabo by'imfashanyigisho z'ibitabo by'imfashanyigisho z'ibitabo by'imfashanyigisho z'ibitabo by'imfashanyigisho za Bibiliya

data.name: Text.89BF7052C30A2A455D98
data.value: Buri tegeko rivuga ko hashyizweho igicuruzwa munsi ya C:\Synix\Games\ [Game]\[Server], ariko ako gakarita k'umushyikirizi buri wese ntaho ari kandi nta mushakirizi wa Synix washyizweho ufite inzira.

data.name: Text.46D0E2FA44635045064B
data.value: Jya uhindura serverconfig.xml mu buryo bwitondewe utahinduye imiterere yayo ya XML.

data.name: Text.5F646AFBC7E02748C71A
data.value: Imirimo yo mu rwego rwo hejuru

data.name: Text.947BC568AF81FE33EC61
data.value: Gufasha gusa igihe ishyirwaho zitazwi rya SteamCMD ridashoboye kandi bisaba konti ya Steam.

data.name: Text.2F7C7C280CF67E40627A
data.value: Gufasha gusa igihe seriveri idashobora gukora neza idafite uburebure bwa Windows.

data.name: Text.615A691F61191EE9C393
data.value: Jya ukora RCON gusa ku mashusho y'umukino ushyigikira amategeko akomeye ya kure.

data.name: Text.64D3499BE4B6DBDA7DC0
data.value: Jya ushyiraho ubushobozi bwo kugenzura ibibazo bya seriveri

data.name: Text.59AD73A66B0E19C3759F
data.value: Gufasha igihe seriveri ifite ikibazo cyemejwe cyangwa ikoranabuhanga rya interineti Synix ishobora kugenzura.

data.name: Text.518F7A1D974E46AED149
data.value: Andika imyirondoro mu buryo yagombye kuzamurwa. Jya ukoresha ibigereranyo, ibigereranyo cyangwa ikimenyetso kimwe ku murongo. Synix ntabwo ikeneye urutonde rw'amazina ya mod.

data.name: Text.E486E8326F69B31FB7D5
data.value: Andika amakuru y'umukino, hanyuma ugaragaze ko ari ukuri mbere yo kuyakura.

data.name: Text.E83F8984B15353372DF8
data.value: Urugero: Seriveri ifunga nyuma y'amasegonda make itangiye

data.name: Text.6F9406E668F812A49DBB
data.value: Gushyira hanze bigenewe gutangiza cyangwa imashini zibarirwa mu byuma kandi bihagarika kugenzura ibibazo.

data.name: Text.0078A1C33BF28B41D89B
data.value: Hashyizweho amategeko ayo makuru yakoreshwaga munsi ya C:\Synix\Games\[Game]\[Server], ariko iyo seriveri idakiriho kandi dosiye yayo ya seriveri yaragiye. Ibirindiro n'ibikoresho byashyizweho ntabwo bisanirwa.

data.name: Text.07E7C9C515328484C872
data.value: Amategeko ashyirwa mu bikorwa muri Firewall yiteguye gukurwaho

data.name: Text.6D27A85CB8D78F9F3B3E
data.value: Ubutumwa bwo gutangiza bwa mbere bugaragazwa ku mukoresha

data.name: Text.88ED3B522C4F0A8BD740
data.value: GitHub ntirihuza. Kopi n'amahitamo ya Discord biracyakora.

data.name: Text.9942D957346A0E83C15C
data.value: GitHub yohererezanya ubutumwa butaziguye nta mushakisha ufunguye nyuma y'uko konti ihamye.

data.name: Text.4E4DEFAC10984CADF571
data.value: Guhisha aderesi za IP, impuruza n'andi makuru yihariye mugihe usangiye igishushanyo.

data.name: Text.A8578B710044B649B2CD
data.value: Uko umukoresha abona n'aho ashyira dosiye z'umukino

data.name: Text.4E469076738CB74F0877
data.value: Nemeje izina rya seriveri rigaragajwe, imigi, imipaka y'umukinnyi, n'indi mibare yose ikoreshwa n'iri tangazo, harimo ijambo ry'ibanga, RCON, uburyo, n'ikarita/isi aho bikenewe.

data.name: Text.5D385B4C5044DA97B77C
data.value: INKURU Nta gihombo cyatoranyijwe Jya uhitamo uburyo bwo kubara umwanya n'igihe.

data.name: Text.44D7882A1ADBECC9092C
data.value: Shyira uyu mukino muri Synix mbere y'uko ugerageza ibimenyetso byawo byo gutangiza.

data.name: Text.70CAC3F03884A4946236
data.value: Gushyiraho, gutangira, guhagarika no kugenzura ibipimo byandikwa mu buryo bwikora. Kugenzura igitekerezo bikoresha seriveri nyayo yashyizweho n'igeragezwa ry'ubuyobozi bwisukuye; igishushanyo kiguma ari igisuzumisho cy'ibikoresho.

data.name: Text.B00EA51A815EE55F2F3E
data.value: GUKORA ibintu mu buryo buzira uburyarya

data.name: Text.D3F2BA487FAA0A74E4A4
data.value: Ureka umukoresha akore dosiye yo gutangiza yasubiwemo. Jya ukuraho amabwiriza yo gushyira mu bikorwa agomba kuguma muri Synix.

data.name: Text.2FD27154D5938042C2FF
data.value: Jya ugera ku mubare w'ibikoresho by'ubudehe bikomeza kubikwa kuri buri mudaseri.

data.name: Text.E749931070B84A1593D2
data.value: Imikorere yo mu buryo bw'ibyishimo ikorerwa kuri buri mudaseri y'umukino ushinzwe.

data.name: Text.522E549C1259D9FA47D1
data.value: Ikigeragezo cyo kwiringirwa mu gihe kirekire

data.name: Text.F31BBCEE0082BEEE372A
data.value: Amahitamo y'ikarita n'imikorere aturuka mu cyitegererezo cy'umukino watoranyijwe.

data.name: Text.FDA8F741D724B426C343
data.value: Amakarita cyangwa ibijyanye n'imiterere y'ibintu (umurongo umwe ku murongo)

data.name: Text.A5C1D46A9B2A472DF537
data.value: Ubutumwa bwerekanwa nyuma y'uko igenzura ryihariye ry'ubwiteganyirize risohotse (ubusabane)

data.name: Text.71F9139AF2A58247E590
data.value: Sisitemu y'ibanze RAM muri GB (0 bisobanura ko nta cyiciro cyoroheje)

data.name: Text.0F38AC5E2C273A4B6642
data.value: Gukurikirana inzugi zikora za seriveri kugira ngo haboneke imyuzure y'ibikoresho byinjiye no kubimenyesha ku bihereranye n'imyuzure idasanzwe y'umuhanda.

data.name: Text.1C310A469AD1721A3E91
data.value: Gukurikirana no gucunga buri mudaseri y'umukino uvuye mu kibanza kimwe cy'akazi.

data.name: Text.A6D637EAA965641CEB00
data.value: Tanga izina ry'aho uherereye, ushyireho urubuga rwayo rwa Discord, maze uhitemo neza imikorere ya Synix izakirwa.

data.name: Text.39AA18B083CD39C1A64C
data.value: Kugeza ubu nta gerageza ryo kwiringirwa ryakozwe.

data.name: Text.8DDA097844BB6EDCFA10
data.value: Ntabwo byahindutse: dosiye z'umukino, seriveri zicungerewe, amategeko y'amavuko gusa, indangamuntu zo gushyiramo, n'amategeko ya firewall hanze ya C:\Synix\Games.

data.name: Text.4DC50DE227F1D75CFF26
data.value: Icyitonderwa cy'urukuta rw'urubuga gusa ni cyo kigaragazwa. Fungura Porogaramu za Server kugirango urebe cyangwa uhindure aho ugiye.

data.name: Text.A8796566765C1117B49C
data.value: Gusa agaciro uhindura ni ko gasimbuzwa; Ibitekerezo, ibice, imiterere y'ibikoresho, amagambo yavuzwe n'abantu, umwanya uherereye hamwe n'urutonde rw'ibikoresho by'ibanze bikomeza kubaho.

data.name: Text.897C522834169BCBAA15
data.value: Gufungura ikigeragezo cyo kwiringirwa k'igihe kirekire

data.name: Text.8736DCB51A77046719F5
data.value: Fungura igikoresho cy'ibanze igihe umukozi w'umukino atangiye. Jya ukuraho iyo modoka kugira ngo ukoreshe seriveri mu cyubahiro.

data.name: Text.C8CF5C841F7BF2F1E0F3
data.value: Fungura uburyo bwo gukemura ibibazo bya Synix

data.name: Text.CB904327966ABA4B8621
data.value: RCON syntax y'amahitamo ?? Intambwe zo gutangiza zigomba kuba zirimo {rcon}

data.name: Text.2E3FED7012F80848E367
data.value: Guteza imbere amategeko agenga umuriro w'imfungwa

data.name: Text.36B18A6020F2CE06DF28
data.value: Ihagaritse ibyo Synix yifuza ku byerekeye seriveri ziyobowe binyuze mu idirishya ryazo bwite.

data.name: Text.F2492B6E06AE47BEB928
data.value: Ibikoresho by'imbuga bigenzurwa mu buryo bwikora ku mikorere ikora no ku zindi seriveri za Synix.

data.name: Text.F13396A9BD6FFF26191D
data.value: Uburyo bwo kurinda ubuzima bw'ibanga bushobora guhisha iyi nyandiko y'uruhushya. Shyiraho kode yihariye, cyangwa uyirebe ubusa ku nshuro ya mbere kugira ngo Windrose izakore imwe.

data.name: Text.82F665628E2402225B0F
data.value: Icyitonderwa cy'imikorere n'ikoreshwa ry'ibikoresho by'ubuzima kuri buri mukinnyi ukora umukino.

data.name: Text.517D0391800FC8C55AD3
data.value: Ririndwa muri Synix kandi ryahishwe mu nyandiko zayo. Imyandikire y'ibikoresho bya serivisi byakozwe ikubiyemo ikimenyetso gishobora gukoreshwa mu mwandiko usomwa.

data.name: Text.49CDA0DED2FDB6421A49
data.value: Ibaruramari ryashyizweho ryo gusohora. Jya usuzuma igihe uzaba witeguye.

data.name: Text.EC423125FB2CAF05C95B
data.value: Amategeko yihutirwa ?? hitamo imwe yo kuyitegura, hanyuma uyasuzume maze uyoherereze

data.name: Text.15599B0016F3C3591CF5
data.value: Indangagaciro zishobora gusomwa gusa zishobora gutorwa no gukopwa mu rwego rwo gupima

data.name: Text.69EDD9A74D913D8F77D6
data.value: Kugenzura gusa gusomwa kw'ibikorwaremezo by'igishushanyo, kuvugururwa, n'ibiciro byabitswe muri Porogaramu za Server. Nta na rimwe hashyirwa ahagaragara indangagaciro za Password.

data.name: Text.D4BEB0C27C58D53CCFA7
data.value: Gusoma no kugerageza ububiko bw'ibikoresho by'imikino...

data.name: Text.54C8BBF4B91A6012A87B
data.value: Windows isaba uruhushya rw'umuyobozi gusa niba amategeko akeneye kuvanwaho.

data.name: Text.2B2FF7B1710C1AE35612
data.value: Witeguye gusuzuma dosiye zasohotse n'icyemezo cy'igeragezwa cyakozwe mu gihe cyo gusohora.

data.name: Text.FD866259C3EE73E57510
data.value: Twiteguye kugerageza ububiko bw'ibitabo bwerekana imiterere y'imikino.

data.name: Text.C0BAAF3EA26A1A69CE63
data.value: Mwiteguye. 30-minute run na 30-umwitozo w'icyiciro cya kabiri ni cyo gitanga inama yo kugenzura vuba.

data.name: Text.0C10BD130731730DDC5C
data.value: Jya ushyiramo amakuru y'umukinnyi uhereye kuri seriveri yo mu gace k'iwawe.

data.name: Text.1DE733236BD0DED6BA11
data.value: Ahantu hazajya haboneka amazina y'abantu bazaba barekuwe.

data.name: Text.4CB636A73FAD7D71BC94
data.value: Ikigeragezo cyo kwiringirwa cyahagaritswe. Nta migambi ya seriveri yahinduwe.

data.name: Text.FE3F7B0A38B0EEDF20EB
data.value: Synix ikomeza gusuzuma ibyiyumvo byayo, imikorere yayo, imitwe yayo n'imikorere y'ibikoresho byo gusoma gusa. Ntibitangira cyangwa ngo bihagarike, ntibikore, ntibisubireho cyangwa ngo bihindure seriveri.

data.name: Text.D320B9FEE80C1B53C8BD
data.value: Bisaba idirishya rigaragara ry'ubuyobozi bwa seriveri

data.name: Text.76E9456EF215ECDE0E0F
data.value: Bisaba porogaramu ifite ubushobozi bwa AVX2

data.name: Text.88E68081C6F4A7C6EEE2
data.value: Jya usaba ko idirishya ry'ubuyobozi bwa seriveri riguma rigaragara

data.name: Text.EF20D5D938A93CEF88A3
data.value: Bisaba Visual C ++ 2013 x64 igihe cyo gukora

data.name: Text.A35B9EA54D03EE898DA0
data.value: Bisaba Visual C ++ 2015-2022 x64 igihe cyo gukora

data.name: Text.9E09BE4B90E9259491DD
data.value: Amasambu asabwa ahindurwa ku buryo bwikora ku mukino watoranyijwe.

data.name: Text.AD654849FC9CF1C6D997
data.value: Ibikoresho byasabwa n'ibishushanyo byakozwe na Synix bifasha kugabisha.

data.name: Text.B0DAEADE1B96AB9F8EB5
data.value: Bisabwa ku byiciro nka Hyper-V bidahari kuri Windows Home.

data.name: Text.5BA4DAF696F2453133A8
data.value: Impamvu zisabwa zo gutangiza zirashyirwamo mu buryo bw'imbaraga n'amakuru yawe yihariye mbere yo gutangira. Ushobora gushyiramo andi mabendera y'umurongo w'amabwiriza atagarutsweho n'umunyururu usanzwe mu gice cy'impamvu zinyuranye.

data.name: Text.5DC5CE2CCFBCC1F3AE31
data.value: Amashusho akenewe yatanzwe n'umukoresha (inzira zifitanye isano, imwe ku murongo)

data.name: Text.2D41AABA41C2EF3FED5C
data.value: Jya wongera gutangiza iminsi yatoranijwe ku gihe cyashyizweho, ugakomeza kubika amakuru y'umushinga w'igihe.

data.name: Text.FE8445D560EC3691D1E1
data.value: Reba uko Synix yubaka itegeko ryakoreshejwe mu gutangiza seriveri.

data.name: Text.FC0C7D5D72BB74B7579E
data.value: Jya usuzuma amategeko y'uruhushya mbere yo kwemerera seriveri gutangira.

data.name: Text.A2CBC7E3EEB055BE8AFC
data.value: Jya usuzuma ibyo usabwa mbere yo gukomeza.

data.name: Text.B38F7F9752C285B4B90B
data.value: Gukora imiterere y'ibikoresho, SHA-256, n'ibizamini bya virusi...

data.name: Text.5D719633D44DEE05A861
data.value: Gushakisha hakurikijwe umukino, ibyangombwa bishobora gushyirwa mu bikorwa, cyangwa imiterere y'ubufasha...

data.name: Text.01F1674FFF3FC5AD8DC9
data.value: Gushakisha umukino cyangwa izina rya seriveri...

data.name: Text.4CDDB86B34725DFF943D
data.value: Iperereza ry'umutekano ryabuzanyije iyo filimi. Nta dosiye yahinduwe.

data.name: Text.8C5A71A792CF70840F4B
data.value: Reba neza ibyo Synix ishobora gushyiraho, gutunganya, kugenzura no gukora ibibazo mbere yo kurema seriveri.

data.name: Text.339761CAC4ADD79725CB
data.value: Reba icyerekezo cya Discord gihabwa buri bwoko bw'itangazo rya Synix kuri iyi seriveri.

data.name: Text.F00F8392B2C39AE7826E
data.value: Jya uhitamo abasigaye kugira ngo bakomeze.

data.name: Text.FFF9C013BFE465B863CB
data.value: Hitamo umukino wo kuvugurura ibimenyetso byawo.

data.name: Text.F576F35548B3364CBEDB
data.value: Hitamo seriveri ishyizweho maze wemeze itegeko ryayo.

data.name: Text.DA03B7F52F79500329AF
data.value: Kohereza amakuru, ububiko, kwitabwaho n'ibibazo ku mihanda itandukanye ya Discord.

data.name: Text.B67782439FDBA86190F5
data.value: Umuyoboro ushobora gushyirwa mu bikorwa (inzira ihwanye)

data.name: Text.A50A426E7FA853DA7584
data.value: Imirongo y'imikorere ya seriveri (umuhanda umwe cyangwa ishusho ya karita idasanzwe kuri buri murongo)

data.name: Text.52D1EA9EC1761138D30F
data.value: Erekana umuburo wo gutangiza bwa mbere

data.name: Text.D72917FA7B697BD4F0E1
data.value: Ryerekanwa kugira ngo ugire ubushishozi kugira ngo ushobore kureba ko itegeko ryo gutangiza ritagira imvugo zihishe.

data.name: Text.20C57F23AC717E8E040D
data.value: Ntangira seriveri binyuze kuri Synix. Itegereje ko umutezi wayo ushinzwe gusubiza...

data.name: Text.091C22C7EE122D76DAE4
data.value: Itangira gukurikirana imiterere y'ibintu igihe winjiye muri Windows. Gufunga dashboard ya Synix buri gihe bivamo Synix byuzuye mugihe cyo gutangiza.

data.name: Text.74F96C8582DE2CB217C7
data.value: Kwinjira mu konti ya Steam byasabwa

data.name: Text.AD5BE8100C99D831B948
data.value: SteamCMD umuvuduko wo gukuramo muri megabits ku munota

data.name: Text.6DC2259A4335DB1F7C92
data.value: Kuhagarika seriveri y'igerageza binyuze muri Synix...

data.name: Text.AFC6E98203B42710D6D2
data.value: Jya ucunga imyirondoro y'ibikoresho by'ububiko bya seriveri bikoreshwa n'abantu ku giti cyabo.

data.name: Text.A03EE332F98F4733802C
data.value: Jya uhindura dashboard ya Synix hagati y'ibishushanyo by'urudaca n'iby'icuraburindi.

data.name: Text.1263E823649071566AFC
data.value: Synix yubaka itegeko ry'ukuri ikoresheje imiterere y'iyi seriveri, ihisha ijambo ry'ibanga ryose, iritangira mu buryo busanzwe, maze igategereza igihamya cy'uko seriveri yemeye gutangiza.

data.name: Text.030EBC77E93FA53151CE
data.value: Synix ntabwo ifungura icyambu rusange cyo kugenzura urubuga. Amagambo y'ibanga abitswe na Synix arindwa ku rwego rw'igihugu, kandi indangagaciro zirangwa n'ubwumvikane buke zihishwa mu nyandiko zayo z'ibikorwa.

data.name: Text.385E44CCA2BC7A3242CF
data.value: Synix Gahunda yo kugerageza gusobanura umukino

data.name: Text.69B1390848A4F53A80A2
data.value: Synix ishyiraho umuterankunga wa seriveri watoranyijwe hamwe na Portable Java ihuriyeho. Jya wongeramo mod zawe nyuma yo kuyishyiraho.

data.name: Text.93F24BC2C28FEF1DDC28
data.value: Synix yagenewe gutuma umukinnyi w'umukinnyi ashyiraho seriveri y'umukino ku giti cye asobanukiwe atahisha ibyo ahindura kuri orudinateri yawe.

data.name: Text.3D07CCD88E27236748F3
data.value: Synix Igikoresho cyo kugenzura igihe cyo gufungura

data.name: Text.DB74849CCDF411527A63
data.value: Synix igenzura kopi z'ububiko zifite impapuro z'ubudahemuka, igashyiraho inyandiko yatoranijwe mu buryo bwitondewe, kandi igasubira inyuma mu buryo bwikora mu gihe gusubiza ibintu mu buryo bidashoboka. Inkomoko ya seriveri ya Synix yandikishijwe intoki n'ibishushanyo byayo ntibihindutse.

data.name: Text.F283ABEE58C3C5919882
data.value: Synix igenzura buri gikorwa mu buryo bwikora nyuma yo kugikora kuri iyi PC.

data.name: Text.7083BACCFEE1C7E3CC47
data.value: Mutubwire icyo mwabonye, ibyo Synix yerekanye, n'uburyo bwo kongera kubikora.

data.name: Text.D25BF1DE94C6CFCB40D4
data.value: Kugerageza buri tsinda ry'imiterere n'ibishushanyo byujuje mu buryo bwitondewe...

data.name: Text.91657E9737A951B3ADA2
data.value: Gusuzuma buri mukino wubatse, guhuza imiterere yagenwe, inyandikorugero yuzuye yo gutunganya, kuvugurura, inzira, ahantu ho kwandika, n'ibikorwa byemewe nyuma yo gushyiraho. Abaserveri bashyizweho ntibahinduka.

data.name: Text.D1227935539D1BA6B9E6
data.value: Igikorwa cya seriveri y'umukino ntikirimo gukora

data.name: Text.8421EE422CBE769494A6
data.value: Porogaramu ya seriveri y'umukino iri kuri interineti

data.name: Text.849FF4D03C300A88F143
data.value: Umurongo w'aho hantu wavuyeho. Gusubiza inyuma Synix ku ipaji ya GitHub yafunguwe.

data.name: Text.199AA28C30C28597C6E2
data.value: Raporo y'ibanga yashyizwe mu mpapuro z'umwimerere yasubiwemo, kandi yiteguye gushyirwa muri forum y'amakosa ya Discord.

data.name: Text.3CDC839AB03D7080ED58
data.value: Gusuzuma ko umuntu yarekuwe ntibyashoboraga kurangira.

data.name: Text.0117F5327FA39CD0DABB
data.value: Icyemezo cy'uko barekurwa cyahagaritswe. Nta dosiye z'ibitangazamakuru zahinduwe.

data.name: Text.AB89F96B667CE80E48CB
data.value: Raporo yo kwiringirwa izagaragara nyuma y'igihe cy'ikiruhuko cyasabwe kirangiye.

data.name: Text.D9718558CFBB91F44CFF
data.value: Urutonde rw'ibihe rwibitswe n'imikorere y'iyi porogaramu.

data.name: Text.44D8326D9590F71F8B1B
data.value: Seriveri yatoranyijwe ikeneye konti ya Steam kugirango ishyirweho. Andika izina rya konti SteamCMD yagombye gukoresha.

data.name: Text.D305131EE6798E1D30FA
data.value: Server igomba gukomeza guhagarara mu gihe cyo kugarura

data.name: Text.BCB4E85BFE366942E9D4
data.value: Seriveri yahagaze mbere y'uko itangira gushyirwa mu bikorwa. Suzuma inyandiko n'isobanuro byatanzwe vuba aha.

data.name: Text.946FF9E0EB0FA926E2AF
data.value: Seriveri y'igeragezwa yahagaritswe. Ibimenyetso by'impaka byuzuye biracyariho.

data.name: Text.7B3AC1F3AD7BA73ED0CC
data.value: Ibi biciro byemewe gusa mugihe inyandikorugero ya seriveri yatoranijwe ibishyigikiye.

data.name: Text.7CB94F75343DF207439A
data.value: Iyi myumvire y'amakuru yerekana imvugo z'ibanze Synix ikoresha mu kubaka itegeko ryo gutangiza.

data.name: Text.6440A1A6AB337CD371BA
data.value: Jya uhagurutsa buri munsi igihe gahunda yagombaga gutangirira.

data.name: Text.09872897779CD02DAC70
data.value: Ubuvugurura ntibutangiye • Synix ya none ntiyahindutse

data.name: Text.A8142050CBD33EE95F3F
data.value: Jya ukoresha umuvuduko wose cyangwa ugere ku muvuduko wo gushyiraho seriveri z'umukino, kuzivugurura, kuzisubiramo no kuzikosora.

data.name: Text.60ADFA0715E4E83522DF
data.value: Koresha interineti imwe kuri seriveri yawe maze uhitemo ubutumwa yagombye kwakira.

data.name: Text.4910EE68C0A14BD4AF19
data.value: Gukoresha gusa igihe igeragezwa rigaragaza ko seriveri ikeneye dosiye Steam DLL yemewe. Intego igomba kuguma muri dosiye ya seriveri.

data.name: Text.1433E221238B95E942F7
data.value: Gukoresha gusa igihe seriveri ishyirwa mu bikoresho bya Hyper-V cyangwa Windows.

data.name: Text.F2029FAFB53EFFEE6890
data.value: Akoresha igihe cya orudinateri n'isaha y'amasaha ya 24.

data.name: Text.229193F097F563A43177
data.value: Urutonde rw'abashakashatsi rwasubitswe hakurikijwe ibihamya bya Synix byatsinzwe.

data.name: Text.A7678DBAFBD9E2842236
data.value: Ibikoresho byemejwe n'ibisabwa na Windows bigenzurwa mbere y'uko Synix ishyiraho cyangwa itangiza seriveri.

data.name: Text.16FB4FBCA9A11AC839AE
data.value: Kugenzura inzira z'ibikoresho byo mu bubiko n'ubudahemuka bwa SHA-256...

data.name: Text.29CAE0D1FFE7D67CA266
data.value: Gutegereza icyitegererezo cya mbere • Gusubiza vuba buri cyiciro cya 1

data.name: Text.9B1DF515009197F7B731
data.value: Icyo Synix izi muri iki gihe ni uko ishyiraho, guhuza, gutangiza, kugenzura no gushakisha uyu mukino.

data.name: Text.DDE7244B8E964BD733E4
data.value: Icyo Synix yakoraga igihe icyo kibazo cyabaga

data.name: Text.C29162E9E78CEEA6A66B
data.value: Iyo byemewe, gusiba seriveri isaba umuyobozi uruhushya rwo gukuraho amategeko yayo ya Windows Firewall. Jya uyizimya kugira ngo utajya uyisukura mu buryo bwikora mu gihe uyizimye.

data.name: Text.9D352A1132C068237394
data.value: Windows yasabye uruhushya rw'umuyobozi. Synix noneho ikuraho amategeko y'urukuta rw'umuriro gusa ahuza n'inzira zisanzwe zishobora gushyirwa mu bikorwa hejuru hanyuma ikongera isuzuma kugirango yemeze isuku.

data.value:
Gukuraho GitHub na Synix?
Synix izakuraho konti yaherekejwe kuri orudinateri, hanyuma ifungure GitHub kugira ngo ushobora gukuraho uruhushya kuri konti yawe.

data.name: MessageText.1D8A8E332F05698AE41A

data.value: Ibimenyetso byo kwinjiza, gutangira, guhagarika no gukurikirana byandikwa mu buryo bwikora na seriveri nyayo ya Synix kandi ntishobora gushyirwaho ikimenyetso ku rukuta.

Synix izabanza kurinda dosiye ziriho kugira ngo iki gikorwa cyo gusubiza ibintu mu buryo gishobora no gukurwaho.

data.value: Synix ntiyashoboye kubona dosiye y'umushinga. Kora iki cyangombwa kivuye muri Visual Studio Build or Rebuild of the Synix project.

data.value: Synix ntifite inyandikorugero yuzuye yo gusubizaho uyu mukino.

data.name: MessageText.AA9402AAA45447FCB9A8
data.value: Synix izongera kubaka porogaramu yuzuye ikurikije inyandikorugero yizewe, yongera gushyiraho indangagaciro za seriveri zatanzwe, kandi ikomeze kubika kopi. Ese dukomeza?

data.name: MessageText.3679B9A889A4F6F470DA
data.value: Iyo porogaramu y'inyongera yashyizweho kandi iragenzurwa. Tangira gukoresha seriveri igihe uzaba witeguye.

data.name: MessageText.F23CB309225C503B6D8A
data.value: Iyo porogaramu y'inyongera yashyizweho kandi iragenzurwa. Ubusanzwe, ubwo buryo bushobora kubusubiramo nta bwo bwasubiraho burundu.

data.name: MessageText.21619FB57FA1E3D42E43
data.value: Amategeko agomba kurenga buri igenzura ryemeza mbere y'uko Synix ishobora gutangira ikigeragezo cy'impaka.

data.name: MessageText.EA2CD9B6AE3E2608F49E
data.value: Igishushanyo mbonera cy'imikino kiboneka gusa mu byubaka iterambere.

data.name: MessageText.2A2FCD5BFFF42E6401AE
data.value: Urutonde rw'ibyangombwa by'imyororokere byasabwe rwari rwiteguye. Umukino uza gukuramo cyangwa kuvugurura ibikubiye mu bikoresho bya seriveri igihe seriveri izaba itangiye.

data.name: MessageText.A570646762EA80624E34
data.value: Igikoresho cy'ubuhinduzi cyatoranyijwe nticyabonetse. Ongera uhitemo.

data.name: MessageText.313E93838C2B67200EAB
data.value: Iyi kopi y'ububiko ifite icyangombwa kitemewe cya SHA-256 kandi ntishobora gusubizwaho. Hitamo ubundi bwoko bw'ubufasha.

data.name: MessageText.379C1CF1A5975C5E0C37
data.value: Iyi dosiye si ubusa. Kwishyiramo hano bishobora gusenya dosiye. Ese dukomeza?

data.name: MessageText.F94014E8EAE83ED1AC43
data.value: Uyu mukino ugenzurwa mu buryo bwuzuye binyuze mu bitekerezo byo gutangiza, bityo nta gerageza ryihariye rya dosiye yo gushushanya rikenewe.

data.name: MessageText.AC3B07BB575D129E2A12
data.value:
Ibi bizubaka imiterere y'umukino uhereye ku cyitegererezo cy'igishushanyo cya Synix kandi bishyire mu bikorwa indangagaciro zibitswe muri Server Settings.
Ibindi biciro byose byashyizweho bizakurwaho.

data.name: MessageText.BA03F2AB291E808BE95A
data.value: Tegereza ko ishyirwaho, kuvugururwa, sauvegarde cyangwa kwimurirwa birangira mbere yo kwemeza paketi.

data.name: MessageText.C4163B7C6E2B1B662C17
data.value: Windows ntiyashoboye gusubiramo raporo yo kurekura.

data.name: MessageText.E30D1FF9B8D6F1EEE71C
data.value: Windows ntiyashoboye gusubiramo raporo yo kwemeza.

data.name: MessageText.D08D6AB01BF21D6FCB08
data.value: Windows ntiyashoboye gufungura ipaji yo gusohora GitHub.

data.name: MessageText.663E3E2D227DB51428B7
data.value: Ufite impinduka z'ibikorwaremezo zitaziganyijwe. Ese uzabireka maze ubishyire mu kaga?

data.name: MessageText.3B1950A30C957AAF88A2
data.value: Ugomba guhagarika seriveri mbere yo kuyivugurura.

data.name: MessageText.19580FB3CF2A0F82762D
data.value: Ugomba guhagarika seriveri mbere yo kwemeza dosiye za seriveri.

data.name: ModManager.Error.LinkedPath
data.value: Icyo gikorwa cy'inyongera gikoresha dosiye cyangwa dosiye zifitanye isano. Hitamo dosiye isanzwe; Synix ntishobora gukurikira uwo murongo.

data.name: ModManager.Error.PreviousFileMissing
data.value: Hariho dosiye y'inyongera yari ikenewe kugira ngo isubirwe. Nta dosiye yahinduwe. Jya usubiza dosiye y'ububiko itakiriho cyangwa ukoreshe seriveri y'ububiko yemejwe mbere yo gukuraho iyi porogaramu.

data.name: ModManager.Error.RecoveryRetained
data.value: Icyo gikorwa cy'inyongera cyarasenyutse kandi hari ibintu bimwe na bimwe bidashobora gukurwaho. Ibikoresho byo kuvura byacungiwe kuri {0}. Jya ukomeza guhagarika seriveri maze ushyireho izo dosiye cyangwa ukore sauvegarde ya seriveri yemewe mbere yo kuzitangira.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchValue
data.value: Intara yo kurasa {0} ntishobora gutemberezwa mu mutekano binyuze muri iki cyuma cyo kurasa cya serivisi ya Windows. Ibice bibiri by'amagambo byashyizwe mu nyuguti, icyuho cy'umurongo cyangwa imvugo ihindutse ntibikoreshwa hano. Icyo cyiciro nticyahindutse.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchArguments
data.value: Itegeko ry'uruhererekane ryuzuye rikubiyemo imvugo y'itegeko idafite umutekano cyangwa igipimo cy'iterambere ry'ibintu bihinduka. Gusuzuma ibipimo byo gutangiza n'ibindi bitekerezo by'inyongera; Nta kintu na kimwe cyatangiye.

data.name: ServerStart.Arguments.CustomHidden
data.value: [Ibitekerezo byatanzwe ku mugenzo; ibikubiye muri log]

data.name: Configuration.Editor.Error.YamlUnsupported
data.value: YAML umurongo {0} ntabwo ikora neza cyangwa ikoresha ikintu uyu muhanga adashobora guhindura. Gushyigikirwa: inyandiko imwe ifite imiterere y'urupapuro / urutonde n'ibiciro by'umurongo umwe. Ibikoresho by'ubushakashatsi n'ibikoresho byo mu rwego rw'ikoranabuhanga Nta kintu na kimwe cyarokowe.

data.name: GameInput.WorldSeed.RequiredNumber
data.value: Ubukungu bw'isi bukenewe kuri {0}: koresha umubare wose uhereye kuri {1} kugeza kuri {2}. Jya uyikosora muri Setup ya Server > Icyiciro cy'isi.

data.name: ServerSetup.World.Seed.RangeHint
data.value: Umubare wose uhereye kuri {0} ukageza kuri {1}. Ku birebana n'isi iriho, jya urinda imbuto zayo z'ibanze.

data.name: ServerSetup.World.Seed.Hint
data.value: Jya utera imbuto z'isi nshya, cyangwa ujye mu isi yawe. Ku birebana n'isi iriho, jya urinda imbuto zayo z'ibanze.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Profile
data.value: Iyi porogaramu y'ibikoresho ifashwa gusa mu ma Folders y'Ibikubiyeho ya Empyrion.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.FolderName
data.value: Koresha izina rya folda y'abanditsi ba 1–80, nta mashusho, amazina ya Windows yihariye, cyangwa ahantu ha mbere / nyuma. Izina ry'ikintu runaka ntirishobora kuba ari nimero y'ikigo gusa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Layout
data.value: Hitamo imiterere yuzuye yo gukuramo cyangwa igitabo cy'imikorere ya seriveri cyakozwe, ntabwo ari ugushyiramo umukino, igitabo cya Workshop, igishushanyo mbonera cyangwa inyandiko y'ibikoresho by'urubuga.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioLayout
data.value: Ikiganiro kigomba kuba gifite gameoptions.yaml n'umutungo wacyo w'ibikoresho, imirima yo gukina, ibyiciro cyangwa prefabs hamwe, haba mu musaruro wa ZIP cyangwa muri dosiye imwe y'ikiganiro.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioCode
data.value: Iyi porogaramu irimo kode ya DLL, C# cyangwa JAR. Jya winjiza kode ya seriveri witandukanyije na Mods ya seriveri ya Empyrion nyuma yo gusuzuma amabwiriza y'umwanditsi.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ModLayout
data.value: Hitamo mod package yuzuye: dosiye za DLL n'izindi dosiye zibashyigikira zigomba kuba kuri paki root cyangwa mu mafolda ya mod. Ibikoresho by'inyongera n'ibikoresho byose bya seriveri ntibimwemerwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.MissingScenario
data.value: Icyo gitekerezo ntikiriho. Mbere na mbere, jya winjiza inyandiko yuzuye, hanyuma uhitemo mu rutonde rwashyizweho.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ConfigurationChanged
data.value: Imikorere cyangwa imiterere yo kubika byarahindutse mu gihe iyi idirishya yari yuguruye. Jya uyifunga maze wongere uhitemo uko ibintu bizagenda.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ExistingSave
data.value: Icyo gakiza kirahari. Mu mimerere itandukanye, hakenewe izina rishya ritakoreshejwe. Synix ntabwo yasimbuye cyangwa ngo ikureho isi iriho.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Configuration
data.value: dedicated.yaml irabuze, nini cyane, cyangwa ntiyirimo imiterere imwe ya GameConfig.CustomScenario na GameConfig.GameName. Jya ubanza ushyiraho seriveri.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.SaveFailed
data.value: Synix ntiyashoboye kubika inyandiko y'umukoresha. Gushyiraho imiterere y'ibyabaye mu gihe cyashize byasubijwe; Ibikoresho by'ubutabazi biracyariho.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ProtectedScenario
data.value: Synix ntabwo izavanaho imiterere y'ibintu cyangwa imiterere y'ibintu byatoranijwe mugihe isi zibitswe zikiriho. Izo si zishobora kuba zikiriho bitewe n'izo dosiye. Nta dosiye z'ibivugwa muri iyo nkuru zavanywe.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.ImportedScenario
data.value: Ibishushanyo by'ibiganiro byinjijwe mu gihugu. Nta kintu na kimwe cyahindutse ku isi n'ukuntu ibintu byagenze. Jya ukoresha Scenario Hitamo kugira ngo uhitemo iyo shusho n'izina ryo kubika. Jya ukoresha izina ry'ububiko bw'imimerere nk'uko ubigenje igihe winjiza ubuvugurura.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ModTitle
data.value: Jya ucuruza imikorere ya mudaseri ya Empyrion

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ScenarioHelp
data.value: Subira muri Steam hanyuma ureke gukuramo birangire, hanyuma uhitemo dosiye ya scénario munsi ya steamapps\workshop\content\383120, cyangwa uhitemo scénario yuzuye ZIP. Ibi byinjiza kopi y'aho hantu; Steam ntishobora kuvugurura kopi ya seriveri mu buryo bwikora.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ModHelp
data.value: Hitamo mod ZIP yuzuye ya seriveri cyangwa dosiye y'umwanditsi wizera. Jya ushyira hamwe DLL, _Info.yaml (igihe byatanzwe), ibyo ukeneye n'umutungo. Synix ntabwo ikuramo ibyo ishingiyeho cyangwa ngo ikore kode ya mod ubwayo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.FolderName
data.value: Izina ry'ububiko bwa Scenario kuri seriveri (kongera gukoresha iri zina mu gusesengura)

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.Confirm
EmpyrionMods.Selection.Saved
data.value: Ibyavuzwe muri iyo nkuru hamwe n'ibisobanuro byatanzwe mu gusohoza ayo masezerano, byararokotse. Jya utangiza seriveri igihe izaba yiteguye, hanyuma usuzume inyandiko y'umukino wayo maze uhuze n'umukiriya. Amazu y'ibitabo yariho muri icyo gihe yarakomeje.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.Help
EmpyrionMods.Selection.SaveName
data.value: Izina ryo kubika (GameConfig.GameName ?? ntabwo ari izina ryerekana seriveri)

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.NewSaveNotice
data.value: Impamvu itandukanye n'iyo, ni uko hari ubundi buryo bwo kubikemura. Synix igaragaza izina rishya kandi ntiyigera isesa cyangwa ngo ihindure isi iriho.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Support.Scenarios
data.value: Jya winjiza dosiye yo gukuramo cyangwa ZIP. Jya ukoresha Scenario uhitamo nyuma yaho; ibikoresho by'ubwubatsi bikiriho birarindwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Support.Mods
data.value: Jya winjiza imiterere y'ibikoresho bya mod byuzuye cyangwa ZIP. Genzura ibyo umwanditsi ashinzwe; code ikorera muri Empyrion.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Remove.Confirm
data.value: Gusubiza inyuma ibicuruzwa birimo {0}? Amafayili yose yashyizwe muri iyo pakete azakurwaho cyangwa asubirane kopi zayo za mbere, harimo n'izindi mod ziri muri iyo pakete. Ifayili zahinduwe hanze ya Synix zizabuza kugaruka. Kora kopi yuzuye y'ibikoresho bya seriveri mbere yo gukomeza.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.FolderUnsupported
data.value: Iyi sisitemu y'inyongera ntishyigikiye ibyo kwinjiza amabaruwa. Hitamo imwe mu mafayili y'ibikoresho byayo yemewe.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Hitamo dosiye yuzuye ya mod cyangwa ya scénario irimo dosiye zisabwa za package, ntabwo ari ishyirwaho ryumukino cyangwa urutonde rw'ibikuramo bidafitanye isano.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.Size
data.value: Igikoresho kirenze imipaka yo kwinjiza muri iyi sisitemu y'inyongera, cyangwa ibikubiyemo byahindutse mu gihe cy'ubuhinduzi. Nta kintu na kimwe cyashyizweho.

data.name: ModPackages.Picker.Help
data.value: Hitamo mod ZIP yuzuye cyangwa dosiye y'umukino n'ikibanza cyatoranyijwe. Jya urinda imiterere y'ibikoresho, ibyo ukeneye n'ibyo ufite. Jya usuzuma aho ugiye kandi urebe uko byagenze mbere yo kuwushyiraho.

data.name: ModPackages.Picker.SelectFolder
data.value: Hitamo dosiye yuzuye ya mod cyangwa scénario, aho guhitamo ishyirwaho ryumukino

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Import.ExistingScenario
data.value: Iyi dosiye y'imimerere imaze kubaho. Izo dosiye zizasimburwa, kandi zishobora kugira ingaruka ku isi zikoresha iyi nkuru. Komeza kubika seriveri yuzuye kandi ukoreshe izina rinyuranye ry'ububiko mu bihe bitandukanye. Ibitabo by'isi yahindutse ntibizongera kuvugururwa.

data.name: ModManager.Error.NewerInstallation
data.value: Ubu impapuro z'inyandiko ziherutse kwinjizwa zifite dosiye ziri muri ako gatabo. Mbere na mbere, jya ushyiraho ibintu bishya.

data.name: ModManager.Error.PreviousFileChanged
data.value: Ifayili y'umwimerere yari yaranditswe yahinduwe. Gusubiza byahagaritswe mbere yo guhindura dosiye za seriveri. Niba ari ngombwa, jya ushyiraho seriveri yuzuye yiringirwa.

data.name: ModManager.Inventory.Search
data.value: Gushakisha ibindi bintu by'inyongera muri iki gice cyo gushyiramo...

data.name: ModManager.Inventory.Scanning
data.value: Gusuzuma ibintu by'inyongera no kugenzura dosiye zashyizweho...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Installing
data.value: Gushyiraho ako gatabo kavuguruwe no kubika kopi z'ibitabo byasubiwemo...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Removing
data.value: Gusuzuma igiceri cyose no gusubizaho dosiye za kera...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Framework
data.value: Gushyiraho urufatiro rw'ibikoresho bya seriveri. Ndakwinginze komeza kugurura iri dirisha...

data.name: ModManager.Framework.SaveFailed
data.value: Amabiko y'ingingo yashyizweho, ariko Synix ntiyashoboye kubika imiterere ya seriveri. Suzuma ibyangombwa by'ububiko maze usubire kubika imiterere ya seriveri mbere yo gutangira. Ibikoresho byashyizweho ntibyabuwe.

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Failed
data.value: Icyo gikorwa nticyashoboraga kurangira. Ongera usuzume ikosa, hanyuma usubireho mbere yo kongera kugerageza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ApplyRuntime
data.value: Gushyira mu bikorwa igihe cyo gukora cyatoranyijwe

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Ready
data.value: Mwiteguye. Nta mushakisha utangizwa mu buryo bwikora.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Wait
data.value: Reka dutegereze ko icyo gikorwa kirangira.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Discard
data.value: Mbese, wagombye kwirengagiza izo mpapuro z'umwimerere?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewHelp
data.value: Genzura seriveri ya Minecraft yatoranyijwe hano. Muhagarike mbere y'uko uhindura dosiye, isi, paketi cyangwa igihe cyo gukora. Tangira, uhagarike kandi wongere ukoreshe uburyo busanzwe bwo kurinda ubuzima bwa Synix.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewValues
MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleHelp
data.value: Jya ukoresha gahunda zo kongera gutangira no gukora imirimo y'ubutabazi, harimo gutegereza abakinnyi no kubanza gukora kopi yuzuye. Ikirere gikoresha igihe cy'iyi PC. Synix igomba kuba irimo gukora kugira ngo ikoranabuhanga ryayo rigende neza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleValues
MinecraftWorkspace.PlayersHelp
data.value: Jya usubiraho kugira ngo urebe amazina yo kuri interineti n'inyandiko zandikishijwe intoki. Hitamo cyangwa wandike izina ry'umukinnyi, hanyuma usuzume icyo wakoze. Amategeko asabwa seriveri ikora no guhuza igikoresho gikora. Bedrock ntishyigikira amategeko yo kubuza Java.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.SettingsHelp
data.value: Jya uhindura dosiye za server.properties na mod/plugin. Ibiciro bikoreshwa na Synix bihuza mugihe server.properties ibitswe. Izina ryatangajwe / MOTD ritandukanye n'izina ry'aho muri iyi nyandiko. Gusubiza byongera guhinduranya imiterere yo hanze mugihe byahagaritswe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.EditorHelp
data.value: Gucunga birema kopi zo gusubukura. Guhinduka ku byambu, isi, imbuto, uburyo bwo gukina, imipaka y'umukinnyi, no gushyigikira imiterere yo kugenzura Minecraft nabyo bishyaza Synix. JSON, XML na YAML birasuzumwa mbere yo kubika; ubundi buryo bukenera gutunganywa neza. Jya urinda imyirondoro yawe ibanga.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.WorldsHelp
data.value: Jya winjiza Java cyangwa Bedrock world ZIP muri dosiye nshya, hanyuma uhitemo kuyikoresha. Isi zose ziriho ntizishobora gusimburwa. Ibitabo by'imfashanyigisho za Bibiliya ntibihindurwa. Guhindura ntabwo bivugurura, kugabanya cyangwa kwemeza ko umukino w'isi / mod ihuriyeho; banza usubire inyuma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ModsHelp
data.value: Gusuzuma metadata ya JAR n'ibikorerwa, gucunga inyongera ku giti cyawe, cyangwa gusuzuma seriveri yuzuye. Jya ukoresha verisiyo nyayo y'umukino n'igishushanyo cy'ibikoresho. Gusuzuma niba ikoranabuhanga rihuje n'amategeko ni inama kandi ntibigaragaza ko kode ifite umutekano cyangwa ko mod zose zizakora.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupsHelp
data.value: Ibikoresho by'ububiko bwuzuye birimo dosiye ya seriveri, isi, inyongera n'imiterere. Jya ubanza uhagarike seriveri. Mbere yo gusubiza ibintu mu buryo, jya ugenzura niba ibyo bintu ari ukuri. Gusubizaho gusimbuza dosiye za seriveri; inyandiko z'ibyangombwa zigenzura uburinganire bw'ibikoresho by'ububiko, ntabwo zigenzura niba ububiko bw'ibyangombwa bufite ikibazo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RecoveryHelp
data.value: Buri kintu cyose gihindurwa kiba gifite dosiye z'ibanze n'ama hash. Hitamo impinduka yashyizweho cyangwa yahagaritswe kugira ngo uyigarure. Mbere na mbere, ujye uhindura ibintu bishya. Ibikoresho byavuguruwe mu buryo bw'iburyo hamwe n'isi ikorwaho ibyoherezwa hanze birarindwa. Jya ukomeza kubikoresha kugira ngo utere imbere igihe cyo gukora/isi yose.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.DiagnosticsHelp
data.value: Jya ushakisha ibibazo bikunze kuvugwa mu nyandiko ya vuba y'ibikoresho bya seriveri no mu raporo y'impanuka. Ibyavumbuwe ni ibimenyetso, si impamvu zemeza. Igikorwa CPU/RAM ntabwo ari TPS/MSPT ya Minecraft; Gukoresha imyirondoro ihuje muri seriveri mu gihe ugenzura imikorere ya tick.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmStop
data.value: Noneho se, uhagarike uwo mushakisha akoresheje Synix?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestart
data.value: Noneho se, ushobora kongera gutangiza iyi seriveri ukoresheje Synix?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RuntimeNotice
data.value: Ese ushobora kwishyiriraho verisiyo y'umukino watoranyijwe, ukayishyiraho ubundi ukayishyiraho? Ibi bishobora gukuramo Java no gutangiza installateur yemewe ya Forge/NeoForge. dosiye za seriveri zibanza gushyirwa mu cyiciro; dosiye zigeze gusimbuzwa zibikwa kugira ngo zisubirane. Isi n'ibikoresho by'inyongera birakomeje kubaho. Kora kopi yuzuye mbere yo guhindura verisiyo z'umukino. Nta muyoboro w'imikino watangiye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmPlayer
data.value: Kohereza umurongo w'umukinnyi watoranyijwe? Uruhare rw'umukoresha rutuma umukinnyi ashobora kugenzura seriveri y'umukino.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmWorld
data.value: Ese uzakoresha isi yatoranyijwe mu ntambwe ikurikira? Isi iriho ubu iguma kuri disiki. Jya uhitamo gusa isi ihuriye n'iyo seriveri, verisiyo yayo n'imikorere yayo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PackNotice
data.value: Kwimura iyi seriveri yiringirwa? Paketi ya Modrinth ishobora gukuramo dosiye zivugwa mu byemezo bya HTTPS. Mods n'inyandiko z'umukino zikoresha kode muri seriveri y'umukino. Imiterere y'ibikoresho, hash, guhuza n'imikorere ya virusi hamwe n'ibipimo by'imikoreshereze ya virusi ntibitanga icyizere cy'uko bizagira umutekano. Jya usuzuma ibyo wahinduye mbere yo kubishyira mu bikorwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilityNotice
data.value: Ibikoresho by'ubushakashatsi bisoma metadata nta kode ya mod yishyuriwe. Ibikoresho by'ubuhinduzi bigoye, dependance zigengwa n'imimerere, hamwe na metadata zimwe na zimwe zishyiriweho / zisigaye zikeneye gusuzumwa mu buryo bw'amaboko. Ibyo bigenzurwa ntibitanga icyizere cy'uko hari malware ihuriyeho cyangwa ko itabaho.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupSpace
data.value: Reba ahantu ho gushakira ibyangombwa n'ahantu habonetse.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmBackup
data.value: Mbese, wakora kopi yuzuye y'iyi seriveri yahagaritswe?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestore
data.value: Ese ushobora gusubizaho ibyangombwa byose by'ubufasha? Ibikoresho by'abakozi biriho bizasimburwa. Jya usuzuma inyandiko z'ibitabo kandi ukomeze kubika dosiye zose ukeneye mbere yo gukomeza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.UndoNotice
data.value: Jya usubiza dosiye zabanjirije iyi mpinduka. Amafayili yongeyeho iyi mpinduka avurwa gusa niba itarahindutse. Ibikoresho byavuguruwe bibuza kugarura. Kugira ngo umuntu ahindure isi iyo ari yo yose nyuma yo gutangira verisiyo y'umukino, hakenewe kopi yuzuye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoLogFindings
data.value: Mu nyandiko za vuba aha, nta kintu na kimwe cyabonetse. Ibyo si ibizamini byuzuye. Koresha ikoranabuhanga ryiteguye maze urebe niba hari ikosa rya mbere ryakorewe hafi y'igihe cyo gusenyuka.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PreviewSummary
data.value: Isuzuma mbere yo gushyira mu bikorwa: {0} nshya • {1} yasimbuwe • {2} yakuwe. Ibikoresho by'ububiko bya kera bigumaho kugira ngo bisubirane. Nta muyoboro utangiye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Runtime
data.value: Igikorwa cy'umushinga wo gutangiza seriveri cyangwa metadata yacyo yo gukuramo ntabwo iboneka. Jya ushyiraho uburyo bwo guhitamo verisiyo/gushyiraho inyandiko maze wongere ugerageze.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Size
data.value: Ibyo bikubiyemo birenze imipaka y'ibikoresho byashyigikiwe, metadata cyangwa ingano rusange.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Recovery
data.value: Ibimenyetso byo kugaruka birabuze cyangwa ntibihuza. Jya urinda dosiye yo gusubiza ibintu mu buryo kandi ukoreshe kopi yuzuye y'ibikoresho.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PendingRecovery
data.value: Imikorere y'ibikubiye mu nyandiko ya mbere ikeneye gusubirwamo. Fungura Gusubiza Ihinduka maze ucyikemure mbere yo gukora indi mpinduka.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Changed
data.value: dosiye yarahindutse kuva isuzumwa cyangwa kuva icyo gikorwa cyakozwe. Ongera usubire gusuzuma. Nta mpapuro z'ubuhinduzi zitari zifitanye isano zizasubirwamo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Layout
data.value: Uburyo bwo gutegura ibyo bikoresho cyangwa uburyo bwo kubishyiraho, ntibirimo umutekano, ntibihuje n'ukuri, cyangwa se ntibishyigikiwe. Hitamo seriveri ikoreshwa cyangwa inyandiko y'isi yose.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ActiveWorld
data.value: Iyi ni isi y'ibintu byinjijwe mu mahanga. Jya mu yindi si mbere y'uko ushyiraho imihati kugira ngo uyisubize.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldExists
data.value: Iyo dosiye y'isi imaze kubaho. Hitamo izina rishya ry'ububiko; Ibihugu bikiriho ntibizigera bigerwaho n'ibicuruzwa bituruka hanze.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldLayout
data.value: Hitamo inyandiko irimo isi imwe na level.dat. Ibaruramari rya serveri yuzuye na multi-world rikoresha imikorere y'ububiko bwa backup/reset.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldEdition
data.value: Iyi si ntihuza na seriveri cyangwa nta dosiye zisabwa zo mu karere / urubuga rw'amakuru. Java n'isi Bedrock ntizihindurwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldName
data.value: Koresha izina ry'ububiko bw'isi rifite umutekano, ritagira inzira cyangwa amazina ya Windows yihariye. Ku bihugu byinjijwe mu mahanga, koresha inyuguti, imibare, ibibanza, imirongo y'inyuguti cyangwa ibimenyetso by'ibanze.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.JavaOnly
data.value: Iyi gahunda y'akazi igenewe mod/plugins z'abakozi ba Java. Gukoresha imikorere ya Bedrock bwite ifashwa; Java JARs ntizishobora gukoreshwa kuri Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackEmpty
data.value: Nta kintu cyo muri seriveri cyifashishwa cyabonetse. Imyandikire yo gutangiza, dosiye z'umukiriya, igihe cyo gukora, isi, n'ibishushanyo bya seriveri y'umuzi ntabwo byinjizwa mu modpack.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.LoaderMismatch
data.value: Ubwoko bw'ibikoresho ntibuhuza na porogaramu ya seriveri yatoranyijwe. Mods zikeneye mod loader ihuriyeho; Bukkit / Paper plugins zikeneye igihe cyo gukora plugin.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.CurseForgeManifest
data.value: Iyi ni inyandiko y'umukiriya wa CurseForge, si seriveri yuzuye. Vanaho seriveri z'umwanditsi ZIP irimo mods n'imiterere; dosiye zitariho ntizigomba guceceka.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackVersion
data.value: Verisiyo ya pack Minecraft na loader/build bigomba guhura n'iyi seriveri. Mbere na mbere, jya uhitamo igihe nyacyo cyo gukora. Ibikoresho byo kwinjiza bidashyigikiwe ntibisimburwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadSource
data.value: Igikoresho cyo gukuramo cyangwa kongera kuyobora ntabwo ari isoko ryemewe rya public HTTPS. Ahubwo jya ukoresha seriveri ya ZIP ikoreshwa n'umwanditsi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadHash
data.value: Ifayili yakuritswe ntiyari ihuje n'ubunini bwayo bwatangajwe cyangwa hash ya SHA-512. Nta kintu na kimwe cyashyizweho.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Properties
data.value: Igiciro cya Minecraft gikoreshwa na Synix ntabwo gifite agaciro cyangwa kirimo amakimbirane. Jya ugenzura imbuga, imipaka y'umukinnyi, uburyo bwo gukina, n'imiterere yo kugenzura mbere yo kubika.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.SaveEntry
data.value: Synix ntiyashoboye kubika inyandiko ya seriveri iherutse kuvugururwa. Icyo gikorwa nticyakiriwe; dosiye zo gusubukura zabaga zikiriho igihe byari bikenewe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ManagementLocal
data.value: Synix's Minecraft management connection igomba kuguma kuri localhost. Ntukagaragarize kuri interineti iyi ntego yo kugenzura.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PortConflict
data.value: Icyambu cyashyizweho ni icy'indi seriveri ya Synix. Hitamo icyambu gitandukanye mbere yo kubika.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Player
data.value: Hitamo igikorwa cyifashishwa n'izina ry'umukinnyi ryemewe. Kubuza Java si amategeko ya Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.StartFailed
data.value: Seriveri ntiyatangiye. Mbere yo kongera kugerageza, jya ureba ko witeguye kandi urebe inyandiko y'ibikorwa bya dashboard.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.MetadataUnknown
data.value: Metadata ntiyashoboraga gusomwa mu buryo bwuzuye. Reba dosiye n'ibisabwa n'umwanditsi wayo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.Duplicate
data.value: Abenshi mu bayobozi ba JAR bo ku rwego rwo hejuru batanga ubu butumwa. Jya usuzuma maze ukureho iyo kopi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.ClientOnly
data.value: Iyi JAR ivuga ko igenewe abakiriya gusa. Ntukishyire kuri seriveri yihariye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.WrongLoader
data.value: Metadata z'iyi JAR ntizihuye na loader/porogaramu yatoranyijwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyMissing
data.value: Ibisabwa ntabwo biboneka muri metadata ya scan: {0}. Mbere yo gushyiraho ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose, ujye ureba niba hari ibyo ukeneye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyReview
data.value: Kugenzura ku giti cyawe {0}: {1} ikenewe, {2} isanijwe. Iyi ntera/iyo nteruro ntabwo isobanutse neza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Java
data.value: Iyo nyandiko igaragaza ko Java/classes-version idahuje. Koresha verisiyo ya Java isaba seriveri n'umujyanama wa mod yatoranyijwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Memory
data.value: Igitabo cyerekana ko Java idashobora gushyiraho ubushobozi buhagije bwo kwibuka. Jya ureba niba RAM iriho, urugero rw'ikipe y'abakozi, n'uko abandi bakoresha iyo seriveri.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Dependency
data.value: Mu gitabo cy'ibitabo havugwamo ibyo umuntu asabwa kugira ngo agire icyo akora. Suzuma ikosa rya mbere ryakozwe n'umukoresha, hanyuma ugenzure mod nyayo, uburyo umukino ushyigikiwe, verisiyo y'umukoresha n'ubwubatsi bw'umukoresha.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Port
data.value: Igitabo kivuga ko hari icyambu cyamaze gukoreshwa. Reba izindi gahunda n'amavuko yashyizweho y'iyi seriveri; ntukingure inzugi zitari zifitanye isano na firewall.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Eula
data.value: Igitabo gisaba ko Minecraft EULA yemerwa. Niba ubyemeranyaho, ujye uyisoma kandi uyemere.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Tick
data.value: Ibitabo by'ibitabo bivuga ko imbwa z'umurinzi zifata igihe cyo gukora ibintu mu buryo butunguranye. Reba ibyo CPU itwara, iterambere ry'isi, ibiremwa n'imikorere. Birashoboka ko RAM yonyine itazakemura icyo kibazo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Mixin
data.value: Ikosa ry'urusobe akenshi riterwa n'imiterere idashyize mu bikorwa ya mod/loader. Reba impamvu ya mbere mu raporo y'impanuka n'ibisobanuro byasabwaga.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.World
data.value: Iyo nyandiko igaragaza amakosa yo gusoma amakuru y'isi. Jya uhagarika seriveri maze ukomeze kubika dosiye ziriho mbere yo kugerageza gukora sauvegarde ikora neza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeRecovery
data.value: Icyo gikoresho cya kera ntikirimo igihe cyo gukora cyanditswe. Koresha seriveri yuzuye yo kuyigarura; Synix ntishobora kwiyumvisha uko byari byifashe mu gihe cyashize.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeMismatch
data.value: Igihe cyo gukora cyashyizweho ntabwo gihuye n'ibisabwa mu mpapuro, verisiyo, utwara cyangwa Java watoranyijwe. Fungura ikigo cy'ubuyobozi cya Minecraft ukoreshe Apply Runtime mbere yo gutangira.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.InvalidValue
data.value: Igiciro cya {0} ntikirimo agaciro. Jya ukosora iyi myugariro mbere yo kubika.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Empty
data.value: Nta kintu cyo kwerekana. Gusubiza nyuma yo kongeramo ibikubiyemo cyangwa guhindura igenamiterere ry'iyi seriveri.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilitySummary
data.value: {0} add-ons zavuzwe • Ibyavumbuwe muri {1} bigomba gusuzumwa. Iyo filimi ntihindura dosiye.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityAddOns
data.value: Nta bikoresho by'inyongera byabonetse muri mods cyangwa plugins ikora kuri iyi seriveri.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityFindings
data.value: Nta bibazo byabonetse mu gusuzuma metadata zariho. Ibyo ntibigaragaza ko mod zose cyangwa plugins zizakorana.

data.name: AsaPackages.Help
data.value: Hitamo ASA Windows-server ZIP yakuwe cyangwa dosiye yakuwe. Synix ibona ibisobanuro bya mod biri mu mpapuro zisanzwe, zuzuye cyangwa nyinshi kandi zitegura ID za CurseForge kugira ngo zisubizwe. Amabiko ya ZIP ntabwo avugwa cyangwa ngo ashyirweho. ASA ikuraho kandi igakora inyandiko y'umushinga w'umushinga igihe utangije seriveri; Ibyo ntibigaragaza ko iyo filimi ari iya ZIP.

data.name: AsaPackages.Choose
data.value: Hitamo aderesi cyangwa dosiye ushaka gusuzuma. Nta migambi ya seriveri cyangwa dosiye bizahinduka kugeza igihe usuzumye byitondewe no kubika urutonde rwa mod ID.

data.name: AsaPackages.Trust
data.value: Impamyabumenyi y'ibikoresho ntiziringirwa. Kwiyumvisha ibintu si ukugenzura porunogarafiya, kureba niba ikora neza cyangwa se kugaragaza ko ari umwanditsi.

data.name: AsaPackages.Reading
data.value: Gusoma metadata y'ibikoresho. Nta mod code ikoreshwa.

data.name: AsaPackages.Found
data.value: {0} modes zigaragaye; {1} impamyabumenyi nshya yo kongeramo. Inyandiko z'ibyangombwa zifite aho zibarizwa. Jya usuzuma urutonde rwuzuye mbere yo kubika.

data.name: AsaPackages.Timeout
data.value: Isuzuma ry'ibyo bikoresho ryahagaritswe cyangwa ryaratinze cyane. Hitamo dosiye y'ibikoresho bito hanyuma wongere ugerageze.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Source
data.value: Hitamo mod ZIP ya seriveri ya ARK cyangwa dosiye ya mod yakuwe. Iyi mpuguke ntishyigikiwe n'izindi mpuguke z'ibitabo.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Limit
data.value: Igihembo kirenze imipaka y'umusomyi wa metadata. Hitamo dosiye nto cyangwa ZIP ifite ibisobanuro bya mod 100 gusa.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Icyo gikoresho kirimo inzira zitari nziza, amahuza, inzira zinyuranye, dosiye zivuguruzanya cyangwa imfashanyo nyinshi cyane. Nta kintu na kimwe cyahindutse.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Descriptor
data.value: Nta gisobanuro cy'imikorere ya mod .uplugin cyabonetse. Hitamo mod ZIP cyangwa dosiye yayo yakuwe; inyandiko zashyizwe mu nzu y'ibitabo zigomba kubanza gushyirwa hanze.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Metadata
data.value: Igisobanuro cy'imikorere ntabwo gihuje n'ukuri, JSON idafite aho ihuriye. Nta kintu na kimwe cyahindutse.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Game
data.value: Igishushanyo cyerekana ko nta mushinga wa ARK: Survival Ascended CurseForge urimo. Synix ntishobora kumenya umukino cyangwa mod ID.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Id
data.value: Igishushanyo cy'ibisobanuro ntigifite ID imwe yemewe y'umushinga wa CurseForge (cf_ugcID). Koresha Manage Mod IDs hamwe na ID yo ku ipaji ya CurseForge y'umwanditsi.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.ServerBuild
data.value: Mod nta pakizi ya WindowsServer izwi cyangwa nta dosiye .ucas/.utoc ihuriyeho. Hitamo uburyo bwo gukuramo kuri seriveri ya Windows, aho guhitamo uburyo bwo kubaka umukiriya.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.DuplicateMod
data.value: Igihembo kirimo ibisobanuro birenze kimwe kuri mod id idasanzwe. Jya uhitamo imwe muri buri mod, maze wongere uyisuzume.

data.name: AsePackages.Title
data.value: Soma ibikubiye muri ASE mod package

data.name: AsePackages.Help
data.value: Hitamo mod ARK: Survival Evolved ZIP cyangwa dosiye irimo .mod descriptor n'igitabo cyayo cyo guteka. Synix isoma ID ya Workshop mu gisobanuro, ntabwo ari izina rya ZIP. Files ntizivugururwa cyangwa ngo zishyirweho: nyuma yo gusuzuma, Synix ishyiraho ActiveMods na ModIDS kugirango ARK ikore inzira yo gukuramo ikoranabuhanga. Amakarita n'ihindurwa rusange bishobora gusaba ko hashyirwaho seriveri itandukanye. Amapaki ya ASA CurseForge ntabwo ahuriyeho.

data.name: AsePackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Ibi ntabwo ari ibicuruzwa byemewe byuzuye bya mod ASE. Shyiramo .mod description and matching mod folder with mod.info and cooked assets. ID yashyizweho igomba guhuza n'izina rya dosiye ry'ibisobanuro by'umubare. Raw Workshop .z downloads zitagira dosiye .mod yiteguye ntizifashishwa n'uyu musomyi; jya ukoresha Mod ID zo gucunga.

data.name: ArkPackages.Error.WrongEdition
data.value: Iyi mfashanyigisho ikubiyemo ibisobanuro ku kindi gitabo cya ARK. Mod za Workshop za ASE Steam na mod za ASA CurseForge ntabwo zisubirwamo. Hitamo seriveri yatoranyijwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Help
data.value: Shyira dosiye ya mod cyangwa plugin maze wemere amoko y'ibikoresho byingenzi ukoresheje amabwiriza y'uyu mukino cyangwa uwutangiza. Ibyo bireba seriveri gusa. Hitamo ahantu habayeho kugira ngo uheruke; Nta dosiye za mod zihindutse hano.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Warning
data.value: Kwinjiza dosiye ntabwo bishyirwaho moderi yo kwinjiza cyangwa yo kwiyandikisha igenzurwa n'umutangabuhamya. Reba amabwiriza yo gushyiraho umukino.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Ready
data.value: Kwinjiza dosiye ku giti cyawe ?? gusesengura ibyo ukeneye

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Start
data.value: Jya ukoresha imikorere yo kwinjiza kugira ngo ushyireho dosiye ya mod cyangwa plugin y'iyi seriveri. Kwinjiza dosiye ntibigaragaza ko umukino ushobora kuzishyiraho.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Help
data.value: Hitamo dosiye iri muri ako gatabo irimo ibintu biherereye aho seriveri iherereye. Amapaki y'ibikoresho by'ubushakashatsi aracyariho. Ushobora gukuraho impapuro zo gukuramo ukoresheje dosiye y'inyongera. Gusa dosiye ziri muri urwo rutonde ni zo zizatangwa; dosiye zisanzwe zihabwa kopi zo gusubirana. Ibyo ntibyahindura mod zidashobora guhura.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.WholePackage
data.value: Ipakiti yose ?? ikomeze kugira imiterere y'ibikoresho

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Reading
data.value: Gusoma ibitabo no gutegura urutonde rw'aho ugiye kujya...

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Summary
data.value: Guhitamo dosiye {0}; {1} dosiye zisanzwe zizasubirwamo mbere yo gusimbuzwa. Nta kintu na kimwe cyashyizweho kugeza igihe hazabaho ikemezo gikurikira.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.InvalidLocations
data.value: Imirimo yo kwinjiza ibitswe ntabwo ikora cyangwa ni iy'umukinnyi utandukanye na we. Nta dosiye yahinduwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.InstallFolder
data.value: Jya ushyiraho iyi seriveri mbere yo gushyiraho imikorere yo kwinjiza mu karere.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.LocationLimit
data.value: Seriveri ishobora kugira ahantu ho kwinjiza ibyangombwa bya 32.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.LocationName
data.value: Andika izina ry'ahantu mu nyuguti 1–80 maze uhitemo Mod cyangwa Plugin.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.Extensions
data.value: Andika inyandikorugero zingenzi za dosiye 1–32, harimo utubazo twazo, nka .dll cyangwa .pak. Ibikoresho byo gushyiramo n'ibisomwa by'amabwiriza ntibimwemerwa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.Collision
data.value: Iyi paki ifite ikibazo cy'ibikoresho bya dosiye n'ibikoresho bya foleri. Jya uhitamo igitabo cyuzuye.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.NoFiles
data.value: Ako gakarita k'ibikoresho cyatoranyijwe ntikirimo amoko y'ibikoresho by'ingenzi byo muri ako gace. Hitamo indi folda y'ibikubiyemo cyangwa usuzume ubwoko bwemewe bw'aho uherereye.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.PackageRoot
data.value: Hitamo dosiye yemewe iri muri ako gatabo. Inzira zitari muri iyo mfungurwa ntizemerwa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Done
data.value: Ibikoresho byinjijwe. Kopi z'ibitabo byavuguruwe zabaga zigenewe gusimbuzwa izindi. Mbere yo gutangira, ujye usuzuma ibisabwa kugira ngo umukino ushyirwe ku murongo n'ibisabwa kugira ngo ukore. Nta muyoboro watangiye.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Rollback
data.value: Gusubizaho package yose y'ibyoherejwe "{0}" (files {1})? Ibyo bigarura dosiye zayo za kera kandi bikakuraho dosiye zari zongeyeho. Ibyo bigira ingaruka ku bikoresho byose, si kuri dosiye yatoranyijwe gusa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Button
data.value: Jya winjiza impapuro z' inyandiko / dosiye

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Help
data.value: Hitamo inyandiko ya ZIP, dosiye ya mod washyize kuri orudinateri, cyangwa dosiye yakuwe muri orudinateri. Synix isoma igitabo cya {0} kandi igaragaza uko kiza kongerwa mbere yo guhindura ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.File
data.value: Hitamo dosiye ya ZIP cyangwa mod

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Filter
data.value: Ibihembo bya ZIP (*.zip)|*.zip|Amashusho ya Mod cyangwa Plugin (*.*)|*.*

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Empty
data.value: Tangira uhitemo inyandiko yawe ya ZIP cyangwa ako gakarita. Si ngombwa ko ubanza ushyiraho ahantu ho kwinjiza.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.DestinationHelp
data.value: Hitamo dosiye ya mod iri muri iyi seriveri, ukurikije amabwiriza yo gushyiraho umukino.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Reading
data.value: Iyo usomye ako gatabo, ugasuzuma uko gashyizwe... nta dosiye z'abakozi zihinduka.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Unknown
data.value: Soma dosiye {0}. Synix ntiyashoboye kumenya aho uyu mukino uherereye. Hitamo dosiye ya mod ya seriveri; amakarita y'ibikoresho byuzuye mu buryo bwikora. Ntugatekereze kuri iyo dosiye.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Ambiguous
data.value: Soma dosiye {0}. Hari ahantu henshi ushobora kujya. Hitamo mod cyangwa plugin ihuriyeho hejuru kugira ngo uyirebe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Cancelled
data.value: Gusoma ibyangombwa byahagaritswe. Nta kintu na kimwe cyinjijwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.ProviderDetails
UniversalMods.Wizard.ProviderWarning
data.value: Twabonye imyirondoro ya mod {0}. Hanyuma usuzume urutonde rw'ibyangombwa byatanzwe. ARK ikuramo modes mu ntangiriro zayo zikurikira; Iyi si dosiye yoherejwe mu karere. Nta mushakisha utangizwa mu buryo bwikora.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.LoaderMissing
data.value: Iyi porogaramu ikeneye umuyoboro ushyiraho seriveri. Jya ushyira umurongo w'ibikoresho mu myitozo ya seriveri, hanyuma wongere ufungure Import. Amabiko ntiyahinduwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Summary
data.value: dosiye za {0} zizatangwa; {1} dosiye zisanzwe zizasubirwamo mbere yo gusimbuzwa. Isuzume aho ugiye kujya. Nta muyoboro utangira ku buryo bwikora.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.ManualWarning
data.value: Ibikoresho bizandikwa muri {0}. Reba isura y'ibanze n'amabwiriza y'umukino: guhitamo dosiye ntibituma ushyiraho umuyoboro wo gupakira cyangwa ngo ukore mod igenzurwa n'abatangaza. Aho hantu twibuka nyuma yo kubimenya.

data.name: ModSupport.ImportRules
data.value: Synix ifite amategeko agenga ibyo kwinjiza muri uyu mukino. Paketi igomba gukomeza guhura na loader yashyizweho, verisiyo ya seriveri n'ibikorerwa.

data.name: ModSupport.ManualSetup
data.value: Kugeza ubu nta tegeko ry'ishyirirwaho ryikora ririho kuri uyu mukino. Soma inzira ikurikira mbere yo guhitamo aho ugiye; dosiye na zo zishobora gukenerwa gukoreshwa muri porogaramu cyangwa umuyoboro.

data.name: ModSupport.EvidenceNote
data.value: Ubufasha bwanditse ntabwo ari ikigeragezo cy'ubwumvikane kuri seriveri nzima. Imikorere y'abakozi, imikorere y'abakiliya n'iy'abashyiramo ibikoresho byo gupakira ibintu biratandukanye. Nta kintu na kimwe cyakuwe, cyashyizweho cyangwa gitangizwa n'iyi nyigisho.

data.name: ModSupport.UnverifiedNote
data.value: Nta buryo bwizewe bwo gushyiramo bwihariye kuri seriveri bwemejwe kugeza ubu. Ibyo ntibishatse kuvuga ko umukino udashobora guhindurwa. Hitamo aderesi ya ZIP cyangwa dosiye kugira ngo uyisuzume, hanyuma ukoreshe amabwiriza ya seriveri y'umwanditsi kugira ngo wemeze aho ugiye no gukora.

data.name: ModSupport.Sources
data.value: Ibimenyetso byo gushyiramo (gufungura umurongo wo gusoma)

data.name: ModSupport.GuidedImport
data.value: Uburyo bwo guhindura seriveri bwanditswe. Jya ukoresha Mod support & setup kugira ngo ubone amabwiriza yo gukora, hanyuma wohereze ZIP / folda kugira ngo usuzume package yawe.

data.name: ModSupport.UnverifiedImport
data.value: Hitamo Import ZIP / Folder kugira ngo usuzume paketi. Kugenzura ibyifuzo byubufasha bwa seriveri; Gushyigikira Mod & Setup bisobanuye imipaka.

data.name: ModSupport.InvalidCatalog

data.name: Configuration.Sync.Ambiguous
data.value: Imyitozo ya "{0}" ifitanye isano n'imiterere y'ibintu byombi cyangwa ibivuguruzanya. Jya ubikemura mbere yo kubika kugira ngo Synix ishobore kuvugurura agaciro k'umukozi.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.InvalidValue
data.value: Inshingano yahawe "{0}" ifite agaciro katemewe kuri Synix. Jya ubikosora mbere yo kubikuraho.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.RollbackFailed
data.value: Kurinda byarananiye kandi imiterere y'umwimerere ntiyashoboraga kugarurwa mu buryo bwikora. Ntuzatangire gukoresha seriveri kugeza ubwo usuzumye imiterere n'ibikoresho byayo by'ububiko: {0}
