data.value: Hitamo ifunguro n'aho ugiye kureba icyo Synix ishobora kugenzura.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingDestination

data.value: Kwinjiza ibintu mu kindi gihugu ntibizigera bitangiza seriveri. Gukora bizaterwa n'umukino n'imikorere ya mod.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingRecovery
data.value: Shyiramo seriveri n'isi mbere yo gukoresha mod nshya. Inzira yahisemo izasobanura ibyo umuntu ashobora guhindura.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.LayoutRecognized
data.value: Uburyo bwo gutunganya/gushyiraho ibintu bwaramenyekanye. Imyitozo y'umukino, dependance n'ibisabwa n'umukiriya ntabwo byemezwa mu buryo bwuzuye hano; Reba ibyo umwanditsi asaba.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ManualCompatibility
data.value: Gushyira hamwe kw'igitabo cy'ibanze cy'aho ugiye guherera (manual destination) ntabwo byemejwe. Gushyiraho inyongera y'ifoto ihuje n'iyo, ntibigaragaza ko iyi mod ikorana n'uyu mukino cyangwa umushyitsi.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.LoaderMissing
data.value: Kwinjiza kwabuzanyijwe: hari umuterankunga uhuye utariho cyangwa paketi ntihuze n'umuterankunga watoranijwe. Reba imiterere ya seriveri n'ubufasha bwa Mod & setup.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderCompatibility
data.value: Impapuro z'abatanze gusa. Ibitabo by'imfashanyigisho za mod, dependencies na platform compatibility ntibigenzurwa. Wemeze ko buri gikoresho cya seriveri gifasha iyi seriveri.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderDestination
data.value: Synix ibika urutonde rw'amazina ya {0} yategetswe, ntabwo ibika dosiye za mod za ZIP. Umukino/uwatanze ayobora aho gukuramo.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileChanges
data.value: dosiye {0} ziri muri gahunda; {1} dosiye zisanzwe zizasubirwamo mbere yo gusimbuzwa.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FilePreview
data.value: Hitamo dosiye iri ibumoso kugira ngo urebe aho iherereye. Nta kintu na kimwe cyandikwa kugeza igihe ikiganiro gikurikira kizaba cyaremejwe.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderActivation
data.value: Ujye uhungira imyirondoro yawe, hanyuma utange seriveri ubwawe maze usuzume inyandiko yo gukuramo / gutangiza. ZIP yatoranijwe ntabwo ishyiraho verisiyo yakuritswe n'umukino/uwatanze.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ManualActivation
data.value: Gukoporora dosiye ntibikoresha ikinyabiziga cyangwa kwandika/gufasha mod. Kurikiza Mod support & setup n'amabwiriza y'umwanditsi wa seriveri, hanyuma utange seriveri ubwawe maze urebe inyandiko yayo.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ScenarioActivation
data.value: Kwinjiza ibicuruzwa mu mahanga si byo bituma isi ikora. Jya ukoresha Scenario uhitamo kugira ngo uhitemo iyi shusho n'uko uyigumizamo mbere yo gutangira. Amacunga asanzwe ntabwo ahindurwa mu buryo bwikora.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileActivation
data.value: Iyo utangiye seriveri, iyo porogaramu yatoranijwe isoma dosiye zashyizwe hanze. Mbere na mbere, jya wuzuza ibindi bisobanuro by'umwanditsi n'ibyo umukiriya asabwa, hanyuma usuzume inyandiko yo gutangiza. Synix ntabwo itangiza seriveri.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileRecovery
data.value: Uhagarike seriveri, uhitemo ikintu cyinjijwe maze ukoreshe Roll Back Import. Ibi bigarura dosiye zasimbuwe kandi bikuraho dosiye nshya kuri ibyo byinjijwe; Guhindura ibintu nyuma bishobora kubuza abantu gusubira inyuma. Nta kintu na kimwe ihindura ku isi. Mbere yo gutangira, ujye ushakisha amafaranga yose.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderRecovery
data.value: Uhagarike seriveri maze uhindure urutonde rw'ibimenyetso kugira ngo ukureho ibyo wongeyeho cyangwa usubize urutonde rwa mbere. Ibi ntabwo bihanagura dosiye z'abatanga serivise cyangwa gusubizaho verisiyo za mod za kera / amakuru y'isi. Mbere yo gutangira, komeza urutonde rwa kera rw'ibyangombwa n'umwirondoro wa seriveri.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ScenarioRecovery
data.value: Imimerere ikiriho cyangwa imicungire iriho ishobora gutuma umuntu atayivanaho.

Kora ku kibazo maze wongere ugerageze gutangira; iyo gahunda yo gutangiza ikomeje guhagarara kugeza igihe ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry'ubuhuza rizaba ryaragenze neza. Ibisobanuro: {0}

data.name: Language.PreviewNotice
data.value: Isura y'ibanze: Ibikoresho by'ingenzi byo kuyobora byahinduwe. Hari ubufasha n'ubuvuzi bikiri mu cyongereza.

data.name: GameText.Introduction
data.value: Synix yemera inyandiko mpuzamahanga. Buri shami rifite imiterere yaryo bwite y'ibimenyetso; gushyigikirwa kw'izina ntabwo bigaragaza ko ushyigikiye ijambo ry'ibanga. Kuba nta gihamya bifite ntibisobanura ko nta gihamya ifite kandi ntibituma amategeko yo mu rurimi rw'icyongereza gusa ashyirwa mu bikorwa. Ibaruramari ntabwo ari ikigeragezo kibaho cya buri verisiyo y'umukino, inyuguti ya client cyangwa uburyo bwo kwinjira.

data.name: GameText.SafetyNote
data.value: Jya urinda amagambo y'ibanga nk'uko yashyizwe: ibimenyetso bisa n'ibyo mu maso bishobora kuba bifite uburyo butandukanye bwo kwandika. Imirongo y'imikino iriho n'ibitabo by'itandukaniro bibujijwe biracyakoreshwa. Ibirango byo kwemeza, ID, amazina y'ibikoresho n'amazina y'umukinnyi bifite amategeko yihariye.

data.name: GameText.UnverifiedNote
data.value: Gushakisha kuri interineti ntibyatumye haboneka ubufasha bwemewe n'amategeko ku rwego mpuzamahanga. Jya usuzuma ibitabo by'imikino biriho ubu maze ugerageze kumenya neza abo bantu mbere yo kubashingiraho. Si ngombwa ko umupira uhagaritswe muri Synix utaboneka mu mukino.

data.name: GameText.InvalidCatalog
data.value: Gahunda yo gushyigikira imiterere ya seriveri ntikora.

data.name: GameText.InvalidUnicode
data.value: {0} irimo inyuguti ya Unicode itararangira. Ongera uyinjize; Synix ntabwo izasimbuza ijambo ry'ibanze cyangwa izina ry'imiterere mu cyubahiro.

data.name: Content.007253C01F3D240BCA85
data.value: Euro Truck Simulator 2 igomba kohereza hanze amakarita yayo, DLC, na mod dosiye z'umukino usanzwe mbere y'uko seriveri yihariye ishobora gutangira. Jya ukurikiza intambwe zigaragara zo gushyiraho; Synix izinjiza dosiye zakozwe kuri iyi seriveri.

data.name: Content.00DEEBB0AC0CF305D39F
data.value: Hariho mod za code zo ku ruhande rw'imashini, harimo na mod yatanzwe n'umushakashatsi. Gushyiraho porogaramu y'umukino, guhuza n'ibikorerwa hamwe no gukora isi bishingiye kuri verisiyo y'umukino/mod; nta cyerekezo rusange cya DLL gitekerezwaho.

data.value: Hitamo mod z'isi / seriveri aho gukoporora ZIP rusange. Steam na crossplay/mod.io biratandukanye. Ibishushanyo bya seriveri bikeneye ishyirwa mu bikorwa ryiza rya seriveri no kubaka plugin.

data.value: SteamCMD Uburyo bwo gukuramo no gutera imbere

data.value: Java ifite rcon.password; Bedrock nta murongo w'iherezo wubatse muri Java RCON. UTF-8 configuration support ntabwo ishyiraho imikorere y'imiterere ya buri mukiriya wa RCON. Jya ugenzura seriveri n'umukiriya hamwe.

data.name: Content.04306C6DCC8E032536F2
data.value: Komeza buri cyumba cy'ibikoresho hamwe na filelist.xml hamwe hanyuma ushyireho ibyangombwa mu mikorere ya seriveri. Ibimenyetso by'ubuyobozi byashyizwe ahagaragara bishingiye ku mashusho; koresha inzira z'ubucuruzi.

data.name: Content.046758F1CA21BD9F666A
data.value:
Koresha uru rupapuro kugira ngo ukore seriveri yawe ya mbere. Synix irabikoresha kuri iyi PC, bityo komeza gukoresha iyo PC mu gihe abantu barimo bakina. Si ngombwa ko wandika itegeko ryo gutangiza kugira ngo ushyireho gahunda isanzwe.
1. Fungura Synix maze ureke ikoranabuhanga ryo kureba niba SteamCMD ihuje n'ibyo ikora. 2. Hitamo Add Server, hanyuma ushyireho seriveri nshya. Niba dosiye za seriveri zirahari, hitamo Import Existing Server. 3. Muri General, andika izina ry'igisonga cyihariye maze uhitemo umukino. Hitamo iyo videwo, verisiyo y'umukino cyangwa uburyo bwo kuyishyiraho. 4. Jya ukomeza gukurikiza amahame yatanzwe, keretse niba hari ikindi ukeneye. Reba amapaji y'igishushanyo ashyirwa mu bikorwa maze ushakishe ubutumwa busobanutse neza bw'igishushanyo gikenewe munsi. 5. Hitamo Save Server. Ibyo byongeraho inyandiko kuri dashboard; ntibishatse kuvuga ko umukino warangiye gushyirwaho. 6. Hitamo iyo nyandiko maze uhitemo gutangira. Jya wemera ko gukuramo no gutangira gutegura birangira, ukurikije ibyo Synix igaragaza. 7. Kurangiza gahunda iyo ari yo yose igenewe umukino, urugero nk'isezerano, kwiyandikisha kuri konti, cyangwa kurema icyiciro muri interineti yayo. 8. Jya wifatanya na bo ukoresheje orudinateri cyangwa ikindi gikoresho cyo mu rugo rwawe. Iyo ibyo bimaze gukorwa, kora kopi y'ibikoresho byawe mbere yo kubishyiraho cyangwa kugira ibyo uhindura mu buryo bukomeye.
Uramutse ubabaye Fungura witeguye kuri seriveri yatoranyijwe maze usome Activity & Diagnostics. Jya ukurikiza ikosa ryihariye aho guhita ukanda ku gitekerezo cyo gutangira. Ku bijyanye na Minecraft cyangwa Satisfactory, mu cyiciro cy'abashakashatsi b'imikino hasobanurwa intambwe z'inyongera.
Gucumbikira abantu hanze y'urubuga rwawe ni intambwe itandukanye yo gushyikirana. Mbere na mbere, ujye wemeza ko seriveri ikora mu karere k'iwawe.

data.name: Content.04A9AB215D19FA573345
data.value:
Buri nyandiko y'ibikoresho igomba kuba ifite izina ryayo bwite n'inkoramutima yo kuyishyiramo. Synix ihindura izina rya seriveri mu kimenyetso cyirinda Windows kugirango dosiye n'imiterere yo gutangiza byemezwe. Ibi bigatuma imimerere itandukanye n'uburyo bwo gusangira dosiye bitari ngombwa; si imashini igendanwa cyangwa umupaka w'umutekano.
IBIHAMBA by'ibanze • C:\Synix ?? urwego rukuru rw'akazi rw'amakuru ya Synix. • C:\Synix\SteamCMD ?? downloader y'umukino usanzwe. • C:\Synix\Games\<umukino>\<server> ?? imikorere isanzwe ya seriveri. • C:\Synix\BackupGames ?? Umuzi w'ibanze. • C:\Synix\SynixData\logs ?? inyandiko z'ibyifuzo n'inkuru zivuga iby'impanuka.
Imyandikire y'ibikoresho bya MSI ubusanzwe iri munsi ya %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. Ibisabwa bimwe na bimwe n'ibiciro birindwa na Windows nabyo ni ibya konti yawe ya Windows.
UBUGENGE bw'Abaturage Koresha Install & Launch mu gihe uhitamo dosiye ya seriveri. Kugira ngo ushyireho ikintu gishya, hitamo dosiye yoroheje ishobora kwandikwa irimo umwanya uhagije wo gukina no kuvugurura. Ntukerekeze imyirondoro ibiri mu gitabo kimwe.
Akabumbano ka Open Server kagaragaza aho seriveri yatoranyijwe iri. Open Backup Folder igaragaza aho backup iri; ntukagire icyo utekereza ku nzira iyo ari yo yose ukurikije izina ryayo.
ABANTU bashobora kubaho ahandi hantu Umukino ushobora kubika isi muri AppData, Documents, indi diski cyangwa muri sisitemu yayo yo gushyiraho. Jya ubanza wemeze aho umukino uri mbere yo kuwukomeza cyangwa kuwuhindura.
Guhindura amazina cyangwa kwimura impapuro muri File Explorer ntibihamya ko inzira zose zanditswe zizasubirwamo. Koresha inzira yo kwinjiza / kohereza zashizweho na Synix no gusuzuma inzira mbere y'itangira rikurikira. Ibikorwa bitandukanye na byo bikenera ibyumba by'umurongo bidashyamirana.

data.name: Content.0AD494C5598090AE9CCD
data.value: Space Engineers ikoresha Umuyobozi wa Seriveri yihariye, Synix igomba kuboneka. Igihe ubanza gufungura, hitamo Local/Console, hitamo Continue to server configuration, winjize imiterere ya seriveri n'isi, hanyuma uhitemo Save & start. Jya ukoresha manager kugira ngo ubone imiterere y'ibikoresho, isi, mod, abayobozi n'igikoresho cyayo. Synix ibika iyi nkuru munsi y'inkoramutima ya Instance ya seriveri. Uburyo bwa mbere Local/Console ntibukeneye uburenganzira bw'abayobozi; kurema serivisi ya Windows nibyo. Ibisabwa ku mugaragaro ni .NET Framework 4.8 cyangwa nshya, Visual C ++ Redistributable 2013 na 2017, nibura 6 GB ya sisitemu RAM, na UDP porote 27016 yemerewe binyuze kuri Firewall ya Windows kandi yoherezwa imbere muri router kubakinyi ba interineti. Ubuyobozi bwemewe: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.0B2D550B207DD25F9B2D
data.value:
Umurinda agenzura imikorere y'abakozi bamenyekanye kandi ashobora gutangiza kuvugurura byateguwe nyuma yo kuva mu buryo butunguranye cyangwa ikibazo cyabonetse.
GUKORERA mu buryo busanzwe Koresha uburyo bwo guhagarika no kongera gutangiza bwa Synix kugira ngo uhindure ibintu ku bushake. Synix ihuza ibyo bikorwa n'urwego rushinzwe kugenzura kugira ngo guhagarikwa kwasabwe kutitabwaho nk'impanuka.
Gufunga idirishya ry'umukino, kuryica muri Task Manager, cyangwa kuryihagarika binyuze ku wundi muyobozi bishobora gusa n'aho bitunguranye maze bigatuma usubiraho.
IGIHUNGU cyongeye gutangira Jya uhagarika seriveri ukoresheje Synix, hanyuma usuzume inyandiko y'umukino. Gukemura ikibazo cy'igihe cyo gukoreramo, uburyo bwo gutangiza, icyambu, kwibuka cyangwa mod mbere yo kongera kugitangira. Gusubiza ntibishobora gukemura mod idashyize mu bikorwa cyangwa imishinga y'umukino itararangira.
Iyo habayeho ikibazo cy'umushinga n'iyo ikibazo kitabonetse, biba bitandukanye. Igihe cyo gukira gihagaze ku mukino n'imimerere urimo, bityo ntukagire igihe cyo gusuzuma buri gihe.
IBIGANIRO Synix ikurikirana abaterura bashyigikiwe n'ibikorwa by'abana bigize seriveri. Imashini zigenzurwa mu buryo bw'ibanze cyangwa serivisi zo gushyirwa mu bikorwa zishobora kurenza igihe cyo gutangiza kandi zikeneye kugenzurwa n'umukino.
Imbwa y'urwego rwo kurinda ntabwo isimbura ibyangombwa byemejwe cyangwa kureba seriveri iherutse guhindurwa mugihe cyayo cya mbere gitangiye neza.

data.name: Content.0D2E92094CEB8EC48551
data.value:
Jya ukoresha imashini z'ubuzima za Synix mu gukora seriveri nk'uko bisanzwe. Ibyo bituma umurinzi abona itandukaniro riri hagati yo guhagarika umuntu ku bushake n'impanuka.
GUTEGURA Hitamo inyandiko hanyuma uhitemo Gutangira rimwe. Synix ireba ibisabwa mbere y'igihe, inzira, imigi, n'itumanaho ryatoranyijwe mbere yo gutangira, irategura dosiye zitemewe zibuze, kandi itangiza seriveri. Tegereza uko bizagenda mbere yo kongera kugerageza.
Jya uhagarara Hitamo Stop maze uhe umwanya umukino wo kubika no gufunga. Synix ikoresha guhagarika neza gushyigikiwe aho bihari, hanyuma igatangiza imikorere mu buryo bw'ibice runaka iyo bibaye ngombwa. Guhagarika akazi ku gahato bishobora gutuma umuntu atagira icyo ageraho.
GUSUBIRA Hitamo gutangiza bundi bushya kugira ngo uhagarike itsinda ry'imihango ririho ubu maze utangire igikorwa gishya. Mu gihe ibyo bibaye, ntugatange ikindi gitabo.
Niba udashobora kubona buto Hari ikindi gikorwa gishobora kuba cyaramaze gutwara seriveri, inyandiko ishobora kuba iri mu cyiciro cy'ihindagurika, cyangwa uwo mukino ushobora gukoresha imikorere yo hanze. Soma ubutumwa bw'ibikorwa n'ubushobozi bwa porogaramu.
Irinde kwica seriveri muri Task Manager cyangwa kuyihagarika ku gikoresho kidafite aho gihuriye n'ibikorwa bisanzwe byo kwitaho. Ibyo bishobora gusa n'aho ari iherezo ritari ryitezwe kandi bigatuma umuntu akira.
Imikino ikoreshwa hakoreshejwe imashini zigendanwa cyangwa serivisi zo gushyirwamo hanze zikeneye igenzura ry'ubuzima bwazo bwite. Gufunga icyuma cyo kurasa ntibigaragaza ko izo serivisi zahagaritswe.

data.name: Content.14E361A374F9F14F65DD
data.value:
Satisfactory igomba gushyirwaho bwa mbere muri Server Manager yayo yo mu mukino. Synix irashobora gushyiraho no gutangiza seriveri yihariye, ariko ntabwo isimbura gusaba seriveri cyangwa kurema session yayo.
Jya urangiza umukino 1. Kora inyandiko ya Satisfactory hanyuma uyitange muri Synix. 2. Reka dutegereze ko seriveri yihariye irangiza gupakira. 3. Fungura Server Manager ya Satisfactory mu mukino maze wongere cyangwa uhitemo seriveri. 4. Jya uyisaba, shyiraho ijambo ry'ibanga ry'umuyobozi, maze wiyandikishe nk'umuyobozi. 5. Kora cyangwa utange porogaramu wifuza gukoresha.
Synix igenzura ibiciro byo gutangiza/gushushanya byashizweho, harimo icyambu cyo gutangiza na MaxPlayers. Ibikoresho bikoreshwa biri munsi ya FactoryGame\Saved\Config\WindowsServer.
SYNIX yo guhuza 1. Komeza seriveri ikorana na -NewConsole. Check inyandiko zinjijwe cyangwa za kera; niba wongeyeho icyo gitekerezo, ongera ukoreshe Synix. 2. Koresha urwego rumwe rw'uruhushya rwa Windows kuri Synix na seriveri, byaba byiza uruhushya rusanzwe rw'umukoresha. 3. Hitamo seriveri maze ufungure Amahitamo ya seriveri → Satisfactory Ikigo cy'ubugenzuzi → Fatanisha API. 4. Hitamo Connect byikora rimwe hanyuma utegereze.
Synix yohereza server.GenerateAPIToken, asoma amakuru mashya yuzuye, agenzura API yo mu gace k'iwawe, kandi akiza ikimenyetso cyashyizwe kuri konti yawe ya Windows. Icyo kimenyetso gitanga uburenganzira bwo kuyobora, si ukurebera gusa.
Raporo z'ibyagezweho Ikimenyetso cyemejwe kandi kizigama mu buryo bwitondewe hanyuma gifungura Isesengura. Si ngombwa ko wandika umurongo w'ibikoresho cyangwa ngo ushyireho icyapa.
Iyo kugerageza kunanirwa, Synix ikomeza konti zose zari zaranditswe mbere kandi ntizongera kugerageza itegeko. Soma uko byagenze mbere yo kongera kugerageza.
Ibi bihuza na seriveri yatoranyijwe kuri iyi PC; si ngombwa ko hashyirwaho itegeko rishya ry'umuyoboro wa Synix. Intangiriro isanzwe, guhagarika no kongera gutangiza bikora nta tandukaniro rya API.

data.name: Content.1734B5184A8732EBE5C7
data.value:
Hitamo inyandiko yo mu kabati maze ufungure Amahitamo ya seriveri. Ibikoresho bishyigikiwe gusa n'iyo porogaramu n'imimerere yayo muri iki gihe ni byo byonyine bitangwa.
INKURU N'UBUGENZI • Ibaruramari rya Open Server na Open Backup Folder rifungura imyanya ikora. • Umuhuzabikorwa w'imiterere y'umukino afungura dosiye z'imiterere y'umukino ushyigikiwe. • Update Server ikuramo amakuru y'umukino ushyigikiwe. • Gushyira mu bikorwa igenzura ry'ibikoresho by'imikino cyangwa gusana ibikoresho bigenzurwa n'ishyirahamwe. • Backup and Restore: Gukuraho cyangwa kugarura ibikoresho byatoranyijwe. • Kurema dosiye ya batch yohereje inyandiko yo gutangiza igihe imyirondoro ishyigikiye. • Delete ivanaho inyandiko kandi igatanga gusa amahitamo yo kuvanaho dosiye agaragajwe mu cyemezo cyayo.
IBYUMVIRISHO N'Ibikoresho by'imikino Amakuru y'imikorere yerekana aderesi, ibyambu n'ibikorwa byo gukoporora. Ibigeragezo byo guhuza, Mod & Plugin Manager, ibikoresho bya Minecraft, na Satisfactory Control Center bigaragara aho byashyigikiwe.
KUREBA umugaragu urimo yiruka Kanda inshuro ebyiri ku murongo wayo kugira ngo umenye amakuru y'umukoresha. Ibirebana n'imikorere ya Live Process Details bigaragaza ibishushanyo byashyizweho, abakoresha console, n'imiyoborere y'abakozi baba muri iyo nyandiko. Umukino wa multi-process ushobora kuba ufite ID y'imikorere irenze imwe.
Jya ukoresha imbonerahamwe y'ibikoresho kugira ngo usuzume CPU ya seriveri n'amateka yo kwibuka. Ibyo bisobanuro bitandukanye n'ibikubiye mu nkuru y'imikorere ya PC yose iri kuri dashboard.
Gufunga idirishya rigenzura ibintu cyangwa rigenzura umutungo ntibibuza umukino guhagarara. Jya ukoresha uburyo bwo guhagarika mu gihe wifuza gukora ibintu nk'ibyo.

data.name: Content.18D0D93C3EB881DA2D03
data.value:
Hitamo inyandiko ya Minecraft mbere yo guhitamo mod cyangwa imiterere yo guhuza. Java na Bedrock ni ubwoko bwa seriveri butandukanye; Bedrock ntabwo ari umutwaro wa Java.
Gushyiraho seriveri 1. Kora inyandiko ya Minecraft hanyuma uhitemo Java cyangwa Bedrock. 2. Kuri Java, hitamo verisiyo ya Minecraft, loader, na verisiyo ihuriye na loader itangwa n'abahitamo. 3. Reba isi, imikorere y'umukino, imipaka y'umukinnyi, ubushobozi bwo kwibuka, ibyambu n'ubushobozi bwo kurinda. 4. Kurinda no gutangira ukoresheje Synix. 5. Jya usoma amasezerano yose cyangwa utangire kuyatanga mbere yo kuyemera. 6. Jya utegereza ko isi irangiza kwinjiza, hanyuma wifatanye n'igitabo gihuje n'icyifuzo cy'umukiriya. 7. Jya ushyigikira gahunda y'akazi mbere yo kongeramo mod.
Java na BEDROCK Java harimo Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Paper, na Purpur aho inyubako ziboneka. Jya ukoresha verisiyo maze ushyireho amahitamo; Paper na Purpur zikoresha plugins, mugihe Fabric, Forge, na NeoForge zikoresha mod zazo zihuye. Synix ikuramo igihe cyo gukora cyatoranyijwe ku muyoboro wayo wemewe.
Bedrock ikoresha seriveri yihariye ya Bedrock yemewe kandi ntabwo ikoresha Java.
JYA WIKURIKIRA imimerere Jya uhitamo imikorere y'ibikoresho byawe. Ujye uhura na Minecraft version, loader, dependencies, n'ibisabwa ku ruhande rw'umukiriya.
Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, hamwe na plugin-server ibikoresho ntabwo bivugururwa. Kurema dosiye ya mods cyangwa plugins ntabwo bishyiraho uburyo bukenewe bwo gupakira cyangwa seriveri. Gusuzuma Catalog si modpack ikorana n'umuntu ku giti cye.
GUTEGURWA Gutegura bigenzura server.properties n'ibishushanyo bidasanzwe. Java kandi itanga uburyo bwa Spectator. Ibipimo n'amabwiriza by'ikoranabuhanga bikomeza kuba nk'uko Minecraft ibyifuza.
Uhereye kuri Server Options, fungura Minecraft Control Center. Urupapuro rwayo rw'ibikoresho ruratanga urutonde rw'ibikoresho by'imikorere bya seriveri bishobora guhindurwa. Gutegura dosiye itanga gutunganya inyandiko; Umuhuzabikorwa ushinzwe gutanga umwanditsi uzi imiterere iriho. Byombi bigeza ku mpinduka mugihe seriveri ihagaritswe. Ibiciro bizwi bya server.properties nk'ibibuga, imipaka y'umukinnyi, isi, imbuto, uburyo, n'ibishushanyo by'umuyoboro w'amabwiriza nabyo bisubiramo inyandiko ya Synix yabitswe. Izina ryatangajwe/MOTD ritandukanye n'izina ry'inyandiko y'imbere mu gihugu. Imikorere y'imikorere itamenyekanye iguma mu mafayili yayo bwite.
Synix isubiramo aya mabwiriza mbere yo guhindura inyandiko cyangwa kuyitangira, kandi iyo Refresh ikoreshwa mugihe ihagaritswe. Niba ihindura ry'inyuma ritemewe cyangwa rikagendana n'ikindi gitabo, koresha ikibazo cyiswe aho gutangira seriveri kenshi. Umwanditsi yanze kwandika dosiye yarahindutse kuva yafunguwe; jya usubiraho kugira ngo ushyireho ibintu bishya.
IGIHE umukozi wa seriveri yakoraga Jya ukora kopi yuzuye ya seriveri mbere yo guhindura verisiyo cyangwa ibyuma byo gupakira. Hitamo igihe gishya cyo gutangiza mu Gushyiraho, gukiza inyandiko yasubiwemo, hanyuma uhitemo Gushyiraho igihe cyo gutangiza muri Minecraft Control Center. Synix itegura igihe cy'imikorere ku giti cyawe, ikomeza kubika dosiye z'igihe cy'imikorere ya server.properties n'ibitabo by'isi, kandi ikandika dosiye z'igihe cy'imikorere yasubiwemo. Iyo porogaramu ntishyiraho seriveri. Gutangiza birabujijwe mugihe igihe cyo gukora cyafashwe n'umwirondoro watoranijwe bidahuje.
Gusubiza dosiye inyuma ntibigena impinduka z'isi zakozwe nyuma y'uko seriveri itangiye. Ntuzigere utekereza ko isi ifunguwe na Minecraft nshya cyangwa imikorere itandukanye ishobora gupakirwa neza n'igihe cy'igikorwa cya kera; Jya ushakisha ibikoresho by'inyongera bihuye n'ibyo.
Irinde mbere yo guhindura dosiye zikeneye kongera gutangizwa. Ntusimbure isi iriho n'igishushanyo gishya nk'umuvuduko wo kuvugurura.
Niba abakinnyi badashobora kwifatanya Reba inyandiko, verisiyo z'umukino/umujyanama, imikorere ikenewe, n'umudendezo nyawo w'inyandiko yatoranijwe. Kugira ngo usohoke hakiri kare, jya usuzuma inyandiko y'umukino kugira ngo urebe niba hari amakosa mu masezerano, igihe cyo gukora, kwibuka cyangwa kuba umuntu yarashinze imizi.

data.name: Content.29DD837D20479ABA0D1B
data.value:
Fungura ikigo cy'ubugenzuzi cya Satisfactory nyuma yo guhuza API yo mu karere. Hitamo akabaruwa k'icyo ukeneye gukora.
Ibisobanuro by'ibanze Hitamo Refresh kugira ngo usome izina ry'ikiganiro, umubare w'abakinnyi bafunze/igice cyabo, uko umukino uhagaze, umuvuduko w'igiciro cy'umukino, igihe cyo gukina n'urwego rw'ikoranabuhanga.
Umukinnyi wa dashboard azajya ahindura amakuru mu buryo bwikora mugihe umuyoboro ufite ubuzima bwiza; Ifoto y'ibikoresho by'ubwubatsi Iyi API itanga imibare, si urutonde rw'abakinnyi bafite amazina. Gucika intege cyangwa kuba umukozi ategereje ko hagira icyakorwa, si igikorwa gihagaritswe.
Imikorere y'abakozi Hitamo Gusubiza, uhindure indangagaciro zifashishwa, hanyuma ushyireho impinduka. Ongera usuzume ibipimo bikiriho nyuma yo kuvugurura. Bimwe mu byemezo bisaba kongera gutangira; Gushyiraho impinduka ntibituma umukino wongera gutangira.
Gushyira imfunguzo n'ibiciro byemewe bikomeza kuba mu rurimi rw'imikino.
Imikino yarokowe • Uhereye ubu: Andika izina cyangwa ukoreshe izina rya Synix ryashyizweho. Kwongera gukoresha izina rishobora gusenya igicuruzwa gihari. • Umutwaro watoranyijwe: Reba icyo cyemezo. Synix ibika intambwe z'igihe cya mbere mugihe iseseshoni ikora; Kwishyurira bishobora gutema abakinnyi. • Kwimuriraho igicuruzwa: Yongeraho dosiye yatoranyijwe kandi ishobora gusimbura igicuruzwa gifite izina rimwe. Ntitubishyira mu buryo bwikora. • Gukuramo ibitabo by'imfashanyigisho za Bibiliya byatoranyijwe: Binyujije ku murongo wo mu karere wahisemo.
Jya ushyiraho ingabo z'inyongera mbere yo gusimbuza cyangwa kwinjiza ibintu by'ingenzi mu isi. Gahunda yo kwishyura ifite imipaka y'umutekano 512 MB. API ishobora kuba itaboneka by'agateganyo mu gihe cy'imibonano.
INKURU y'Ikirenga Kohereza umurongo w'umukino umwe ku gihe maze usome ibyemeza. Ibitabo byanditse, amategeko y'ibimenyetso n'amagambo y'ibanga, hamwe n'amavugurura y'uruhare adafite umutekano birabuzanyijwe hano.
Amategeko yo guhagarika ashyigikiwe agenzurwa binyuze mu gikorwa cyo guhagarika cya Synix. Igikorwa cyo gutanga itegeko kiguma muri iyi idirishya aho gushyirwa kuri dashboard cyangwa mu nyandiko z'inyandiko Synix; Umukino ushobora no kwandika inyandiko zawo.

data.name: Content.29E9D2F428F5E2BA4705
data.value: Umushakashatsi agaragaza dosiye z'ibikoresho bya plugin ku bikoresho by'ububiko bya seriveri ya Java. Ibitabo bya none n'ibya kera bikoresha API zitandukanye; koresha inyandiko n'uburyo bwa plugin byashyizweho mbere yo gukoresha aho ugiye.

data.name: Content.2B0EFE8DBC3E9BEC09E3
data.value:
Imikino yo mu mikino myinshi ishobora gukenerwa:
Synix ishyiraho porogaramu ya seriveri yihariye ariko ntishobora gukuramo, gukoporora cyangwa kongera gukwirakwiza dosiye zifite uruhushya ku mukino usanzwe. Niba seriveri ivuga ko ibikoresho bya multi-player byabuze cyangwa ko byaguye mugihe ushyiraho cyangwa uhindura amakarita, shyira Dark Messiah of Might & Magic Multiplayer ukoresheje Steam ukoresheje konti uyifite. Andika ibikubiye muri mpsrc multiplayer kuva kuri iyo game installation muri iyi folder ya dedicated-server, kandi urebe neza ko mapcycle.txt na maplist.txt bikubiyemo amakarita wifuza gukora.
Iyi ntambwe igomba gukorwa n'umukoresha ushyiraho seriveri. Imikino yo mu bwoko bwa 0 Deathmatch, 1 Team Deathmatch, 2 Crusade, 3 Capture the Flag, na 4 Colosseum.

data.value: Bisaba uburyo buhuza Metamod:Source na SourceMod yubatse kuri iyi verisiyo ya seriveri. Ibikoresho bya .smx byatunganijwe bigenda muri tf/addons/sourcemod/plugins; inyandiko z'ubuhinduzi, amakuru y'imikino n'inyongera biherekejwe na byo bigumana imiterere yabyo.

data.name: Content.2B637CF2169F0AD865CF
data.value:
Soma umusaruro wa Connect mu buryo bwikora mbere yo kongera kugerageza. Hari itegeko rigaragara mu gikoresho cy'imikino ritagaragaza ko gufata ibimenyetso, kubigenzura no kubikomeza byose byagenze neza.
REBA uko byagenze • Ikoranabuhanga ntiriboneka: Tegura ko -NewConsole, seriveri yatoranyijwe, n'ibipimo byemewe na Windows bihuye. • Itegeko ritararangira mu mwandiko: Jya urikuraho. Synix ntishobora kubirengagiza. • Amategeko arakora ariko nta kimenyetso na kimwe gifatwa: Reka gutangiza irangize, ugenzure inyandiko z'imikino zishobora kwandikwa, kandi wemere ko ibintu byose bishya biturukaho bigera. • Indangururamajwi: Shyiraho indangururamajwi zisa n'izisanzwe, maze ureke igikoresho gikorerwamo imibonano mpuzabitsina cyitabire. • Icyambu cya API gifitwe n'ikindi gikorwa: Gukosora icyambu cy'umukino cyashyizweho na seriveri yatoranijwe. Ntukoherereze ikimenyetso cyacyo ku muntu utari incuti yawe. • Ikimenyetso cyanze cyangwa konti yazigamye ntishobora gukingurwa: Shyiraho igikinisho cyuzuye, hanyuma usubire kugirana nacyo. • API ntiriho: Tegereza igihe cyo gutangiza cyangwa gukiza kuzamura maze usuzume inyandiko y'umukino.
Igisubizo gishya gishobora kuba gifite agaciro kamwe n'igisubizo cya mbere. Gufata akoresha umusaruro utangwa nyuma y'iryo tegeko, si ikimenyetso cya kera mu nyandiko.
GUKingira cyangwa gukuraho uburyo bwo kubona amakuru Satisfactory icapa ibimenyetso by'umuyobozi muri konsili yayo bwite no mu nyandiko zayo. Jya ubishyira mu kinyabupfura maze ukureho imirongo y'ibimenyetso mu mashusho n'inkuru.
Synix iragenzura ko iherezo ry'aho ryiherereye rifitwe na seriveri yatoranijwe maze ikandika icyangombwa cyayo. Ntukemere ko ibizamini by'ibyangombwa bihagarikwa kugira ngo ukemure ikibazo cy'ikosa.
Gukuraho ikinyabiziga cyihariye cya Synix; si byo bivanaho icyo kimenyetso kuri seriveri.
Kugira ngo ukureho ibimenyetso bya porogaramu biriho, koresha server.InvalidateAPITokens muri console ya seriveri bwite ya Satisfactory cyangwa console ya Manager ya Server. Ibyo bigira ingaruka no ku bindi bikorwa by'ubufatanye bikoresha ibyo bimenyetso.
Ku wundi konti ya Windows cyangwa icyuma cyimuriweho, kongera guhuza niba konti ikingiwe idashobora gukoreshwa.

data.name: Content.2E2BBD89AFEC2FD2B678
data.value:
Soma inkuru z'ibikorwa bya vuba n'imikino byakozwe kuri seriveri yatoranyijwe. Jya ushakisha ikosa rya mbere aho gushaka gusa ubutumwa bwa nyuma.
GUTEGEKA cyangwa GUTEGEKA hakiri kare 1. Jya ugenzura dosiye y'igishushanyo cyatoranijwe, ikoreshwa, igitabo cy'umukino, n'igicuruzwa. 2. Reba dosiye zisabwa, umwanya wa RAM / diski y'ubuntu, n'ibibuga byakorerwamo imirimo. 3. Jya wuzuza amasezerano yose, kwandikisha konti, icyifuzo cy'ikimenyetso, cyangwa gahunda y'ikoraniro ryo mu mukino. 4. Ku birebana n'imikorere y'umukino, gereranya umukino, umukoresha, ibyo ukeneye n'ibyo umukiriya akeneye. 5. Jya usuzuma Synix mbere yo guhindura dosiye, hanyuma ugerageze gutangira.
Iyo seriveri y'ukuri yananiwe, ushobora gukomeza gutangiza ubwo butumwa. Seriveri ifite ubuzima bwiza ishobora no kuba itegereje koherezwa ku isi cyangwa ikagira ikibazo kitariho / API. Jya usuzuma ibyo bihugu ku giti cyawe.
GUTEGEKA Cyangwa GUSUBIRA HASHIZE IGIHE Imikino ikenera igihe kugira ngo abantu bakomeze gukora imirimo. Jya utegereza ibyavuye muri Synix maze usome ubutumwa buvuga ko yahagaritswe. Iyo umuntu ahindutse, ashobora gutakaza amajyambere atarakizwa.
Ntukwice imikorere icyarimwe, ntutange kopi yindi, cyangwa ngo ukoreshe umuyobozi wundi mu guhangana n'ishusho imwe.
Ibikoresho cyangwa ibikoresho birabuze Suzuma ubushobozi bwa porogaramu n'imimerere yayo. Hari ibintu bimwe na bimwe bibujijwe kubera ko umukino ubikoresha cyangwa nta nzira yo gucunga ikoreshwa. N/A player data si automatically a server failure.
Niba icyo kibazo gikomeje kubaho, ujye wandika icyo wakoze, ikosa ryuzuye n'igice kigufi cy'urwandiko rw'ibyabaye mbere yo kugira ibindi uhindura.

data.name: Content.3111DCC7482FEADC74FC
data.value:
JYA KWIHATIRIRA MODPACK y' seriveri cyangwa uyivugurure 1. Kora kopi y'ibikoresho byose bya seriveri maze uhagarike seriveri. Koresha Synix ufite uburenganzira busanzwe bwa Windows. 2. Shyiraho no gushyiraho verisiyo y'ibikoresho bya Minecraft, igicuruzwa n'igicuruzwa cya mbere. 3. Muri Minecraft Control Center → Mods & Plugins, hitamo Import Server Pack. Hitamo Modrinth .mrpack cyangwa seriveri yuzuye ya ZIP irimo mod/plugins nyayo na dosiye zo gutangiza. 4. Uburyo bw'ibikoresho bya seriveri bufatika burarengagizwa keretse niba hari uburyo bw'ibikoresho by'ibikoresho bya seriveri byihitirwamo. Modrinth inyandiko z'abakiliya gusa n'ibisobanuro by'abakiliya ntabwo byinjizwa. 5. Jya usuzuma ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi bwakozwe, urebe uko metadata yagiye igaragara, urebe ibikubiye mu byo utabonye, n'ibikoresho byose bigomba kongerwaho, gusimbuzwa cyangwa gukurwaho. Wemeze gusa niba isoko n'impinduka ari ngombwa. 6. Tangira gukora imikorere yawe ukimara kuyishyiraho, soma igikoresho cy'ubufasha maze ugerageze ko umuyoboro w'umukiriya uhuje n'ibyo wifuza.
Umwinjizi ntakora inyandiko zo gutangiza zitangwa muri paketi, gusimbuza isi, cyangwa gusenya root server.properties. Kuramo seriveri yuzuye y'umwanditsi niba client ya CurseForge yoherejwe hanze irimo inyandiko yo gukuramo gusa. Ibikoresho byo gukuramo ku giti cyabyo, host zitashyigikiwe, cyangwa ibikoresho byo gutwara bidashyigikiwe bikenera dosiye z'umwanditsi zifashishwa na seriveri; Synix ntabwo irenga ku bihano byatanzwe n'abatanga ibicuruzwa.
Modrinth downloads zashyizweho hash-check. Metadata ya JAR ishyigikiwe iragenzurwa kugirango ibyangombwa bikorwe, umwirondoro wumukiriya gusa, ID duplicate, n'ubushakashatsi bwagaragajwe nta JAR ikorwamo. Ibiranga metadata zitamenyekanye n'ibipimo by'amashusho bigoye bisaba gusuzuma. Gusuzuma neza cyangwa kubura amakimbirane yagaragajwe ntibihamya ko mod ifite umutekano cyangwa ko ihuje n'amategeko. Ibikoresho byabuze ntibishobora gukurwaho mu cyubahiro.
Kwongera kwinjiza pakiti imwe ifite izina rishobora gukuraho JAR zayo zari zarateganyijwe mbere zitakiriho, ariko gusa iyo izo dosiye zikiri guhura na hashes yazo zafashwe. JAR n'ibikoresho by'isi bidakoreshwa ntibishobora gukurwaho. Amashusho y'ibikoresho byatanzwe n'igiteranyo gishya ashobora gusimbuza amashusho ya kera; Ibaruwa y'ibanze irabereka mbere yo kubemeza. Komeza izina rya dosiye ya seriveri-ZIP iyo uherutse kuvugurura ako kantu kugira ngo kamenyekane ko ari kamwe.
UBUGENGE bw'isi yose Jya ukoresha Worlds kugira ngo ushyire urutonde rw'isi zizwi. Jya ucuruza inyandiko ya ZIP y'isi imwe ihuriye n'iyi, uyishyiremo amazina mashya; ntabwo yandika ku isi iriho cyangwa ngo ihindure hagati ya Java na Bedrock. Hitamo isi ishyizweho hanyuma ukore isi kugirango uhindure izina ry'urwego n'imiterere y'isi ya Synix hamwe. Igitangira gikurikiraho ni cyo kizatuma isi yatoranijwe irushaho kuba nziza. Guhindura imbuto bigira ingaruka ku isi nshya, aho kugira ngo bigire ingaruka ku butaka bwariho.
GUSUBIRA Gusubizaho urutonde rw'ibyahindutse muri dosiye zakozwe n'iki cyumba cy'akazi. Undo isubukura dosiye za kera zanditswe cyangwa igavanaho dosiye zatangijwe n'iryo hinduka. Jya kure y'isi y'ibikoresho byinjijwe mbere yo kuvanaho ibyo byinjijwe. Niba dosiye zashyizweho nyuma, Synix yanze kuzishyira hejuru; koroshya ibyo wahinduye kandi ukoreshe ububiko bwuzuye bwujuje ibisabwa niba ari ngombwa.
Igikorwa cyo kugarura kiri mu gihe cy'ubugoryi gitangiye kugeza igihe igisubizo kirangiriye kandi inyandiko yandikishijwe intoki ihuje n'ibikoresho byasubijwe. Ibikoresho bya kera bidafite umwirondoro wa runtime byanditse bisaba ko habaho ububiko bwuzuye bwo kugarura runtime. Ibikoresho by'ububiko biracyari ibikoresho by'ububiko bwuzuye bya seriveri, bititaye ku nyandiko z'impinduka.
Nyuma yo gusubizaho ububiko bwuzuye, inyandiko za kera z'ihinduka ry'imyanya y'akazi zigaragazwa ko zasimbuwe na bwo. Izo nyandiko zikomeza kugaragara kugira ngo zibonekere, ariko ntizishobora gukurwaho mu gihe zigaruriwe. Kwinjiza cyangwa guhindura ibikubiyemo nyuma yo gusubizaho bituma habaho inyandiko nshya zo kugarura.
INKURU N'IBIGENGE Ibaruramari ry'ibimenyetso ryerekana ibibazo bya Java bikunze kugaragara, kwibuka, guhohoterwa, icyambu, isi n'igihe cyo gukora. Nta kintu na kimwe kibonetse kitagaragaza ko seriveri ifite amagara mazima. Ibikorwa byugurura monitor y'ibikoresho; Ibipimo bya CPU na RAM ntabwo bisimbura imiterere y'imikino.
Urutonde rw'ibihe rufungura imiterere ya Synix yo kongera gutangiza no gukora imirimo. Hitamo iminsi wifuza, igihe wifuza, imyitwarire yo gutegereza umukinnyi, uburyo bwo kubika no kuvugurura, hanyuma usuzume maze ubike. Mu mwanya w'akazi, nta gahunda y'umunsi wa kabiri ibaho cyangwa ngo ihindure gahunda yawe mu buryo bwikora.

data.name: Content.34AD8EEA90B225512F6F
data.value:
Hitamo seriveri Minecraft, noneho fungura Seriveri Amahitamo → Minecraft Ikigo cy'ubugenzuzi. Urubuga rwa Console n'urw'abakinnyi rutuma ibikoresho by'ubuyobozi n'iby'umukinnyi bifatanya. Andi mapaji atanga imiterere, imibereho y'isi, ibindi bikoresho by'inyongera, ububiko bw'ibikoresho bya seriveri yuzuye, igenamigambi ryo gutangiza bundi bushya, gukira no gusuzuma indwara.
INYARUZI Z'IBIBAZO Amashusho ashyigikiwe arashobora gukoresha ikoranabuhanga rigenzurwa na Synix, umuyoboro ushinzwe gucunga localhost ushyigikiwe, cyangwa RCON y'amahitamo. Ikirere kiriho giterwa n'igitabo n'imiterere ya seriveri.
Ikirango cy'umunyamahanga cyihishe gishobora gukomeza gutuma umuyoboro w'ubuyobozi bwo mu karere ushyigikiwe ugaragara. Niba ibyo kugenzura bidafite ubushobozi, ujye ureba niba seriveri ikora kandi niba imiterere yo kuyobora ifite agaciro.
INKURU ZITEGURIRWA Iyo byemejwe, Synix itanga amatangazo, urutonde rw'abakinnyi, guhuza, guhinduka kw'umukoresha n'abemerewe, kugenzura igihe / ikirere, no kubika.
Hitamo umukinnyi wifuza gukina maze usome icyo gikorwa mbere yo kugikomeza. Gutanga umukozi uburenganzira bwo kwinjira muri iyo mikino bituma haboneka uburenganzira bw'umukino. Ntukabikore kugira ngo ukemure ikibazo cy'imishyikirano gusa.
IBIGANIRO BIKURU Jya ukoresha imvugo y'umwimerere igomba gukoreshwa muri iyo gazeti. Amategeko nka list na save-all ni inguzanyo yumukino kandi ntabwo ahindurwa n'interface ya Synix. Mbere yo kohereza itegeko rihindura isi cyangwa uburenganzira, ujye ureba amategeko y'iryo shuri.
ABANTU n'ABAHINDI Ikibazo gishobora gutanga umubare w'abakinnyi badafite urutonde rw'abakinnyi rufite amazina yemewe. Kuvuga izina ry'umuntu ku giti cye ntibigaragaza ko nta muntu n'umwe ufitanye isano na we.
Jya ukoresha igikoresho cyo guhagarika cyangwa kongera gutangiza kugira ngo uhindure imiterere y'ubuzima, kugira ngo umurinzi amenye ko guhagarika ari ugukorwa ku bushake.
Jya ukoresha RCON cyangwa inzego z'ubuyobozi mu buryo bwemewe, keretse niba ufite gahunda yo kugenzura kure. Imikino ya rusange ntibisaba ko ibyo bisobanuro cyangwa amanota y'iherezo byashyizwe ahagaragara.

data.name: Content.F91F63CB8463862C6775
data.value:
SYNIX CONTROL PANEL
Ivugururwa ry'ibyangombwa 1.4 ?? Ugushyingo 11, 2026
Iyi ni yo mpinduka y'ibyangombwa byemewe, si iyo porogaramu ya Synix. Copyright © 2026 Jason Turner. Uburenganzira bwose bubikiwe. Leta Zunze Ubumwe z'Amerika Gusaba kwandikwa kw'ibitabo by'umwanditsi: birateganyijwe
Uru ruhushya rurareba porogaramu ya Synix Control Panel, harimo code yayo y'ibanze, binaries yakusanyijwe, interfahi y'umukoresha, inyandiko, ibihangano by'ubuhanzi, logo, n'ibindi bikoresho birimo (bishyizwe hamwe, porogaramu ??).
Ibice 13 na 14 nabyo bisobanura imikorere y'ibanga ryurubuga rwemewe rwa Synix, igicuruzwa cyibikorwa, n'umuyobozi wa kure uhitamo. Basobanura serivisi ikoreshwa muri iki gihe; ntabwo bihindura uruhushya rw'umuntu ku giti cye, rutari urw'ubucuruzi rukurikira.
1. Umutungo
Porogaramu ifite uruhushya, ntabwo igurishwa.
Jason Turner afite uburenganzira bwose, umutungo n'inyungu kuri porogaramu ndetse no kuri iyo porogaramu, harimo uburenganzira bwose bw'umwanditsi n'ubundi burenganzira ku mutungo w'ubwenge. Nta burenganzira bw'ubwigenge buhabwa wowe muri uru ruhushya.
2. Gutanga uruhushya rufite imipaka
Uretse ibivugwa muri uru ruhushya, uhabwa uruhushya ruciriritse, rutari urw'umwihariko, rutajya rusimburwa, rutajya ruhabwa uruhushya rw'ikirenga, kandi rushobora kuvugururwa:
- Vanaho porogaramu maze uyikoreshe ku giti cyawe. - Reba kandi wiyigishe kode y'ibanze. - Jya ukora kopi z'ibikoresho byawe bwite. - Jya uhindura kode y'ibanze kugira ngo uyikoreshe ku giti cyawe. - Jya ukora ibisobanuro ku bikoresho ufite cyangwa ugenzura.
Uburenganzira ubwo ari bwo bwose butahabwa mu buryo bweruye n'iri ruhushya, bubikiwe nyirabwoba.
3. Ivugururwa ry'umuntu ku giti cye
Ushobora guhindura porogaramu kugira ngo uhuze n'ibyo ukeneye.
Ibyahinduwe ku giti cyawe bigomba kuguma mu ibanga keretse Jason Turner aguhaye uruhushya rwanditse rwo kubitanga mbere y'igihe.
Ntushobora gusohora, kohereza, gusangiza, gushyira ahagaragara, gukwirakwiza, cyangwa gukora ko kode y'ibanze yahinduwe cyangwa amabinari yahinduwe ashyirwa ku mugaragaro ari verisiyo yihariye ya Synix.
4. Imirimo ihindagurika
Ntushobora, nta ruhushya rwanditse rwatanzwe na Jason Turner:
4.1 Gukoreshwa mu bucuruzi
- Kugurisha, gukodesha, gukodesha, uruhushya, sublicense, cyangwa kwishyura porogaramu. - Kugurisha cyangwa gukwirakwiza binaries zihinduye cyangwa zitarahindutse. - Gukoresha porogaramu cyangwa kode yayo y'ibanze nk'igice cy'igicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi y'ubucuruzi. - Kwunguka mu buryo butaziguye cyangwa butaziguye binyuze mu gukwirakwiza, guha impushya, guhindura izina cyangwa gutanga uburyo bwo kugera kuri Porogaramu.
4.2 Kwongera gusaranganya no kwakira abantu
- Kwishyira kuri interineti, ku bubiko, kuri serivisi yo gukuramo, ku mbuga y'ububiko cyangwa ku iduka ry'ibikoresho byo gusangira dosiye, kwerekereza cyangwa kwakira porogaramu. - Kwongera gusaranganya kode y'ibanze cyangwa ibishushanyo bya binary, byaba byarahinduwe cyangwa bitarahinduwe. - Kora cyangwa ushyire ahagaragara abashyiraho ibikoresho bidashyizweho ku mugaragaro, ibikoresho bigendanwa, indorerwamo cyangwa amashusho yo gukuramo. - Jya usohora ibitabo bivuye kuri porogaramu cyangwa kopi y'iyo porogaramu. - Gushyiraho igishushanyo, ihinduka cyangwa igishushanyo cy'ibikoresho nk'ikintu cyigenga cyangwa kiri mu marushanwa.
4.3 Kwongera gushyiraho izina n'ihame
- Jya ukuraho, uhishe cyangwa uhindure izina rya Synix, impapuro z'umwimerere, impapuro z'umwanditsi, impapuro z'ibyangombwa by'uruhushya, amarogo cyangwa inyandiko. - Guhindura izina rya porogaramu cyangwa kuyishyiraho izina rishya kugira ngo isohoke mu ruhame cyangwa ikwirakwizwe. - Jya uvuga ko ari wowe waremye porogaramu y'umwimerere. - Koresha izina Synix cyangwa izina ry'ubwami mu buryo buterekana ko ari umuterankunga, kwemerwa, gufatanya n'abandi cyangwa ko ari umutegetsi.
4.4 Injiniya ihindutse no kurinda bypass
Mu rugero rwagutse rwemererwa n'amategeko akurikizwa, ntushobora guhindura imikorere, gusambura, gusambura cyangwa kugerageza kurenga ku byemezo by'ibyangombwa by'impushya, kwitabwaho, ibyangombwa by'umutekano, igenzura ry'iminsi mikuru, cyangwa gushyiraho izina ry'ikirango biri mu nyandiko yemewe yashyizweho.
Iryo tegeko ntirikugiraho imipaka ku burenganzira ubwo ari bwo bwose uhabwa n'amategeko akurikizwa mu buryo bweruye.
5. GitHub Amacumu n'impano
Ububiko bwemewe bwa Synix bushobora kugaragara ku mugaragaro kuri GitHub. Urubuga rwa GitHub rushobora kwemerera abakoresha kureba no gushushanya ububiko rusange binyuze mu mikorere yubatswe ya GitHub.
GitHub furuka ntiguha uburenganzira bwo:
- Shyira ahagaragara itangazo ridafite ireme rya Synix. - Gukwirakwiza binaries zahinduwe cyangwa zitarahinduwe. - Rebrand Synix. - Jya ukoresha urubuga rwihariye rw'abantu bose rwo gukuramo cyangwa icyerekezo. - Jya utanga iyo porogaramu yawe bwite. - Kwongera gukwirakwiza Porogaramu hanze y'imikorere idasanzwe itanga na GitHub.
GitHub forks zishobora gukoreshwa gusa mu gusesengura kode, gutegura umusanzu cyangwa kohereza igisabo cyo gukuramo mububiko bwemewe bwa Synix. Ibihindurwa ku giti cyawe bidatangwa nk'impano bigomba kugumaho mu karere kandi bigakorwa ku giti cyawe.
Iyo ushyikirije kode y'ibanze, inyandiko, igishushanyo cyangwa indi nyandiko mububiko bwemewe bwa Synix, ugaragaza ko ufite uburenganzira bwo kuyitanga no guha Jason Turner uruhushya rw'iteka ryose, ku isi hose, rudasesuye, rudasubirwaho, rutarimo umusoro wo gukoresha, gusubiramo, guhindura, gushyira ahagaragara, gukwirakwiza, gutanga uruhushya rusubirwamo, no gushyiramo iyo nyandiko muri Synix.
6. Synix Izina n'ibimenyetso
Izina rya Synix, ikirango, ubwenegihugu bw'amashusho, n'ibimenyetso bifitanye isano na byo bikomeza kuba umutungo wa Jason Turner.
Nta cyangombwa cy'ubushakashatsi cyangwa icyangombwa cy'ubushakashatsi gihabwa n'iri ruhushya uretse kwerekana izina Synix ridahindutse n'icyangombwa cy'ubushakashatsi mu gihe ukoresha Porogaramu.
Gukoresha izina rya Synix mu buryo butemewe n'amategeko bishobora kurenga ku mategeko agenga uburenganzira bw'ikiremwamuntu, ikimenyetso cy'ubucuruzi, irushanwa ridakwiriye cyangwa andi mategeko.
7. Guhagarika umurimo
Uburenganzira ufite muri uru ruhushya buzavaho mu buryo bwikora iyo urenze ku masezerano y'uru ruhushya.
Nyuma yo guhagarika, ugomba:
- Reka gukoresha cyangwa guhindura porogaramu. - Reka gukwirakwiza cyangwa kwerekana kopi zitemewe. - Jya ukuraho kopi z'ibitabo, ibishushanyo, iby'indorerwamo cyangwa ibyo wavana kuri interineti utabifitiye uruhushya. - Jya uhanagura kopi z'ibitabo byawe bwite igihe ubisabwa n'amategeko.
Ingingo zivuga iby'ubwenegihugu, ku bibujijwe, ku mitangire y'amafaranga, ku kwirengagiza ibyangombwa n'ibikurikizwa by'amategeko zirokoka igihe cy'irangiza.
8. Gushyira mu bikorwa
Ufite uburenganzira bwo kugena amakuru ashobora gukurikirana uburyo ubwo ari bwo bwose bwo gukemura ibibazo bijyanye n'amategeko akurikizwa ku birebana no gukoporora, gukwirakwiza, kwakira abantu mu ruhame, kugurisha, guhindura izina cyangwa ibindi bikorwa byo kurenga ku mategeko.
Uburyo bwo gukemura ibibazo bushobora kuba bwarakoreshejwe mu gusaba ko umuntu akurwaho, uburyo bwo gukuraho urubuga, ubufasha bw'ubujurire, indishyi n'ubundi buryo bwo gukemura ibibazo mu rwego rw'uburenganzira bw'ikiremwamuntu iyo bibaye ngombwa.
Nta kintu na kimwe gikubiye muri iri tegeko cyemeza ko hari igikorwa runaka cy'ubugenzacyaha cyangwa uburyo bwo gukemura ikibazo kizaba gihari mu bihugu byose.
9. Kwirengagiza inshingano n'ingaruka z'ibyangombwa
Porogaramu itangwa nk'uko iboneka n'uko iboneka, nta gihombo cy'ubwoko ubwo ari bwo bwose, mu buryo bweruye cyangwa bufatika, harimo n'ibihano by'ubworoherane, gukoreshwa ku bw'intego imwe n'imwe, izina ry'icyubahiro, no kudasuzugura.
JASON TURNER NTAGIRWA MUKIZA ku ngaruka z'ibanze, zitaziguye, zidakemutse, zihariye, ziterwa n'ingaruka cyangwa z'icyitegererezo, cyangwa ku ngaruka zo gutakaza amakuru, inyungu, umusaruro, dosiye za seriveri, isi y'imikino, ubucuruzi, cyangwa serivisi zituruka cyangwa zifitanye isano n'ikoranabuhanga rya software cyangwa ikoreshwa ryayo.
Ni wowe ufite inshingano yo kubungabunga ibyangombwa by'ububiko no kugenzura ko Porogaramu ikwiriye sisitemu yawe n'ibidukikije bya seriveri y'umukino.
10. Ibikoresho by'abantu batatu
Porogaramu z'abantu batatu, ibitabo, dosiye za seriveri y'umukino, ibice bya SteamCMD, ibimenyetso by'ubucuruzi n'ibindi bikoresho ni ibya ba nyirabyo kandi bikomeza gukurikizwa n'ibyangombwa n'amabwiriza yabo.
Uru ruhushya rukoreshwa gusa ku bice bya Synix bifite Jason Turner.
11. Uburenganzira bwatanzwe mu nyandiko
Ibisabwa ku birebana n'iri ruhushya biba bifite agaciro gusa iyo byatanzwe mu nyandiko na Jason Turner.
Ibibazo cyangwa ibyifuzo by'uruhushya bigomba gutangwa binyuze mububiko bwemewe bwa Synix GitHub cyangwa ubundi buryo bwemewe bwo gushyikirana na Synix.
12. Inyandiko z'ibanze zo gukuramo
Gufata Synix binyuze gusa kuri ibi bikoresho byemewe:
- https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases - https://synix.info
Kopi zatanzwe n'izindi mbuga za interineti ntizigenzurwa na Jason Turner kandi zishobora kuba zidafite umutekano, zarahinduwe, zishaje cyangwa zikaba zifatanye na porogaramu idakenewe. Umutekano wabo n'ukuri kwabo ntibigaragazwa na Jason Turner.
Gushyira ku rutonde rwa Synix, guhuza na GitHub, cyangwa gutanga gukuramo ntibigena ubwenegihugu cyangwa gusobanura uburenganzira, kwifatanya, gushyigikirwa, cyangwa imimerere y'ubutegetsi. Synix iracyari umutungo wa Jason Turner.
Kugira ngo umuntu abone ibishushanyo, abigaragarize mu mashusho, abihagararire, abisubize cyangwa abishyiremo, aba agomba guhabwa uruhushya rwanditse mbere y'igihe. Iyo umuntu ahuriye ku isoko ryemewe n'amategeko, ntashobora guhabwa ubwo burenganzira.
Igice cya 4.2 ntikibuza imibare isanzwe y'ibanze kuri izo nyandikorugero zemewe zemeza neza Synix na Jason Turner. Izo nteruro ntizihindura urubuga ruhuza amakuru isoko ryemewe.
WinGet package ubidzz.Synix ni uburyo bwemewe bwo gushyiramo igihe gukuramo installateur itarahindutse mu buryo butaziguye kuva muri GitHub version yemewe. Ibi ntibituma umuntu wa gatatu ashyirwa mu nzu cyangwa ngo ashyirwe mu cyumba.
13. Gukurikirana ibikorwa byo mu buryo bw'ibyishimo no kubana n'abandi
Synix ikubiyemo umwirondoro w'ibikorwa byikora ku giti cyawe ugaragaza umubare w'ibiganiro bya Synix bikorwamo kuri https://synix.info. Ushobora kuwuzimya igihe icyo ari cyo cyose muri Settings > Privacy & Security > Share active count utarinze kugabanya izindi nyungu za Synix. Uburyo bw'ibanze bwo kwifashisha mu gutangiza imibonano mpuzabitsina
Mu gihe byemewe, Synix yohereza ikimenyetso cy'ubuhari bwa HTTPS kuri https://synix.info/api/presence mugihe cyo gutangiza ndetse na hafi buri minota ya 10 mugihe porogaramu ikora, harimo no inyuma. Ikimenyetso kirimo kode y'igikorwa cy'igihe gito gitunguranye n'ikimenyetso rusange cy'ikoreshwa rya Synix, kitagira ubutumwa. Kodegisi ya session ibikwa mu bwenge gusa kandi igasimburwa igihe hashyizweho gahunda nshya yo gutanga raporo; ntabwo ari ikimenyetso gihoraho cy'ibikoresho.
Iyo konti ntishyiraho izina ryawe, aderesi ya interineti, amagambo y'ibanga, amakuru yerekeye seriveri cyangwa umukinnyi, indangagaciro z'iterambere, dosiye cyangwa ibimenyetso byerekana imashini.
Buri gihe, urubuga rwa interineti rwibikira gusa hash ya code y'iyo porogaramu n'igihe cy'ikimenyetso cyayo cya nyuma. Urubuga rusange rwerekana gusa umubare w'abitabiriye ibirori byose, bikaba ari ingengabihe aho kuba umubare w'abantu badasanzwe. Icyiciro cyaretse kubara nyuma y'iminota 15 nta kimenyetso. Ibitabo by'ibikoresho bidakora bihinduka ibyangombwa by'isuku nyuma y'iminota 30 kandi bikurwaho igihe ibyangombwa by'isuku bikurikiyeho bikorwa. Synix ntabwo ihuza ibyo bitabo by'ibaruramari na konti z'umuyobozi wa kure cyangwa imyitwarire ya mudasobwa yihariye.
Kuzimya iyo porogaramu bihagarika ibindi bimenyetso by'uko umuntu ariho kandi bigatuma usaba ikintu kimwe kugira ngo ukureho iyi porogaramu. Gufunga Synix nabyo bigerageza gukuraho; niba gukuraho bidashobora kugera ku rubuga rwa interineti, ikiganiro gihagarika kubara byikora nyuma y'igihe cyo kudakora.
Nk'uko bimeze ku bufatanye bwose bwa interineti, serivisi zo kwakira urubuga zihabwa amakuru asanzwe y'ubufatanye, nka aderesi ya IP iturukaho n'igihe cyo gusaba, kandi zishobora kubikora cyangwa kuzifata nk'uko amategeko yazo yerekeye ubuzima bwite abivuga. Aya makuru ntabwo abikwa muri table z'ibikorwa bya Synix cyangwa ngo yerekanwe mu ibarura rusange.
14. Ubumenyi n'umutekano wo kugera kure
14.1 Uburyo bwemewe bwo kubona amakuru kandi nta kugurisha
Ubuyobozi bwa kure kuri https://manager.synix.info ni bwo bushingiye ku mahitamo kandi buzimye kugeza igihe uhuza mudasobwa maze ukemera konti usaba muri porogaramu ya Synix kuri iyo mudasobwa. Ushobora gukoresha Synix mu karere kawe udafite konti y'umuyobozi. Igikoresho cyo kugenzura ibikorwa by'abaturage kiratandukanye kandi gishobora guhagarikwa ku giti cyacyo.
Synix ntabwo igurisha, ikodesha, gucuruza cyangwa guhishura amakuru ya konti yawe, amakuru ya mudasobwa yihariye, ibikorwa bya kure, cyangwa amakuru ya seriveri ku bamamaza cyangwa abacuruzi b'amakuru. Synix ntabwo ikoresha aya makuru mu kwamamaza ku giti cyawe cyangwa ngo ibishyiremo imyirondoro. Amakuru ashyirwa mu bikorwa kugira ngo utange ibintu wahisemo, ugaragaze ko ari ukuri, ukoreshe iyo serivisi kandi uyirinde gukoreshwa nabi.
Uburyo bwo kugera kure si uburyo bwo kubika ubusa. Akeneye inyandiko z'ibaruramari ridafite aho zibogamiye, ibyo guhuza imibare, ibyo gukora n'ibyo gucunga umutekano nk'uko bigaragara hasi aha. Izo nyandiko ntizashyizwe ahagaragara mu ibaruramari ry'ibikorwa bya Leta cyangwa ngo zigaragare ku zindi konti z'abayobozi binyuze muri serivisi.
14.2 Ibisigaye kuri orudinateri yawe
Synix ntabwo ishyiraho imikino, dosiye z'umukinnyi wumukino, ibikubiye muri dosiye yo gutunganya, ibikubiye mububiko bw'ibikoresho byububiko, umusaruro usanzwe wa console, cyangwa amakarashi ya seriveri yumukino abitswe. Gukora ububiko bwa backup no kugarura kure kuri mudasobwa yihariye; dosiye z'ubufasha zikomeza kuba ahantu hashyizweho. Iyo uhisemo kwandika itegeko ry'ikigo gishinzwe gukinisha umukino ku rubuga rwa interineti, inyandiko y'iryo tegeko irakurikiranwa maze igashyirwa kuri orudinateri ikorana n'iyo porogaramu, hakubiyemo n'ibiciro by'ingenzi ushyira muri urwo rwandiko. Umuyobozi ntabwo ari ububiko bwo kubika mu gicu kandi ntatanga desktop ya kure idafite imipaka, Windows yo kwinjira ku itegeko, cyangwa kurebera dosiye rusange.
Synix ibika imiterere y'aho iherereye, urutonde rw'abakozi, amateka, ububiko n'imimerere yo guhuza kuri orudinateri yawe. Urufunguzo rw'ibanga rwo gusinya kuri orudinateri yashizweho n'umuntu, ruguma mu bubiko bw'urufunguzo rwa Windows. Synix ikunda ububiko bushyigikiwe na TPM iyo buhari kandi mu bundi buryo ifasha imfunguzo za software zikingirwa na Windows, harimo no ku bikoresho bya VM bihuza. Kuba TPM ikiriho si gihamya y'uko orudinateri itagira ibibazo.
Aya magambo asobanura kuyobora kure Synix. Imikino, Steam, mods, integanyigisho za Discord, ibicuruzwa, n'inkuru z'ubufasha uhitamo gusangira bifite imiterere yabyo bwite y'amakuru. Ntukashyiremo amagambo y'ibanga cyangwa andi makuru yihariye mu mazina ya mudasobwa, amazina ya seriveri cyangwa amazina ya dosiye y'ububiko, kuko ayo mazina ashobora kugaragara muri manager.
14.3 Amakuru y'Umuyobozi Imikorere n'Ububiko
- Akaunti n'ubushakashatsi: Izina ry'umukoresha watoranyije, umugaragu wa konti, igihe cyo kurema, ibyifuzo by'umutekano, hash y'amagambo abamo umunyu, ibanga ry'ubushakashatsi ryashyizwe muri encrypted when enabled, passkey public credentials when enabled, and temporary verification/session records. Ama password n'ibikoresho by'ubushakashatsi bigakorwa kugira ngo hakorwe igenzura ry'imyandikire; ama password y'iteka ntabwo abikwa nk'inyandiko isomwa. Synix ntireba ibiganza byawe, ishusho y'amaso yawe, urufunguzo rw'ibanga cyangwa urufunguzo rw'ibanga rwa mudasobwa. Kwiyandikisha ntibisaba izina nyakuri cyangwa aderesi ya interineti. - Gushyira hamwe no guhuza: Ikirango cya mudasobwa wahisemo, umugaragaro w'ibikoresho, urufunguzo rusange rwo gusinya, urubuga rwa konti, ubwoko bwatanzwe n'abatanga urufunguzo, ikirere cyo kwemererwa gushyiramo hamwe n'igihe cyo guhuza bwa nyuma. Urubuga rushobora gukomeza gufungura ikoranabuhanga ryihariye mu gihe Synix ikora kugira ngo urubuga rushobore gukangura porogaramu ihuriweho byihuse. Igikoresho cy'ubushakashatsi kigaragaza ko igicuruzwa cy'umwirondoro gitanga amakuru y'imikorere n'imikorere y'imikorere. - Imimerere igaragajwe: Ibimenyetso by'abakozi ba seriveri, amazina, amazina y'imikino, ikoranabuhanga, umubare w'abakinnyi, igihe cyo gukora, ibikorwa bihari, igihe cya nyuma cyo kubika / imimerere, ibipimo bya CPU na RAM byahurijwe hamwe biturutse ku mikorere y'abakozi ba seriveri y'umukino (harimo n'abashinzwe gutangiza no gukurikirana), hamwe na CPU ya mudasobwa yose yihariye, RAM yakoreshejwe / yose, hamwe n'ibipimo byo kohereza / kwakira kumurongo. Imyitozo yumuyoboro wa mudasobwa ikubiyemo urujya n'uruza rwa LAN kuri adapteri z'inzira zikora; Ibimenyetso by'imikorere ya adapter, aderesi za IP, ibikubiye mu mpapuro n'aho ugiye gutembera ntibimenyekana muri ibi bisomwa. Iyo porogaramu yohereje ibi bisobanuro mu gihe uburyo bwo kureba umuyobozi bwemejwe bukora. CPU/RAM updates zihari za mudasobwa zihuza; Amakuru asobanutse neza ya seriveri agera kuri mudasobwa yatoranyijwe. Ubuvugurura busanzwe bubera buri masegonda ya 10 hanyuma buhagarara nyuma yo kureba ibikorwa bifunze, guhagarika, kurangira cyangwa kwihisha nkuko bikwiye. Abandi bantu bakoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga bashobora gukomeza kubona ibyo bareba. - Ibikorwa byasabwe n'ibikoresho by'ubudehe: Ibimenyetso bya seriveri/ibikorwa, igihe cyisabwa, iterambere/ibisubizo, kandi, iyo usabye amahitamo y'ubudehe, ibimenyetso by'ubudehe, amazina ya dosiye, amatariki, uburebure, n'ibimenyetso by'ubwiza. Ibikoresho by'ububiko n'inzira zisanzwe zo mu karere ntabwo byoherezwa kuri iyi ngingo. - Amategeko y'igikoresho cyo gukinisha: Ikimenyetso cy'umukino udasobanutse neza, uruhushya rw'igihe gito rwo gufungura, n'umwandiko w'itegeko wohereje. Inyandiko ziteganyijwe zashyizwe mu makuru y'umurimo kandi zivanwa muri iyo nyandiko igihe zitanzwe. Ntiyigeze iboneka ku rutonde rw'ibikorwa bya vuba cyangwa mu nyandiko z'amatangazo y'amafaranga. Igisubizo cyatanzwe bisobanura ko iyo nyandiko yoherejwe mu mukino, atari uko umukino wayemeye cyangwa uyirangije. Ibisubizo by'umukino n'igiti cy'imikorere cyo muri ako gace ntibirashyizwe ku rubuga. - Umutekano no gukumira ihohoterwa: Ubwoko bw'igikorwa cyo kwinjira butemewe, umubare n'ibihe byageragejwe mu matsinda, ubwoko bw'ibyabaye byo kugarura / umutekano, n'ibimenyetso by'ikoranabuhanga bihari. Inyandiko z'igihe gito zifite imipaka y'ingengo y'imari zishobora gukoresha hashes ya konti IP n'ibimenyetso bya konti. Synix's account-alert records ntizirimo amayeri yageragejwe, kode zo kugenzura, aderesi z'ibanze za IP, cyangwa amafoto y'urutonde rw'abashakisha. Abatanga serivisi zo kwakira abashyitsi bashobora gutunganya amakuru y'itumanaho ku giti cyabo nk'uko byasobanuwe mu gice cya 14.6.
Urubuga rwa interineti rugomba guhita rusesengura ibigereranyo n'amabwiriza yemerewe kugira ngo rutange ubuyobozi bwa kure. HTTPS hamwe n'imikorere ya interineti yashyizwe muri encrypt ikingira urujya n'uruza mu nzira; ibi ntabwo ari ikirego cy'uko serivisi yo kwakira idashobora gusesengura amakuru.
14.4 Kugumana no gusiba
- Imyandikire ya konti n'ibisanzwe bikomeza kubaho kugeza iyo konti ivuyeho. Ibitabo byemewe byo guhuza abantu biracyariho kugeza igihe orudinateri itakiriho cyangwa iyo konti igacibwa. - Amashusho y'imiterere n'ibisomwa bya CPU/RAM birasimburwa n'ibisomwa bishya kandi bihabwa uburenganzira bwo gusukurwa nyuma y'iminota ya 15 idahindutse. Igihe cyo guhuza ubwa nyuma gikomeza kuba kimwe mu bigize inyandiko y'ubushyinguro. - Inyandiko z'ubuyobozi bwa kure, ibisubizo, n'imiterere y'ibikoresho by'ubushakashatsi byasubijweho bihabwa uburenganzira bwo gusukurwa nyuma y'amasaha ya 24. - Amategeko y'ikigo cy'imikino agisigaye ararangira nyuma y'amasegonda 30. Inyandiko itaratanzwe iba ikwiriye gukurwaho igihe iherezo ryayo rigeze cyangwa igahita ivugururwa; Gutanga ibyangombwa byemejwe bigomba guhita bimenyekana. Amasezerano y'ibikoresho by'ibyuma by'imashini asohora mu minota itatu. Ikimenyetso cy'ibikorwa n'ibisubizo by'igihembwe bigendera ku gihe cyo kwandika igikorwa cya 24-isaha. - Ibikorwa byo kugarura / umutekano n'ibikangisho byo kwinjira bitemewe bihabwa uburenganzira bwo gusukurwa nyuma y'iminsi 90. Gushyiraho imyirondoro mu buryo butemewe n'amategeko bigumaho 100 amakipe aheruka gushyirwa mu bikorwa; Ibipimo by'imikorere y'ibinyabiziga byakozwe mu gihe cy'iminota ya 10. - Imirimo yo kurebera imbuga iba irangiye nyuma y'iminota 30 idasabwe n'umuyobozi cyangwa nyuma y'amasaha 8 muri rusange. Kugerageza kugenzura birarangira nyuma y'iminota 5; Gusubiza password by'agateganyo birarangira mu minota ya 10 kandi bikoreshwa rimwe. Mu gihe cyo gukora isuku, inyandiko zitararangira gushyirwa mu bikorwa, kugarurwa, kurindwa gusubiramo no kugabanya umuvuduko w'akazi zicibwa. Kwandikisha konti zitararangira birahabwa uburenganzira bwo gusukurwa nyuma y'amasaha ya 24.
Mbere y'uko umuntu akuraho inyandiko runaka, igihe cyayo kirarangira. Isuku yisanzwe y'urubuga rwa interineti ikorwa mu gihe cy'ibyifuzo by'umurimo bikurikiyeho, nibura rimwe mu minota ya 10 yo gusukura umuyobozi, bityo ibihe biri hejuru ni ibihe byo kurangiza cyangwa igihe cyo gusukura aho kuba isezerano ryo gusiba mu kanya gato. Inyandiko z'abatanga ubufasha n'inyandiko z'ubufasha zifite imibereho itandukanye.
Gukuraho imiterere y'ibikoresho biherekejwe n'imiterere y'ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga (unpairing) bihanagura imiterere y'ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga (active service database). Amateka y'ibyangombwa by'ububiko/ubwishingizi ashobora kubana n'igitabo cy'ibyangombwa cy'igihe cyavuzwe haruguru. Guhanagura konti y'umuyobozi bivanaho ibyangombwa byayo, guhuza, gufata amashusho yihuta, amabwiriza, n'inyandiko z'umutekano / kugarura konti mububiko bw'amakuru ya serivisi ikora. Ntiyivanaho seriveri z'umukino, isi, imiterere cyangwa dosiye z'ibikoresho byawe. Ibitabo by'iminsi mike byo kwirinda ihohoterwa n'ibitabo cyangwa ibitabo by'ububiko bigenzurwa n'abatanga ubufasha ntibigomba guhita bihanagurwa.
14.5 Ibikoresho byawe n'uburinzi bwo kwinjira
Kwiyandikisha bisaba ijambo ry'ibanga ryawe hamwe n'urufunguzo rw'umwirondoro cyangwa umugaragaro, urugero nka Google Authenticator. Akabungo gateganyijwe ko kagomba gukurikiza uburyo bubiri, kagomba gukurikiza ibyo byombi. Guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga, guhagarika gukoresha orudinateri ukoresheje urubuga rwa interineti no gusiba konti y'umuyobozi, bisaba ko umuntu ahita asuzuma niba hari ihinduka runaka.
Gufungura ingomero yihariye ya console y'umukino byongeyeho bisaba ijambo ry'ibanga rya konti ikora no kwemeza gushya hakurikijwe ibisabwa n'uburyo bwa konti. Kwemera guhuza ni icyiciro kimwe cya porogaramu ya browser, mudasobwa yihariye, seriveri yatanzwe n'umukino wo gukina ukorwaho iminota igera kuri itatu. Guhagarika, kongera gutangiza, gufunga console, guhagarika imiterere ya console cyangwa gutakaza inzira bibuza izindi mabwiriza. Gukuraho cyangwa guhisha akabaruwa k'umuyobozi birangiza uburenganzira bw'akabaruwa. Amabutoni asanzwe akoresha seriveri agumaho ibyo asabwa kugira ngo yinjire. Imyitozo y'imikino ikoreshwa n'umukino gusa ni yo yemewe; Ikimenyetso cyonyine cyonyine ntabwo cyemerera kwandika muri Windows.
Porogaramu y'ikoranabuhanga yemewe mbere ishobora gutanga ijambo ry'ibanga ry'agateganyo niba wibagiwe ijambo ry'ibanga ry'urubuga rwawe. Ntishobora guhitamo indi konti. Password y'agateganyo ntiyihunga cyangwa ngo ikureho ibyo usabwa n'igitabo cy'ibanze/cyemeza, kandi ugomba guhitamo password nshya mbere yo kwinjira muri Manager. Gusubiza ibintu mu buryo bwuzuye bihagarika ibindi bisomwa byawe byo gushakisha.
Umuyobozi wa Synix abika ikimenyetso cye cyo kwinjira mu mushakisha mubwibutsa bwa tab iriho, ntabwo ari muri cookies, ububiko bwo mu karere, cyangwa ububiko bwo kwiherera. Guhumura cyangwa gufunga akabaruwa bipfukirana iyo login. Ibi ntabwo bibuza mushakisha cyangwa umuyobozi wa password kubika amakuru yawe niba uhitamo, kandi ntabwo bisobanura kuki zashyizweho byihariye n'abatanga serivisi zo kwakira / umutekano cyangwa serivisi y'ubuhinduzi bwa urubuga rusange.
Ushobora kwiyandikisha, ukavanaho porogaramu zose z'uruhererekane rw'ibikoresho byawe byo gushakisha, cyangwa ukavanaho orudinateri. Porogaramu ya Synix yo mu gace k'iwabo irashobora guhagarika cyangwa gutandukanya ikoranabuhanga ryayo rya kure itarinze kwinjira ku rubuga. Iyo itari kuri interineti, iba ihagaritse kugera kure mu karere kandi ikongera kugerageza gukuraho urubuga mugihe hari isano. Kwongera gutangiza porogaramu cyangwa Windows ntibishobora kugarura ubwiherero bwakuweho mu buryo bweruye. Ikoreshwa mu karere gusa riracyariho.
14.6 Gucumbikira, Impapuro rusange n'imipaka y'umutekano
Uru rubuga rwemewe rukoresha serivisi zo kwakira imbuga za OpenAI hamwe na Cloudflare yo gutanga, kubika, umutekano, no kumurika. Aba batanga serivisi bagenzura amakuru akenewe kugira ngo batange izo serivisi kandi bashobora guhabwa aderesi za IP, gusaba imitwe, ibihe, n'izindi metadata z'imikorere y'itumanaho, cyangwa bakagumana ibitabo byabo bwite by'imikorere na kopi z'ububiko. Itegeko ry'ibanga ryabo rirareba ibikorwa byabo: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ na https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/.
Ubuhinduzi bwikora ku rupapuro rwa rusange no gukuramo GitHub bigira uruhare ku batanga serivisi zabo. Umuyobozi wa bwite atandukanye n'urupapuro rwemewe n'amategeko kandi ntatwara umukozi ushinzwe ubuhinduzi bwemewe n'amategeko cyangwa inyandiko z'ibitangazamakuru. Synix ntitanga igitekerezo rusange cy'uko gusura urubuga urwo ari rwo rwose bidatuma habaho cookies, inyandiko cyangwa amakuru abitswe. Amakuru ashobora kandi gutangwa iyo asabwe n'amategeko; Umushinga w'ubuyobozi w'ikigo cy'ubugenzuzi bw'igihugu utegura ibikorwa by'ubugenzuzi mu rwego rw'ubugenzuzi bw'igihugu
Synix ikoresha guhuza kwemejwe, ibisabwa na mudasobwa byashyizweho umukono, imishyikirano ya interineti yashyinguwe, igenzura ry'inyungu kuri konti, no kwemererwa kumara igihe gito kugira ngo igabanure kwinjira bidategetswe. Izo mpamyabushobozi ntizibuza abantu kugera kure no kwirinda ibyago cyangwa ngo zibaheshe umutekano ku bitero byose, kuri mudasobwa / mushakisha byahungabanyijwe, ku buryo bwo kwemeza bwibijwe cyangwa kuri serivisi yahungabanyijwe. Komeza kuvugurura Synix na Windows, urinde konti yawe n'uburyo bwo kugenzura, kandi wemere gusa mudasobwa na konti ugenzura.
Iri tangazo ni rusange kuri https://synix.info/license/ kandi rikubiye mu Kigo cy'ubufasha cya porogaramu no gushyiramo. Ibibazo by'ibanga bishobora gutangwa binyuze ku mahitamo yemewe yo gushyigikira kuri https://synix.info/support/. Ntugatume amagambo y'ibanga, kode zo gusubukura cyangwa andi makuru ya konti bwite mu butumwa bw'ubufasha bwa rusange. Ivugururwa ry'iri tangazo rifite ihinduka rishya n'itariki.

data.name: Content.3EDF002B53C15DD7A21D
data.value:
Ibishushanyo byuguruye → Tanga raporo y'ikibazo kugira ngo utegure raporo, cyangwa ukoreshe ibijyanye n'ubufasha bwemewe buri hasi aha.
Jya ushyiraho imihati kugira ngo uhindure icyo kibazo Shyiramo uburyo bwo gushyiramo, verisiyo Synix na Windows urimo gukoresha, umukino/umwirondoro, hamwe n'ibisobanuro bijyanye by'igitabo/umujyanama.
Sobanura: • Ibyo wabonye cyangwa wahinduye. • Ibyo wari witeze n'ibyabaye. • Ikosa ryakozwe mu buryo buhuje n'ukuri hamwe n'igice gito cy'igitabo cyanditswe hafi y'igihe cyacyo. • Ese iyo gahunda yari yarakoreshejwe mbere y'aho, kandi se ni iki cyahindutse?
Gusuzuma mbere yo gusangiza Jya ukuraho amagambo y'ibanga, ibimenyetso, URL za webhook, inzira z'umuntu ku giti cye n'amakuru y'urubuga udashaka ko aba ahagaragara. Uburyo bwo kurinda ubuzima bwite ntibuhumanya dosiye zose zifitanye isano. Ntukamatanye inyandiko zose cyangwa imiterere y'umukino utabanje kuzisuzuma.
Niba hari ikibazo cy'ubuhinduzi, kanda ku rurimi rwahisemo, izina ry'idirishya n'amagambo asobanutse neza. Ku kibazo cy'imiterere y'umukino, shyiraho urutonde rwashyizweho n'ibisobanuro by'umukino.
INYARWANDA Z'IBIHE Raporo z'ibicuruzwa: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/issues
Umuryango Discord: https://discord.gg/WduKEU3j8s
Ububiko bw'imishinga: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel
Gushyiraho cyangwa kubaka porogaramu nziza ntibishobora kugerageza imikino yose, imikorere ya mod n'imiterere y'urubuga. Intambwe zisobanutse zo gusubiramo zifasha gutandukanya ikibazo cya Synix n'ikibazo cy'umukino cyangwa cyo gushyiraho umukinnyi.

data.name: Content.3FCD178C083A4D548FE7
data.value:
Kanda ku murongo wa seriveri mbere yo gukoresha ibyo kugenzura hasi. Urutonde rwatowe rugena seriveri igikorwa kigira ingaruka kuri.
Jya ushakisha umugaragu Koresha agasanduku ko gushakisha kugira ngo uceceke ukurikije izina ry'umukino cyangwa rya seriveri. Igishushanyo cy'imimerere gikomeza kugabanya urutonde. Niba hari inyandiko isa n'aho itariho, jya uhanagura ibyuma byombi mbere yo gutekereza ko yaciwe.
Soma muri make • Abakozi bashyizwe kuri seriveri baba barabarura abakozi bashyizwe kuri seriveri. • Running Now yerekana inyandiko ubu zivugwaho ko zirimo gukoreshwa. • CPU Usage na RAM Usage bisobanura PC yose, ntabwo ari Synix gusa. • Ibimenyetso by'umukinnyi biboneka gusa iyo umukino watoranyijwe ugaragaje isoko ryemewe.
IBIBAZO bya buri munsi • Gutangira, guhagarika no kongera gutangiza igenzura rya seriveri yatoranyijwe. • Gushyiraho byugurura imirima yo gushyiraho. • Kuba witeguye kugenzura ibibazo bishobora gutuma bitagenda neza. • Server Options ikubiyemo inyandiko z'ibikoresho, iby'itumanaho, ibyo guhuza n'ibyo gukina. • Kanda inshuro ebyiri ku murongo kugira ngo urebe neza iyo porogaramu.
Ibikorwa & Diagnostics bigaragaza iterambere n'imiburo ihuje na ryo. Soma ubutumwa bwa nyuma mbere yo kongera gukora ikintu. CLEAR ihumura ahantu haboneka ibikorwa; si itegeko ryo gusiba dosiye zose z'ibitabo.
Kugira ngo umukinnyi agere ku ntego, si ngombwa ko aba yiteguye. Gushyiraho, kwinjiza ibintu mu isi yose, amasezerano n'imikorere y'umukino bishobora gukomeza nyuma y'aho habayeho igikorwa runaka. Wemeze ko witeguye mu gitabo cy'imikino maze wifatanye na bo.

data.name: Content.3FDD32467F5AC4908CBA
data.value:
Open Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager ku byerekeranye n'umwirondoro ushyigikiwe Synix igaragaza ibikubiye mu byo yashyizeho n'aho iherereye; Si urutonde rw'ibitabo birimo buri mod.
JYA KWIHATIRIRA IMPASHO Z'ABIKURU 1. Kora kopi y'ibikoresho by'inyongera biriho, n'imiterere y'ibikoresho byafashwe. 2. Jya uhagarika seriveri ukoresheje Synix maze utegereze ko itsinda ry'imikorere risohoka. 3. Jya ureba uburyo bw'inyongera bwabonetse, ahantu hashyizweho n'urutonde rw'abashinzwe umutekano. 4. Hitamo Install From File cyangwa Import Package kugira ngo ubone dosiye ishyigikiwe, ZIP, cyangwa mod folder yuzuye. Ibyo ushobora guhitamo bizaterwa n'uburyo umukino uzakoreshwa. 5. Jya usuzuma aho ugiye, urebe uko scan yakozwe, urebe imiburo n'ibisubizo byayo. 6. Mujye mureka ibyo gushyiramo ibintu mu mwanya wa mbere, ibyo kubikomeza no kubishyiraho birangire. 7. Synix ihindura urutonde rushya iyo ishyirwaho rirangiye. Niba ari ngombwa, ongera usuzume inyandiko y'umukino n'umuyoboro w'umukiriya.
Urutonde rwerekana ahantu hashyizweho. Jya ukoresha ubufasha bwo gushakisha kugira ngo ushakishe inyongera ukoresheje izina, ubwoko, isoko cyangwa inzira. Gusuzuma ibintu byongeye gusubirwamo maze bigakomeza kugumana ikintu cyatoranyijwe igihe cyose kizaba kiriho. Gusuzuma ibintu mu buryo bworoheje birimo ibintu by'ingenzi mu by'ikoranabuhanga, ariko ntibigere ku byo bigenzurwa.
Jya ufungura idirishya mu gihe ugenzura cyangwa uhindura ibintu. Synix ikuraho ibikorwa bivuguruzanya kugeza irangiye. Niba hari igikorwa kitagenda neza, soma ikosa ryacyo maze usubire ku rutonde mbere yo kongera kugerageza.
INYANGIRIRO z'imirimo Imikorere y'akazi ishyigikiwe ikubiyemo paketi Minecraft JAR, plugins Rust Oxide / uMod, paketi z'ibanze za 7 Days to Die, imiterere ya Empyrion na mod ya seriveri, ID za Workshop ARK: Survival Evolved, n'izihererekanya umukozi wa ARK: Survival Ascended. Hari uburyo bwo gutahura gusa cyangwa se bukenera ingengabihe yabwo bwa mbere.
Synix igenzura imiterere yemewe mugihe umukino/uwatanze itanga ibikubiyemo. Ibikoresho bitarakurwaho ntibishobora gusesengurwa mbere y'aho.
Ibyo abasesenguzi bashobora gukora n'ibyo badashobora gukora Impunzi zikora igenzura ry'imiterere y'ibikoresho n'aho biherereye kandi zikanga inzira zidatekanye, imirongo, ibikubiyemo bitemewe, ibikoresho binini cyane, aho biherereye kandi byemejwe.
Gusuzuma Defender bidahari cyangwa bidafite ishingiro ni umuburo, si igihamya cy'ikoranabuhanga ridakora neza. Gusuzuma neza no kwandika hash nabyo ntibigaragaza ko paketi y'umuntu wa gatatu yizewe. Mods zikoresha uburenganzira bwa Windows bwa seriveri.
INKURU z'ibitabo, ibyo gukurwaho n'ibyo gukira Gusuzuma Catalogue byugurura urubuga rwa interineti rw'abatanga ubufasha. Ntigikemura ibyo umuntu ashinzwe cyangwa ngo ishyireho modpack yuzuye.
Jya uhagarika seriveri mbere y'uko usubira mu bubiko. Ibi bihindura ibyo kwinjiza byose byatoranijwe, bishobora kuba bikubiyemo ibindi bintu byinshi. Igarura ibitabo by'umwimerere byabitswe kandi igavanaho dosiye zashyizwe muri ubwo bubiko. Gusubiza inyuma ibicuruzwa bishya mbere mu gihe bihuza dosiye; Synix yanze kwandikaho dosiye zihindutse hanze yo kwinjiza cyangwa gukoresha inyandiko z'umwimerere zicungishijwe zitatsinze igenzura ry'ubwiza bwazo. Inyandiko za kera zo kwinjiza zishobora kutaba zirimo hashes z'inyandiko z'umwimerere zicungishijwe.
Ku ID igenzurwa n'umutangabuguzi, Remove Selected ikuraho iyo ID mu mikorere ya Synix yemewe; si gahunda yo gusubizaho ibyangombwa. Synix yandika ibyo ihindura, si ko buri nyandiko ihindura. Jya ukomeza kubika kopi z'ibikoresho by'ibikoresho bya mudaseri: gukuraho mod bishobora gutuma isi idashobora gukururwa cyangwa ukuraho ibikubiye muri mod.
Ibara ry'ubusa risobanura ko nta bikoresho by'inyongera bishyigikiwe bihuye n'ahantu hashyizweho gushyiramo no gushakisha. Shyiraho uburyo bwo gushakisha, hanyuma usuzume imyirondoro, dosiye n'inkoranyambaga mbere yo gutekereza ko dosiye zose ziri kuri diski zashakishijwe.

data.name: Content.3FFA3E0258F2F0369B0C
data.value:
Fungura Add Server → Game Support Catalog kugira ngo urebe ibyo Synix azi ku mukino mbere yo gukora inyandiko. Iyo porogaramu ikoresha ibisobanuro byatanzwe n'ikigo cyashyizweho.
1. Shaka izina ry'umukino. 2. Koresha imiterere, amakuru y'umukinnyi, gukundana, guhuza cyangwa gupima kugira ngo ugabanya urutonde. 3. Hitamo umukino maze ufungure ibivugwamo, cyangwa kanda incuro ebyiri ku murongo w'umukino. 4. Soma imiterere yemewe, porogaramu ya seriveri, ibisabwa mbere y'igihe, n'amakuru yo kugenzura.
Niba umukino utari utunguranye, jya usukura imashini. Minecraft's Java na Bedrock amahitamo ari igice cy'imikorere yo gushyiraho aho kuba imibare ibiri ya mod ihinduranya.
Soma ubuhanga bwawe witonze Umwirondoro ushobora gutanga igenamigambi riyoborwa, guhuza n'ubuyobozi, imiterere yo gutangiza, cyangwa gushyigikirwa ku giciro gito / cy'ibanze. Ikimenyetso cyerekana uko ishyirwaho rikora cyangwa Steam AppID iri ku rutonde; si ko buri mukino wose usohotse.
Igisabwa cya SteamCMD cyemejwe neza gisobanura ko imyirondoro isaba kwinjira muri konti. Umutungo w'umukino n'amategeko y'ubuhinduzi bishobora gushyiraho izindi nshingano.
Ibirwa by'Abatutsi si byo biranga umuriro Igiciro cya porogaramu y'igishushanyo cyashyizwe mu bubiko ntibigaragaza ko umutezi w'igishushanyo abaho cyangwa ko agomba kubimenyeshwa. Jya ukoresha imiterere y'umukino n'ibisabwa mu birebana n'imikorere yayo.
Igitabo cy'ibitabo ni ahantu ho gusuzuma ibisobanuro byashyizweho. Inyandiko zo kugenzura mu karere zigaragaza ibyo abantu babonye kuri iyi PC, ariko ntizigaragaza ingaruka z'ibanze za buri mashini yose cyangwa iteraniro ry'imikorere.

data.name: Content.45EB10CB4237CAC4A2E5
data.value:
Fungura icyapa cy'ibikoresho ku gikoresho cy'ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo ubone imiterere ya porogaramu yose. Jya ukoresha buto yo Gushyiraho seriveri mu myitozo iba kuri iyo seriveri yonyine.
IGIHE cyose • Erekana uburyo bwo kugenzura Server Console Window niba seriveri zifashishwa zigaragaza console zabo kavukire. Ibaraza ryihishe ntirishaka kuvuga ko seriveri yahagaritswe. • Uburyo bw'umwijima buhindura umutwe w'ikiganiro. • SteamCMD Download Speed ihitamo umuvuduko wuzuye cyangwa umupaka wo gukuramo ushyigikiwe. • Guhindura indimi byashyigikiwe n'ibimenyetso by'interface, ibiganiro n'ubutumwa bw'imimerere.
Izindi paji zirimo imikorere y'ububiko n'imikorere, uburyo bwo kurinda ubuzima bwite/umutekano, gutanga raporo z'ibibazo, n'ibishushanyo byateye imbere/ibisobanuro. Si ngombwa ko ushyiraho uburyo bw'ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo ukore seriveri isanzwe.
IMYITwarire y'ururimi Hitamo mu ndimi zitangwa mu gikoresho cyo gutoranya. Synix ikoresha ururimi rwatoranijwe, ingingo z'ubufasha n'ubutumwa butangwa na porogaramu. Amategeko y'umukino, indangagaciro z'imiterere n'umwirondoro w'ibanze wa seriveri ntibihinduwe. Ibitabo by'ubuvuzi bikomeza kugira amagambo ya mbere y'ubushakashatsi.
Inyandiko zijyanye n'umukino ntizihindurwa: amategeko, imfunguzo n'ibiciro byo gutunganya, amazina y'ikarita, imiterere, amazina ya dosiye, imvugo yo gutangiza, indangamuntu n'inyandiko zo kumenya umusaruro bigomba kuguma mu buryo umukino utegereje.
Guhindura ururimi rw'interface ntibihindura imiterere y'amabwiriza y'umukino cyangwa ngo bihindure umusaruro wa console. Niba inyuguti zisanzwe za Synix zitahinduwe mu buryo butunguranye, ujye utanga raporo y'amagambo y'inyuguti, agashya n'ururimi rwatoranyijwe.

data.name: Content.493BAB772B40AABA8979
data.value:
Ibikoresho byuguruye → Ubwenegihugu n'umutekano mbere yo gusangira igishushanyo cyangwa gusuzuma uburyo bwo kurinda.
GUTEGEKA Ama mask yo mu buryo bw'ibanga ashyigikira ibishushanyo byoroheje, urugero nk'amazina n'ibimenyetso. Ntabwo ihindura IP yawe rusange, guhisha urujya n'uruza rw'umuyoboro, cyangwa se gusukura inyandiko zose z'umukino n'ibitabo by'imiterere.
Jya usuzuma iyo shusho mbere yo kuyisangiza abandi. Iyo umuntu ahuye n'igikorwa cyo gusubiramo ku rubuga rwihishe, ashobora gukomeza gusubiramo agaciro nyakuri.
Ibisobanuro by'ibimenyetso n'amagambo y'ibanga Synix irinda impapuro z'umwimerere, amakarita n'ibiciro bya webhook byashyizwe mu maboko y'umukoresha wa Windows. Umukino ushobora gukomeza gusaba ibyangombwa bisomwa mu myubakire yawo bwite cyangwa imishinga yo gutangiza.
Kopi yoroheje ya folda kuri konti yindi ya Windows ntabwo byemeza ko ayo mibare irindwa ishobora kuvugururwa. Koresha imiterere y'akazi yo kwimura yashyizweho kugira ngo ushobore kwimura ibyangombwa byemewe.
INKURU z'ibyangombwa Gukora Synix na seriveri zisanzwe z'umukino zifite uburenganzira bwisanzwe bwa Windows. Guhindura sisitemu runaka cyangwa gutangiza umukino bishobora gusaba kuzamuka ku giti cyabyo; si impamvu yo gutwara ibintu byose burundu nk'umuyobozi.
Ibibazo by'isuku y'inkuta z'umuriro ku bushake byashyigikiwe n'amategeko ya kera ya Synix. Gusuzuma amategeko ateganyijwe mbere yo kwemeza kwimura. Ntigenzura dosiye zose cyangwa ngo yemere gusiba amategeko ya firewall idafite aho ihuriye.
Niba hari ibanga ryashyizwe ahagaragara, musimbuze iryo banga cyangwa murisubize mu rwego rwasohoye iryo banga. Guhisha urubuga cyangwa gukuraho kopi ya Synix yatanzwe ntibihindura ubusa ibyo byemezo ahandi.

data.name: Content.5157BE079A5B48521112
data.value:
Gufunga idirishya ry'umwana, kugabanya Synix, no gusohoka mu buryo bweruye muri porogaramu ni ibintu bitandukanye. Jya usuzuma imyitwarire yawe n'amabwiriza yose yo gusohoka.
GUSUBIRA PANEL yo kugenzura Synix ishobora kumenya imikorere ya seriveri ishyigikiwe ikiri gukora no kuyigarurira. Jya wemera ko igenzura ry'uburyo bwa mbere rirangira mbere yo gutangiza ikindi gikorwa.
Ubumenyi bw'imikorere bugomba guhura n'ishusho yatoranijwe, si izina rizwi gusa. Ibikoresho byakozwe ku giti cyabyo cyangwa ibicuruzwa bigenzurwa n'umuntu ku giti cye bishobora gukenera kwitabwaho kurushaho.
Imikorere y'ibanze Uburyo bwemewe bwo gutangiza / kugena imiterere y'ibikorwaremezo bufasha kugenzura mu kwinjira kwa Windows. Si ngombwa ko utanga seriveri yawe ya mbere.
Umurimo uteganyijwe ukeneye uburyo cyangwa ikoranabuhanga Synix rifite akamaro, icyiciro cya Windows kiriho n'ikigo cy'ikoranabuhanga kizima. Gutangira kwandikisha ntabwo ari isezerano ry'uko akazi kazajya kagenda mu gihe imashini izaba ifunze.
MBERE y'uko usubukura amadirisha Kora kopi z'ibikoresho by'ububiko, ujye ubishyira kuri interineti. Jya uhagarika imikino ukoresheje Synix kugira ngo ishobore kubika bisanzwe, hanyuma usohoke cyangwa wongere gutangiza Windows.
Ntugatekereze ko igikoresho cyo gukinisha cyahise gihagarara cyangwa ko gufunga idirishya ry'urukurikirane bihagarika umukino wacyo. Jya usuzuma urwego rw'ubugenzuzi kandi ukoreshe uburyo bwo kugenzura ubuzima bw'umuntu.

data.name: Content.57A2257D55B43047831A
data.value:
Fungura umwirondoro wo kwitegura wa seriveri yatoranijwe kugira ngo umenye ibisabwa. Igihe cyo gutwara kirimo Synix ntabwo gisimbura ibyo umukino ukeneye ku giti cyawo.
UMUHANUZI W'IBIBONEKO Amakosa avugwa muri MSVCP140.dll cyangwa VCRUNTIME140.dll akenshi yerekana ko Visual C ++ ikeneye igihe cyo gukora. Jya ukoresha amabwiriza y'umukino n'igishushanyo cyashyigikiwe Microsoft gisanzwe.
Amakuru ashobora gusabwa Microsoft: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist
Ntukuremo dosiye za DLL zisanzwe ku mbuga nkoranyambaga cyangwa ngo ushyire DLL zitari zifitanye isano iruhande rwa seriveri ikoreshwa.
IBIBAZO BIMWE Umukino ushobora gusaba konti, uburenganzira bwa seriveri, igihe runaka cyo gutangiza Java, imiterere ya Windows, cyangwa ibikoresho byashyigikiwe. Uzuza ibyo bisabwa mbere y'uko uhindura imbuga zidafitanye isano cyangwa ushyiraho igenamigambi.
Kuri Minecraft Java, koresha urufatiro rwemewe rwa verisiyo/umujyanama uturuka muri Synix's selectors. Bedrock ntabwo ikoresha Java.
Kugira ngo ushyire ibintu mu bikorwa bisaba Hyper-V cyangwa gukoresha ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga, jya usuzuma ibipimo by'imikino. Ntukemure imikorere ya sisitemu cyangwa ngo ukoreshe buri seriveri nk'umuyobozi gusa kugira ngo wirengagize umuburo.
Nyuma yo gukemura icyo cyifuzo, kora intangiriro nshya hanyuma usuzume ikosa rya mbere rifite ireme mu gitabo cy'imikino niba rikomeje kunanirwa.
