Icarus itangira mu cyumba cyayo cya seriveri yihariye; wifatanya na seriveri kugira ngo utware, wongere gukora cyangwa utume habaho prospect.

data.name: Content.5C88F49381905FBD8C70
data.value:
IGIHAMBA CY'UBUGENGE cyasabwe:
1. Synix ifungura Manager ya seriveri yihariye ya Space Engineers kandi ihora igaragara.
2. Hitamo 'Local/Console', hitamo 'Continue to server configuration', winjize imiterere ya seriveri n'isi, hanyuma uhitemo 'Save & start'.
3. Jya ukoresha umuyobozi w'ibishushanyo byateye imbere, isi, mod, abayobozi, n'ikigo gikorerwamo. Amakuru ya seriveri abikwa muri iyi dosiye Synix ya seriveri Instance.
4. Uburyo bwa Local/Console bwa mbere ntibusaba uburenganzira bw'abayobozi. Uburyo bwo gukora bwa Windows burabikora.
5. Ibisabwa: .NET Framework 4.8 cyangwa iza vuba, Visual C++ Redistributable 2013 na 2017, nibura 6 GB ya sisitemu RAM, na UDP porta 27016 yemerewe binyuze kuri Firewall ya Windows kandi yoherezwa ku bakinnyi ba interineti.
6. Inyandiko z'ibanze: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.5CA69EB89BDD805145B9
data.value: Fungura Documents\Euro Truck Simulator 2\config.cfg maze ushyire g_console "1". Funga umukino, hanyuma ukande kuri Synix kongera gutangira. Synix izinjiza dosiye zakozwe byihuse.

data.name: Content.5D3A53B459DA2A7A26AF
data.value:
Koresha ubu buyobozi igihe LAN ikina ikora ariko ikorana n'abantu benshi ntibikore.
UBUGENGE bwawe bwo gushyikirana n'abantu benshi Hari imashini zimwe na zimwe zidashobora gushyigikira iterambere rya NAT, nanone ryitwa hairpinning. Iyo umuntu ahuye n'aho aba ari mu rugo, bishobora kumubuza gukora ibyo ashaka, ndetse n'iyo abakinnyi bo hanze bashobora kwifatanya na we.
Jya ukoresha aderesi ya LAN yo mu rugo kandi usabe umuntu ufite undi murongo wa interineti kugerageza iyo aderesi rusange. Igikoresho cy'ikoranabuhanga cya WAN cyo muri PC cyonyine kitagaragaza ko interineti yafunzwe.
GUTEGUZWA imbere nta tandukaniro Reba niba hari ubundi buyobora imbere, NAT y'uburyo bubiri cyangwa NAT (CGNAT) yo mu rwego rwo gutwara. Gereranya amakuru ya WAN y'umuyoboro na aderesi rusange hanyuma ubabaze ISP niba hari imikorere yo kwinjira ishigikiwe.
Itegeko ryo kohereza ku muyoboro wawe ntirishobora gufungura NAT iyoborwa na ISP. Biterwa n'umuyoboro wa interineti, ushobora kuba ukeneye serivisi ya aderesi rusange, VPN/umugezi ukwiriye cyangwa seriveri yashyizweho. Ibyo ni ibintu byo hanze, si ibintu byubatse muri Synix.
Ntimukabeshye abayobozi n'abakinnyi Ku birebana n'iyo mikino, umurongo w'ubuyobozi bwa kure n'umuyoboro w'umukinnyi ni inzira zitandukanye. Kugena amakuru yo mu karere ka API cyangwa Discord ntibituma umukino ugera kuri interineti.
Jya ushyiraho uburyo bwo kugerageza imbuga nkoranyambaga kugira ngo ugere kuri porogaramu y'umukino n'imikorere yayo. Mu gihe usaba ubufasha, ntusohore amagambo y'ibanga, ibimenyetso, amashusho y'icyuma cy'umuyoboro cyangwa amakuru y'urubuga rwawe bwite.

data.name: Content.6B534A2A8D64DD2115B8
data.value:
Jya ukoresha urutonde rw'ibivugwa mu gice cyayobye.
UMURYANGO wa SYNIX Ibikorwa & Diagnostics yerekana iterambere n'imiburo ihuje n'abakoresha kuri dashboard. Gukuraho ako gace bihanagura ubutumwa buboneka gusa; si byo bihanagura ibimenyetso byose byafashwe.
Ibirango by'ishyirahamwe Synix ibitabo by'inyandiko n'inkuru zivuga iby'impanuka zihitana abantu ubusanzwe ziba zifite: C:\Synix\SynixData\logs
Ikiganiro cyo guhungabana gishobora kwita dosiye runaka. Jya ukoresha iyo nzira n'igihe umuntu atashoboye kubona inyandiko ikwiriye.
Uburyo bwo gusuzuma indwara mu buryo bukoreshwa bushobora kwandikwa mu gitabo cy'inyandiko kitagaragara ku rukuta. Gufata ibintu mu buryo bw'ibanze bitagaragaza ko hari ikibazo cy'ingamba z'ubudehe.
Ibikoresho by'imikino Koresha igitabo cy'umukino cya seriveri yatoranijwe kugira ngo ubone amakosa yo kuzamura isi, gutunganya, mod na runtime y'umukino. Aho iherereye bitewe n'umukino kandi ishobora kuba iri hanze y'inkomoko y'igishushanyo.
GUSOMERA mu nkuru ikikije uwo Suzuma uko ibintu byagenze n'igihe byagenze, hanyuma usuzume ubutumwa bwatanzwe ku bihereranye n'ikosa rya mbere rifite ireme. Iyo umurongo uhagaritswe ku iherezo, bishobora kuba ari ingaruka aho kuba impamvu.
Mbere yo gusangiza abantu inkuru runaka, jya ukuraho amagambo y'ibanga, ibimenyetso, interineti, aderesi bwite n'inzira zawe bwite. Satisfactory'console/log ubwayo ishobora kuba irimo token y'umuyobozi. Jya urinda inyandiko y'ibyabaye ku giti cyawe kugira ngo ukore iperereza.

data.name: Content.72F10866249FA31A6B09
data.value:
Gusubizaho bishobora gusimbuza ibikubiye muri seriveri yatoranyijwe. Jya uhitamo seriveri ikwiriye, kandi uharanire ibintu bishya mbere yo gukomeza.
1. Jya uhagarika seriveri maze ukore kopi yihariye y'ibikoresho ushobora gukenera. 2. Fungura imikorere yo kugarura ibyangombwa by'umwirondoro mu bikoresho bya seriveri. 3. Hitamo inyandiko zigenewe maze usuzume seriveri yayo, itariki yayo, ingano yayo n'imimerere yayo. 4. Jya ubisuzuma mbere yo kubisubiramo. Synix backups na SHA-256 Amafaranga y'ishyingurwa ashobora kugenzurwa hakurikijwe ayo mafaranga; inyandiko za kera zishobora kwemezwa ko ari umurage. 5. Soma umuburo wo gusimbuza maze wemeze gusa niba iyi ari yo ntego ushaka. 6. Kureka ibijyanye n'imiterere y'ibikoresho no kuvura bikarangira nta gufunga Synix cyangwa guhagarika kubika. 7. Jya utangiza seriveri maze wemeze ko isi n'ibishushanyo byagenwe byasubijweho.
Icyo Gusuzuma Ibyanditswe bigaragaza Gusuzuma ko umuntu ari indahemuka, bigaragaza ko hari ibintu byahindutse mu birebana n'inyandiko yatanzwe. Si gihamya y'uko isi yari ifite amagara mazima igihe yarokorwaga cyangwa ko inyandiko zandikishijwe intoki zatanzwe n'undi muntu ari iziringirwa.
NIBA INKURU yabaga mu nzu y'ibyokurya ihagaritswe Jya urinda inyandiko n'izindi dosiye zose zishobora kugarurwa. Soma ubutumwa bwo gusubiza mbere yo kugerageza ubundi buryo bwo gusubizaho cyangwa gukuraho dosiye.
Ntukureho ZIP kuri seriveri ikora. Niba umukino ukomeza kubika hanze ya folder yo gushyiramo, uzasubize izo konti ku giti cyazo ukoresheje uburyo umukino ushyigikiwe.
Jya urinda kopi y'umwimerere kugeza igihe uzaba wisuzumye seriveri yasubiwemo n'umuyoboro w'umukiriya.

data.value:
Kwinjiza Seriveri iriho yandika ishyirwaho ryashigikiwe riri kuri diski. Ntabwo ari kongera gushyiraho kandi bitandukanye no kwinjiza pakiti yuzuye yo kwimura Synix.
Mbere y'uko ujya mu mahanga Kora kopi y'ibikoresho by'ububiko ku giti cyawe, hakubiyemo n'ibikoresho byose bisigaye hanze y'ifatabuleti yo gushyiramo. Uhagarike seriveri kandi uhagarike undi muyobozi cyangwa umuhanga mu gutegura igihe ushobora kuyitangira mugihe Synix irimo kuyigenzura.
INKURU y'ishusho 1. Hitamo Add Server → Import Server iriho. 2. Hitamo dosiye yo gushyiramo seriveri, aho guhitamo inzira ngufi, dosiye ya ZIP cyangwa dosiye y'umukinnyi. 3. Reka Synix ikore isuzuma, hanyuma yemeze umukino wagaragajwe, impapuro z'umwimerere, ibyangombwa byakozwe, n'imiterere. 4. Shyiraho izina ry'uruhererekane kandi ushyireho indangagaciro zibuze. 5. Kurangiza kwinjiza, gufungura Gushyiraho, no gusuzuma inzira zayo n'amavuko. 6. Jya ukora imyiteguro, hanyuma ukore intangiriro imwe igenzurwa. Reba niba isi n'imiterere byateganijwe byari byuzuye.
IBIHINGO by'ingenzi Kwiyandikisha ntibikuraho ibyo bikoresho cyangwa ngo bisubize ibishushanyo byabyo. Ibikorwa bya nyuma uhitamo mu buryo bweruye, urugero nko kuvugurura, kwemeza, cyangwa gusanura imiterere, bishobora guhindura dosiye.
Ibikoresho byo gutangiza, modpacks, passwords n'ibikoresho byo hanze bishobora kutamenyekana mu buryo bwikora. Inzira imwe yo gushyiramo ntabwo ishobora kwandikwa inshuro ebyiri.
Iyo UBUGENGE butagera ku ntego Reba niba wahisemo porogaramu yo gushyiramo seriveri yihariye ishyigikiwe n'umwirondoro watoranyijwe. Ntugahindure izina ry'ikintu kitari gifite aho gihuriye n'ikindi kugira ngo ugihindure. Tanga raporo y'umukino n'isura y'ibikoresho byacapwe kugira ngo bishobore gusuzumwa.

data.name: Content.749F8256FE4490AB39C8
data.value:
Koresha ubu buyobozi igihe umuhuzabikorwa wa porogaramu y'itumanaho atanga raporo y'umurima ufunzwe, inyubako itemewe, cyangwa itandukaniro ry'ibishushanyo.
Sobanukirwa imyanzuro ufata • Gusubiza ibintu bishya bisanzwe bishyigikiwe mu mikorere yatoranijwe. • Gufasha gukemura ikibazo cy'ubufasha cyavuzwe. • Gusubiza ibintu mu buryo bugaragara by'igishushanyo mbonera kandi bishobora gukuraho imiterere yihariye.
Gusubiza ibintu mu buryo si intambwe ya mbere y'uko buri mudaseri idakora neza. Imikino itaratangira gukinwa, imiyoboro ikoreshwa n'imikorere y'imikorere ya mod idakora neza, ntibigororwa binyuriye mu gusimbuza dosiye z'ibikoresho incuro nyinshi.
Mbere yo gukora isuku Jya uhagarika umukino, ukomeze kopi y'ibyo bikoresho, maze usome ihinduka ryasabwe. Hari imyirondoro ifite inyandikorugero yuzuye; Abandi bo baba biteze ko umukino uzajya utanga dosiye ku ncuro ya mbere, cyangwa se ukaba ukeneye gufungura imashini.
Synix ivuga ko amakarita asabwa ataboneka aho gutekereza ko ashobora gusimbuza buri murongo mu buryo bworoshye. Gushyiraho impinduka y'ibishushanyo bigenzurwa bishobora kubika kopi imwe yiswe .synix.before-template-v<revision>.bak.
Nyuma y'uko umuntu yananiwe gukiza cyangwa gusanura Jya urinda dosiye iyo ari yo yose y'ubushakashatsi cyangwa iy'ubugenzuzi maze usome ubutumwa bw'ubugenzuzi. Mbere yo guhitamo icyo uzagarura, gereranya imiterere y'umwimerere n'iyavuguruwe. Ntukamareho ibimenyetso byerekana ko utagikora.
Nyuma yo gukira, jya ubanza usuzume inyandiko y'umukino. Wemeze ko isoma inzira ikwiriye kandi ko imiterere yawe ukeneye ikiriho.

data.value: Jya winjiza inyandiko yuzuye yavanywe, hanyuma uhitemo kuyirinda ku giti cyawe. Abanditsi ba Steam ntibashyiraho kopi ya seriveri.

data.name: Content.773EBB55CC6A1753CF86
data.value: Inyandiko z'imiterere ya 0.3.14 zatanzwe n'umushakashatsi zivuga ikibazo cy'ikirangirire cya UTF-8, kirimo inyuguti z'igisiriliki n'izindi nyuguti zitari iza ANSI. Icyo ni igihamya cy'uko hari ubwoko runaka bw'inyuguti, si ugutekereza ko buri nyuguti y'umushakashatsi igaragaza buri kamenyetso.

data.name: Content.7776A5CA82E9769808BF
data.value: Mbere na mbere, jya ushyiraho imashini yo kwinjiza BepInEx ihuje na Valheim. Plugins zihuza na seriveri zijya muri BepInEx/plugins; ibipimo n'imiterere bigomba guhuza. Hari n'imikorere imwe na yo igomba gushyirwaho umukiriya; igitabo cya Thunderstore cyonyine ntabwo kigaragaza ko seriveri zihuza.

data.name: Content.77BE1B38F7F07CB49C36
data.value: Bisaba uburyo buhuza Metamod:Source na SourceMod yubatse kuri iyi verisiyo ya seriveri. Plugins .smx zashyizwe hamwe zigenda muri fof/addons/sourcemod/plugins; inyandiko z'ubuhinduzi, amakuru y'imikino n'inyongera biherekejwe na byo bigumana imiterere yabyo.

data.name: Content.780D9B8DEE8EE337F6D9
data.value: Jya ucuruza paketi za seriveri ku mukiriya ufite ibikubiyemo wifuza. SCS ivuga ko seriveri yihariye idakeneye amakuru y'inyongera ya DLC/mod; ntushyiremo mod ZIP isanzwe y'umukiriya nk'igishushanyo cyo kuri seriveri.

data.name: Content.7871EA5C906D13E02997
data.value:
Dune ikoresha sisitemu yo kwimura hanze ifite imashini ziboneka mu mikino n'imiterere y'itsinda ry'intambara. Si seriveri isanzwe y'umukino.
IBIBAZO Soma ibyo Synix ikora ku bwiteguye bwo kwibuka sisitemu, AVX2, hardware virtualization, Hyper-V, no gusohoka kwa Professional cyangwa hejuru ya Windows. Ibyo ukenera kwibuka biterwa n'itsinda ry'intambara n'amakarita ukoresha.
Synix ntishobora gukora virtual cyangwa gushyiramo Hyper-V. Mbere yo gutangira gukina, ujye wuzuza ibisabwa ku birebana n'umukino.
Gushyiraho no gutangiza 1. Kora inyandiko ya Dune: Awakening hanyuma usuzume ibyifuzo byayo n'ikaramu yo gushyiraho. 2. Jya ubikomeza. 3. Synix ishyira mu bikorwa igikoresho cyemewe cya battlegroup.bat hamwe n'ubufasha bw'umuyobozi bukenewe muri iyo gahunda. 4. Hitamo initial-setup mu gikoresho cy'umukino maze utange icyangombwa cyawe. 5. Jya wuzuza imiterere y'ikibanza, ikoranabuhanga n'itsinda ry'intambara muri icyo gikoresho.
Jya ubona Ikimenyetso cya Self-Host ukoresheje urubuga rwemewe rwa konti ya Funcom ukoresheje uburyo bwayo bwo kwemerwa / gushyiraho: https://account.duneawakening.com/
Jya urinda icyo kimenyetso ibanga. Uburebure bw'iki gikoresho cyo gushyiramo ntabwo bisobanuye ko buri seriveri ya Synix igomba gukoreshwa nk'umuyobozi.
IBIHINGO byo gushyikirana no kugenzura Koresha imiterere y'urubuga rwa host / VM n'amavuko asabwa. Metadata y'urusobe rw'igisubizo muri Synix yerekana RMQ, ntabwo ari umutezi usanzwe w'igisubizo cya A2S.
Ibaraza ry'umuriro rifunze ntirihamya ko imashini zayo z'ibikoranabuhanga zahagaze. Jya ugenzura uko umukino ugenda kandi ukore ibikorwa by'itsinda ry'intambara ukoresheje uburyo bwo kugenzura imikino.
Synix irashobora gushyiramo, kuvugurura, gutangiza no gukora kopi y'ububiko bwashyizweho. Ntugatekereze ko guhagarika ibikorwa bisanzwe, ibibazo by'umukinnyi cyangwa kugarura imbwa y'umurinzi bigenzura mu buryo bwuzuye ibikorwa byo hanze. Iyo dosiye yo gutangiza ntabwo itangwa kuri iyi dosiye.
Gukoresha imikorere yo guhagarika n'ububiko bw'ibikoresho bishyigikiwe n'umukino ku makuru ya VM/database ihoraho. ZIP yonyine yo gushyirwamo ntabwo ari backup ihoraho yemewe.

IGIHAMBA CY'UBUGENGE cyasabwe:

data.name: Content.7B4987810DD3E78752A5
data.value:
Iki kiganiro ni icy'abakoresha n'abaterankunga b'abahanga. Ntukeneye ibikoresho by'umushakashatsi kugira ngo ushobore gukora seriveri ukoresheje imyirondoro ishyigikiwe.
Uko ibisobanuro bikora Ibisobanuro by'umukino wubatse bisobanura gukuramo, ibishyirwa mubikorwa, Steam AppIDs n'ibisabwa byo kwinjira, impaka zo gutangiza, ibyambu, imyitwarire yo gushyiraho, ibisabwa mbere, hamwe n'ubushobozi bw'umuyobozi.
Guhitamo imyitwarire yashizweho mu bisobanuro. Ntibishyiraho imikorere y'ibikoresho by'ubushakashatsi, ibishushanyo cyangwa inyandiko zavanywe mu buryo bwimbitse. Gusubiza dosiye ya JSON muri dosiye y'ikigo cyashyizweho ntabwo byongeraho imyirondoro mishya y'umukino.
Gukosora cyangwa kongeramo 1. Tangira ukoresheje amabwiriza y'ibikoresho bya seriveri yihariye n'ibikoresho by'imiterere byakozwe. 2. Gukoresha inzira zifitanye isano n'inkomoko ya seriveri aho bikenewe kandi zigaragaza neza imikino. 3. Shyiramo inyandikorugero yuzuye ifashijwe ahantu hashyizweho neza. 4. Gusubizaho ibisobanuro bikwiye/imiterere/ibishushanyo by'igishushanyo. 5. Gushyiraho ubuhamya bw'ibitabo, kubaka ukoresheje SDK isaba umushinga, no gukora ibizamini bijyanye. 6. Gerageza gushyiraho, gutangira, guhagarika no kugenzura umukino mbere yo kwandika igenzura.
Definition Builder ni igikoresho cy'iterambere, ntabwo ari itegeko risanzwe ryo gushyiraho.
UMUTEKEREZI W'Ibikoresho • UI: Amadirishya afite umwihariko. • ServerHandler: Ibikoresho byo kugenzura imikino no guhuza seriveri. • SynixEngine: Gahunda y'ubuzima bwa porogaramu, kwitabwaho, gushyikirana mu mitwe, gukora kopi z'ububiko n'umutekano. • Imyitozo: Gahunda zo kuyobora ibintu, imiterere y'ibiganiro n'abafasha mu gutegura ibintu. • Database/GameDefinitions: Imyitozo y'imikino n'ibishushanyo. • Database/ModSystems: Gushyigikira ibikorwa by'iterambere. • Gushyira mu mwanya w'umuntu: Amatariki y'interface n'ibikoresho by'imikorere. • Ibizamini: Ibikoresho by'ubushakashatsi bishingiye ku mico.
Ku birebana n'ubuhinduzi, ujye ushyiraho urutonde rw'indimi zose hamwe, kandi uzirinde ko hagira umuntu ubanza kuzihindura. Shyiramo n'ingingo z'ubufasha, ibizamini by'uburwayi, inyandiko zigaragaza uko imikino ikorwa, n'ibisobanuro by'imikino isaba ubufasha. Ntuhindure amabwiriza, imfunguzo, ibimenyetso, indangagaciro z'umukoresha, cyangwa ibipimo by'ubuhamya bw'umusaruro. Ibitabo by'umwimerere byemeza ko indwara ivurwa nta cyo byahindutseho.
Soma Amategeko agenga uruhushya n'ububiko mbere yo kongera gukwirakwiza kode cyangwa kubaka. Jya wirinda gutanga amakuru y'ibanze n'amabaruwa yawe bwite.

data.name: Content.7C1660167D3419DD05A4
data.value:
Jya ushyiraho gahunda yo kwita ku mudasobwa nyuma yo kugerageza imyitwarire isanzwe yo kubika, kuvugurura, guhagarika no gutangiza.
1. Fungura imiterere y'ibikoresho bya automatike/agateganyo maze ukore agateganyo. 2. Hitamo iminsi n'igihe. 3. Shyiraho Smart Maintenance maze uhitemo uburyo bwo kubika / kuvugurura buhari. 4. Jya ufata umwanzuro wo gutegereza abakinnyi maze ushyireho igihe ntarengwa cyo gutinda. 5. Jya ubika kandi ugerageze mu gihe cy'imyitozo ushobora kugenzura.
Imyitozo ikoresha igihe cya PC. Jya ukoresha isaha n'ibihe neza.
Mu gihe gahunda y'ibyo ugiye gukora igeze ku ntego Synix irashobora gutegereza abakinnyi bashyizwe hamwe, hanyuma igahuza guhagarika itsinda ry'imikorere yemejwe, gufata kopi mugihe yahagaritswe, kuvugurura no gutangiza bundi bushya ukurikije amahitamo yatoranyijwe.
Igihe ntarengwa cyo gutinda ni igipimo, si isezerano ryo gutegereza iteka ryose. Imirimo yo kubungabunga ishobora gutangira igihe cyayo kirangiye, nubwo abakinnyi bagumaho. Nta gihe cyo gutegereza gihari.
UBUGENZI bw'abakinnyi bufite imipaka Gutegereza bizaterwa n'amakuru umukino watoranyijwe ushobora gutanga. Seriveri ya API ifitanye isano na Satisfactory yita ku mibare idahoraho cyangwa itariho mu gihe cyo gutegereza cyashyizweho. Ibyo ntibigaragaza ko amakuru y'ibikoresho by'ubushakashatsi adashyigikiwe ari ayo kwizerwa.
Menyesha abakinnyi mbere y’igihe kandi usome ubutumwa bw’ibikorwa bivuyemo. Ubutumwa bwa Discord bushobora kumenyesha ibikorwa byo kubungabunga bishyigikiwe iyo inzira zabwo zashyizweho.
PC igomba kuba ikomeje gukora kandi ikoranabuhanga rya Synix rifite aho riherereye cyangwa ikoranabuhanga ry'ibanze. Orudinateri ifunze cyangwa iryamye ntishobora gukuramo ibintu mu buryo busanzwe kandi ntiyisubire gutangira.

data.name: Content.8579FAD0312C27797E9E
data.value:
Fungura Terminal ya Windows cyangwa PowerShell ukoreshe indangamuntu y'ibikoresho iri hasi aha. Ayo mabwiriza agenzura Synix ubwayo, atari seriveri z'umukino ku giti cyazo.
GUSHYA winget install --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
REBA IMPASHO ZIYARI Zishyizweho winget list --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
UPDATE Gufunga Synix no kurangiza akazi kayo mbere yo gukoresha: winget upgrade --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Jya ukuraho iyo porogaramu winget uninstall --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Jya ukoresha amakuru yawe Ibishushanyo bya seriveri, kubika no gukora kopi z'ububiko biratandukanye n'ibikoresho bya porogaramu. Ntuzice C:\Synix cyangwa izindi dosiye z'ibanze, keretse niba wifuza gukuraho izo data ku bushake.
NIBA itegeko rishobora kunanirwa Soma impamvu yavuzwe. Niba WinGet ivuga ko hash hash y'ikigo cyashyizweho idashyize mu bikorwa, ujye uyireka uyirebe; ntukagendere kugenzura hash. Gusubizaho amakuru bishobora kuba bisobanura ko ububiko bw'ibitabo butaracapura igitabo gishya.
Kwemera WinGet hamwe na hash yo gukuramo ihuje ntabwo byemeza kode Synix cyangwa ngo byemeze ko porogaramu yumutekano ya Windows izayizera.

2. Shyira amagambo y'umukozi wawe n'ibyahindutse mu muyoboro w'ikoranabuhanga muri dosiye ya INI.
3. Inyandiko z'ibanze: https://abioticfactor.wiki.gg/wiki/Dedicated_Server

data.value:

data.name: Content.89E9CF0E65B8EACE25DF
data.value:
Mbere na mbere, gerageza kwemeza ko umukino ukora ku rubuga rwawe. Guhindura umuterankunga ntibishobora gukemura umukino utatangiriye cyangwa utarangije imyitozo yawo ya mbere.
Jya uhitamo uburyo bukwiriye • Ku mudasobwa y'umukinnyi: Jya ukoresha imikorere y'umukino ikoreshwa mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga. • Ku rindi koranabuhanga ryo mu rugo: Koresha aderesi ya LAN ya orudinateri. • Utabari mu rugo rwawe: Koresha aderesi yawe rusange cyangwa uburyo bw'umukino bwo gusanga/kwishyira hamwe.
Gufungura amakuru y'itumanaho ku nyandiko yatoranyijwe kugira ngo usuzume aho ihera. Aderesi ya LAN yihariye ntishobora gukoreshwa mu buryo butaziguye n'abakinnyi ba interineti.
GUTESHWA mu karere 1. Jya urindira ko umukino urangira. 2. Reba icyambu cyashyizweho n'imyanzuro y'uko seriveri yiteguye. 3. Jya wifatanya n'umuntu ukorera kuri orudinateri, hanyuma ujye wifatanya n'undi muyoboro wa LAN. 4. Niba LAN ikora nabi, reba mu gitabo cy'umukino no muri Firewall ya Windows kugira ngo urebe niba seriveri ikora neza.
Jya wemera abakinnyi ba interineti 1. Gutanga aderesi ya LAN ihamye, ubusanzwe ifite DHCP y'umuyoboro. 2. Menya inzugi zikenewe n'imikorere ya TCP/UDP igenewe imiterere y'umukino nyayo. 3. Jya kohereza izo mpapuro gusa kuri aderesi ya LAN y'umukoresha. 4. Jya wemera ko urujya n'uruza rw'imikino ruhuza na Windows Firewall kuri porogaramu z'urubuga ukoresha. 5. Ikigeragezo kivuye ku murongo wa interineti utandukanye n'uwa mbere.
Ntukemere ko umuterankunga akorera mu karere ka DMZ, cyangwa ngo ukemure umuriro w'umuriro, cyangwa ngo ugaragaze ko buri cyambu cy'ubuyobozi ari ikibazo rusange. Jya urinda amakuru y'umushinga w'umuyoboro mu ibanga.
Synix ni umuyobozi w'ibikoresho by'imashini. Ntabwo ikubiyemo umurongo wa interineti cyangwa ikoranabuhanga rya rusange rituma ibyo byifuzo by'urusobe bivanwaho.

data.name: Content.8B70E3569A9351B28D08
data.value:
SteamCMD ikuramo no kuvugurura dosiye za seriveri yihariye ku mikino ya Steam ishigikiwe. Synix yitegura kopi yacyo yahuriweho mu buryo bwikora; Gushyiraho seriveri isanzwe ntibikeneye tab ya SteamCMD yihariye.
JYA WIKURIKIRA Hitamo seriveri maze usome Activity & Diagnostics. Ibishushanyo byo ku kabati bigaragaza ko imirimo yo gushyiramo irimo ikorwa. SteamCMD ishobora guhinduka hagati yo gukuramo, gutanga, gufungura no kwemeza, bityo umusaruro wayo ntabwo uhora utanga umubare uhamye cyangwa igihe cyizerwa gisigaye.
Jya wemera ko disiki ikora neza n'iyo traffic yo ku murongo yagabanutse. Soma ubutumwa bwa nyuma bw'uko byagenze neza cyangwa ko byagenze nabi mbere yo gutangira ikindi gikorwa.
IGIHE cyo gukuramo Ibikoresho byuguruye → rusange → SteamCMD Gahunda yo gukuramo. Hitamo uburyo bufite aho bugarukira maze wandikire umuvuduko wagaragajwe, cyangwa uhitemo umuvuduko wuzuye.
Ibi bigira ingaruka ku mikoreshereze ya SteamCMD, ntabwo bigira ingaruka ku bufatanye bw'abakinnyi, kuri buri mukino utari uwa Steam, cyangwa ku bucuruzi bwose kuri PC.
Gushyiraho umukono n'ibyasenyutse Hari imyirondoro y'imikino isaba konti yemewe ya Steam no kwemezwa na Steam Guard. Gukoresha inyuguti yo kwinjira ya Synix; ntibashyiremo ibyangombwa by'ibaruramari mu nyandiko cyangwa mu raporo rusange.
Niba watsinze nabi, soma ikosa ry'ukuri rya SteamCMD maze urebe aho disiki ifite umwanya, uburyo bwo kugera muri dosiye, uburyo bwo kugera ku mbuga nkoranyambaga n'ibisabwa kuri konti. Kugenzura gushobora kongera gukuramo dosiye zikorerwamo abashyiraho, bityo ukomeze guhindura mbere yo kuyikoresha.

data.name: Content.9C3A77D42EDA0BF1010D
data.value:
Imimerere ya Empyrion n'imikorere y'ibikoresho byakoranyirizwagamo kode z'abakozi bitandukanye. Muri Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager, hitamo Empyrion scenarios cyangwa Empyrion server mods. Jya uhagarika seriveri maze ukore kopi yuzuye ya seriveri mbere yo kugira icyo uhindura.
Shyiraho inyandiko 1. Gusuzuma Catalogue byugurura Steam Workshop. Andikira iyi nkuru maze utegereze ko Steam irangiza kuyikuramo. Ibishushanyo mbonera n'ibikoresho byo mu nzu y'imikoranire si ibintu byakozwe kuri seriveri. 2. Hitamo Import Package, hanyuma hitamo Folder. Hitamo dosiye y'imimerere imwe n'imwe iri muri dosiye ya Steam yo mu bubiko bwawe bwa steamapps\workshop\content\383120. Ushobora no guhitamo inyandiko yuzuye ya ZIP. 3. Andika izina ry'ububiko bw'imimerere ushobora kumenya. Ntugakoreshe gusa inyandiko y'ibimenyetso ya Workshop. Jya ukomeza izina ry'uru rutonde rw'ibikoresho bya nyuma. 4. Jya usuzuma ibipimo by'ipaki n'aho ugiye, hanyuma wemeze ko winjiye. Synix yandika uko ibintu byose byagenze muri Content\Scenarios itarinze kubikora cyangwa guhindura isi. 5. Hitamo Scenario urutonde rw'imimerere yashyizweho. Hitamo imwe maze usuzume izina ry'urukurikirane ryihariye. Guhindukira ku byerekeranye n'indi mimerere bisaba izina rishya ritakoreshejwe ryo kubika; Synix igaragaza ko ari yo, igasiga ibitabo biriho bitagihungabanywa. 6. Jya ukoresha amahitamo, utume seriveri itangira, hanyuma usuzume inyandiko yayo n'umuyoboro w'umukiriya. Hari imimerere imwe n'imwe irimo ibindi bisobanuro cyangwa ibisabwa byanditswe n'umwanditsi wayo.
Izina ry'ikibazo ni GameConfig.CustomScenario; Izina ry'isi yaturutseho ni GameConfig.GameName. Synix yasubiza dedicated.yaml mbere yo guhindura aya mashyamba kandi ikomeza kwinjiza seriveri muri sync. Ntitugarura imiterere y'urupapuro rw'urubuga, amagambo y'ibanga cyangwa imiterere idashingiyeho.
Shyiraho uburyo bwa seriveri Jya ukoresha imyirondoro ya Mods yo kuri seriveri ya Empyrion na Import Package kugira ngo uhitemo mod ZIP yakozwe cyangwa dosiye yuzuye ya mod. Shyiramo DLL zayo, umutungo ushyigikiye, ibyo bishingiyeho, na _Info.yaml iyo byatanzwe. Synix ishyira ibi munsi ya Content\Mods; Iyo umukino watangiye, ushyiraho kode. Ibikoresho byo gukuramo kode y'ibanze n'abishyiramo ubwabo ntibikoreshwa.
Synix ntishyiramo mod loader cyangwa ngo itume mod idakora neza. Jya ukurikiza ibisabwa n'umwanditsi, harimo n'ibikoresho by'inyongera byo gupakira, uburyo bwo gutunganya ibintu no gushyiraho umukiriya. Kwinjiza neza ntibigaragaza ko mod ihuriye n'umukino uriho cyangwa indi mod yashyizweho.
UPDATES N'IGIHUNGU Steam ihindura kopi ya Workshop, ntabwo ihindura kopi ya seriveri yinjijwe na Synix. Kugira ngo usubize, uhagarike seriveri maze winjize paketi yuzuye ukoresheje izina ry'ububiko bw'imimerere imwe. Reba niba uwo mwanditsi akeneye gukiza. dosiye zasimbuwe zihabwa kopi z'inyongera; kwinjiza impinduka ntabwo ari ukuvugurura neza kandi ntabwo bihanagura dosiye zibuze muri paki nshya.
Gusuzuma urutonde rw'ibikoresho byuzuye aho kuba buri kintu. Byashyizweho (ntibigarukanwe) bivuga ko kwinjizwa kwanditswe, ntabwo ari uko dosiye zose zishyizweho ziherutse gusuzumwa. Roll Back Import isubika ibintu byose byatoranijwe, harimo n'ibindi bikoresho biri muri paki imwe, kandi yanze gusimbuza dosiye zahinduwe hanze ya Synix. Ibikoresho by'imiterere n'ibikoresho by'imiterere byatoranyijwe bikenewe n'isi zakijijwe birindwa gukurwaho; igishushanyo cyanditse gishobora kongera gushyirwa muri dosiye za mbere.

data.name: Content.9CA409AF86EBA5BEC5C1
data.value:
Fungura Configure → Network & RCON kugira ngo usuzume amanota y'iherezo ashyigikiwe n'umukino watowe. Jya ukoresha imiterere y'umukino, aho gukoresha urutonde rw'ibikoresho.
Ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga • Gahunda y'umukino: Umutekano w'abakinnyi. • Icyambu cy'igisubizo: Amakuru ya seriveri cyangwa ubushakashatsi, niba iyo protocole y'igisubizo ishyigikiwe. • RCON/admin port: Umuyoboro w'ubuyobozi utoroshye. • Porote ya App/API: Umufasha cyangwa serivisi y'ubuyobozi yihariye ku mukino.
TCP na UDP ni imikorere itandukanye. Porogaramu ebyiri zitandukanye zishobora gukoresha inomero imwe y'inkoranyambaga, ariko seriveri ebyiri ntizishobora gusangira interineti itandukanye yo kumva. Synix na yo igenzura imyirondoro yatanzwe ku bibazo by'amavuko, harimo no guhagarika inyandiko.
Kurinda imipaka y'imperuka ifite ubushobozi bwihariye ku bihe bitandukanye no kurinda imishyikirano yose igenewe umukino hagati y'ibibuga. Ntutekereze ko umukino wose ari wa UDP cyangwa ko buri gice cy'ikibazo kigereranya umutezi nyawe.
GUTEGEKA si umukino Ubusanzwe, abakinnyi ntibakeneye kugera kuri RCON cyangwa ahandi hantu ho kuyobora. Jya ukomeza kuyobora mu karere kawe keretse niba ufite gahunda yihariye yo kuyobora kure.
Ingero z'imikino • Minecraft Java na Bedrock zikoresha imyitwarire itandukanye yo guhuza; Jya ukurikiza inyandiko yatoranyijwe. • Satisfactory ya API ikoresha icyambu cyayo cyashyizweho cya game/API; Igiciro cyisumbuye cy'urusobe rw'igisubizo ntabwo ari itegeko ryiyongereye kuri Synix. • Metadata yo mu isambu y'igisubizo cya Dune igaragaza icyambu cyayo cyo gushyirwamo RMQ, ntabwo ari serivisi isanzwe y'igisubizo cya Steam A2S. • Rust+ ikoresha interineti yayo yo guherekeza uretse imikino.
Imyandikire y'ibanze y'igishushanyo ni indangagaciro zo gutangiza, si urutonde rwemewe rwo gufungura umuyoboro. Jya ugenzura umutezi nyawe mbere yo guhindura itegeko ry'urukuta rushinzwe kurinda.

data.name: Content.9D05F59E4F03A202388D
data.value: Dune: Awakening ikoresha sisitemu yemewe yo gushyiraho seriveri yihariye. Hyper-V na hardware virtualization bigomba kuba byemewe, kandi Windows Pro cyangwa Enterprise birakenewe. Mu gutangiza bwa mbere, Synix itangira battlegroup.bat nk'Umuyobozi. Hitamo initial-setup maze witegure icyapa cyawe cyitwa Self-Host. Synix irashobora gushyiraho, kuvugurura, gukora ubufasha bwa back-up, no gutangiza ibikorwa byo gushyiramo, ariko umukino ni wo ufite imashini ziboneka n'imikorere yazo. Ubuyobozi bwemewe: https://duneawakening.com/en/news/dedicated-server-how-to-guide

data.name: Content.A2B1D27FE31D2DC1D587
data.value:
Discord webhooks kohereza ibyabaye kuri seriveri runaka ku murongo. Ni itangazo, si robot Discord yo kugenzura kure Synix.
Jya ushyiraho intego 1. Kora cyangwa ubone urubuga rwa interineti rw'umuyoboro wemerewe kuyobora. 2. Fungura urubuga rwo gutunganya → Discord kuri seriveri yatoranyijwe. 3. Fata urubuga rwa interineti maze uhitemo amahitamo yo kuyobora ibyabaye. 4. Jya ushyiraho urutonde. 5. Gukoresha uburyo bwo kugerageza niba byatanzwe, cyangwa kwemeza gutanga mu gihe cy'igikorwa giteganyijwe.
Ubutumwa bwo gutangiza, guhagarika, kugarura, gukora ubufasha bwa backup no kubungabunga bushingiye ku mihanda yagejejweho no kumenya niba icyo gikorwa cyabayeho koko.
MURINDIRIZE UBUGENGE bwa interineti URL ya webhook ikubiyemo ibyangombwa byo gushyiraho. Umuntu wese uyibona ashobora kohereza ubutumwa kuri iyo televiziyo. Jya wirinda gufata amashusho ya televiziyo, ibiganiro, inyandiko n'ibiganiro.
Synix irinda urubuga rwayo rwanditseho ukoresha Windows. Niba URL ihishuriwe, jya uyisubiramo cyangwa uyikure muri Discord, hanyuma uherutse kuvugurura aho Synix iherereye. Reba amazina ya seriveri n'amakuru y'ibyabaye yohererejwe umuyoboro usanzwe.
Niba ubutumwa butagezeho Reba inzira y'igikorwa cyatoranijwe, URL, uburyo bwa televiziyo/webhook, kandi urebe niba PC ishobora kugera kuri Discord. Jya usuzuma ikosa ryavuzwe utarinze gushyira ahabona URL yuzuye.
Amatangazo akoresha ikoranabuhanga ryo kujya hanze kuri Discord. Si ngombwa ko bafunguye icyambu cy'ubuyobozi bw'umuyoboro ugenda imbere.

data.name: Content.AC2F6ED0F16118E96232
data.value:
Iyemeze niba ukuraho igikoresho cyonyine cy'ubuyobozi cyangwa niba ugahanagura burundu seriveri zawe. Ibyo ni ibintu bitandukanye.
KUKURA gusa porogaramu 1. Jya urangiza ibyo washyizeho, ibyo uherutse kwimura cyangwa ibyo ukoresha. 2. Jya uhagarika seriveri zawe ukoresheje Synix, utegereze ko zirangiza kubika, hanyuma usohoke muri Synix. 3. Jya ugumana kopi yemewe y'isi z'ingenzi, amakarita yo gushyiraho ibintu n'amazina y'uruhushya. 4. Jya ukuraho Synix ukoresheje porogaramu za Windows zashyizweho cyangwa umuyobozi wawe w'ibikoresho.
Jya urinda C:\Synix, udupapuro tw'ibikoresho bya seriveri, udupapuro tw'imikino two hanze, n'imyanya y'ububiko niba ushaka kuzongera kubikoresha. Kwongera gushyiraho porogaramu si ngombwa ko uhanagura izo dosiye.
Jya ukuraho umukozi umwe Koresha igikorwa cyo Guhanagura cya seriveri yatoranyijwe muri Synix maze usome ibyemeza. Gukuraho inyandiko y'urupapuro rw'umwimerere si kimwe no kwemera gusiba dosiye zishinzwe gushyirwamo cyangwa gufata kopi z'ububiko. Reba neza amakuru azakurwaho.
Ntukoreshe gusiba nk'inzira ngufi yo gukemura ibibazo. Ububiko bw'ibanze bubitswe gusa muri dosiye ugiye gusiba si kopi yo gusubiramo.
Niba ugiye mu yindi porogaramu yo kugenzura, ujye wemeza ko ishobora gutangiza neza iyo porogaramu kandi utange urubuga wifuza mbere yo gukuraho amakuru yawe ya kera.

Hitamo ingingo iri ibumoso kugira ngo usome amabwiriza arimo. Ingingo zose z'ubufasha zikora offline mu rurimi wahisemo.
Ese uri mushya muri SYNIX? Fungura Inzira yo Gutangira Gutangira no Gutangira Gutangira.
MBESE, ushobora gukoresha seriveri? Hitamo urutonde rw'ibyo ugomba gukora, urugero nko gutunganya ibintu, gushyikirana n'abantu mu buryo bwa interineti, gukora kopi z'ububiko cyangwa gutegeka umukino runaka.
Ese urimo ushakisha ikosa? Kanda kuri Ctrl+F maze ushakishe ikintu runaka, umukino cyangwa igice gito cy'ubutumwa. Gushakisha bigenzura imitwe y'ingingo n'umwandiko wose, kandi bigatuma ubona umwandiko uhuye n'uwo mwandiko.
Jya ukoresha buto yo gushakisha kugira ngo usubire ku ngingo zose. Fungura no gushyigikira imyirondoro ifunguye mu mushakisha yawe gusa igihe uhitamo.

data.name: Content.B6FC67DB36AEA1C2C9E1
data.value: ATLAS ikeneye urubuga rwa seriveri rwoherejwe hanze hamwe na database ya Redis irimo mbere yuko ShooterGameServer.exe ishobora gutangira. Synix izahagarika gutangiza kugeza igihe ShooterGame\ServerGrid.json na ShooterGame\ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json zizaba zihari. Kora grid ukoresheje Grapeshot Games ServerGridEditor yemewe, ushyire dosiye zombi muri dossier ya ShooterGame, hanyuma utange AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat mbere yo gutangiza seriveri ya ATLAS. Redis igomba kuguma mu karere ka 127.0.0.1 kandi icyambu cya 6379 ntikigomba gushyirwa kuri interineti.

data.name: Content.B9AD3A6BF122B35896B1
data.value:
Hitamo seriveri maze ukoreshe ibikoresho byo gupima imishyikirano cyangwa iby'umukinnyi igihe bihari. Synix ihitamo ibyo igenzura hakurikijwe ikibazo cyatewe inkunga n'umukino, TCP / UDP / HTTP, API yo mu karere, hamwe n'ubushobozi bw'imikorere.
Icyo ibyo bisobanura Igisubizo cyo guhuza ku rwego rwo hasi ntabwo kigaragaza ko umukinnyi ashobora kwemeza no kwifatanya. Nanone kandi, uburyo bwo gushakisha bukorwa mu buryo bwa bwite ntibugaragaza ko serivisi y'ubushakashatsi iteganyijwe.
Umubare w'abakinnyi n'amazina y'abakinnyi ni ubushobozi butandukanye. Serveri ishobora gutanga raporo y'abakinnyi bangahe bashyizwe kuri interineti, itarashyira ahagaragara urutonde rw'abakinnyi. Urutonde rw'abakinnyi rufite ubusa si urw'abakinnyi b'abaherwe.
Ibikoresho bya HIDDEN OR N/A Hari imikorere ya EOS gusa cyangwa yo gukina hakoreshejwe interineti idashyira ahagaragara ibibazo byiringirwa cyangwa uburyo bwo kuyobora umukinnyi. Synix ishobora kwerekana N/A cyangwa gusiba ikigeragezo aho kugaragaza igisubizo kiyobya.
Reba inyandiko yatoranyijwe n'umuyoboro wo gucunga wateguwe wa Minecraft. Umubare w'umukinnyi wa Satisfactory ushingiye ku bufatanye bwa local API. Ntukagire impamyabumenyi za EOS zigenewe abahanga gusa kugira ngo uhatire gukora ikizamini.
INKURU z'ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga Imikino myinshi ya Steam ikoresha ibibazo bya A2S, ariko ibyo si ibintu bisanzwe. Kwiyandikisha, imiterere y'umukino n'umurimo ukorerwa mu mushakisha bigira ingaruka ku bigaragara, kandi nta gihe gihamye cyo gushyiraho urutonde.
Niba hari seriveri itari mu mushakisha, gerageza uburyo umukino uhuza na wo mu buryo butaziguye maze usuzume inyandiko yawo. Guhindura incuro nyinshi inzugi z'ibishakashusho zidafite aho zihuriye bishobora guteza ibibazo by'inyongera.

2. Jya uhindura 'dedicatedServerConfig.xml' kugira ngo usobanure ijambo ry'ibanze ry'ubuyobozi bwa interineti n'amazina y'ububiko yo kubika.

data.name: Content.BDCE626AE85DA5ADC9CD
data.value:
Koresha Gushyiraho imirima rusange Synix igenzura. Koresha umuhuzabikorwa wa dosiye yo gushushanya muri Server Options igihe ukeneye gusuzuma cyangwa guhindura imiterere y'umukino.
1. Uhagarike seriveri niba isoma dosiye iyo itangiye cyangwa ikayandika mu gihe ikora. 2. Kora kopi y'ibikoresho by'ububiko maze wemeze ko wahisemo seriveri n'ifoto. 3. Soma imibare n'ibitekerezo biriho. 4. Jya uhindura imiterere ushaka guhindura gusa. 5. Jya ukemura amakosa y'ubuhinduzi kandi usuzume imiburo itanga. 6. Fungura, utange seriveri ukoresheje Synix, maze urebe inyandiko y'umukino.
Imyitozo y'ibikoresho Synix itanga imikorere ijyanye n'uburyo bwo gutunganya imiterere ya INI/imico yemewe, JSON, XML, YAML, nibindi byuma byihariye. Si ko buri dosiye cyangwa amahitamo yose afite umwanditsi ushinzwe. Guhindura YAML bishyigikira imiterere yashyizweho, urutonde rwashyizweho, n'ibiciro byumurongo umwe mugihe kubika ibitekerezo no gushyirwamo. Ibikoresho byimbitse bya YAML nka anchors, aliases, inline collections, na multiline values birabuzwa nta kubika.
Jya ukoresha imfunguzo z'ibikoresho, ibiciro byemewe, amazina y'ikarita n'amabwiriza nk'uko umukino ubiteze. Ntugahindure ayo magambo ngo ahwanye n'ururimi rw'uruhererekane.
GUTEGEKA si ikigeragezo Iyo dosiye ifite imiterere myiza ishobora gukomeza kuba irimo imiterere idashyize mu gaciro. Imyitozo cyangwa imyanzuro y'imikino bishobora kongeramo ibintu umuhuzabikorwa adashobora kumenya. Reba niba umukino warashe dosiye yagenewe n'isi nyuma yo kongera kuyitangira.
Niba hari umwanditsi cyangwa umukino uhinduye dosiye mugihe ifunguye, kandaho ubundi ugereranye mbere yo kubika. Imyandikire y'umukino ishobora kuba ikubiyemo amagambo asomwa cyangwa ibimenyetso; jya ubisuzuma kandi ubyandike mbere yo kubishyira mu bikorwa.
SatisfactoryNi muzima API amahitamo ari mu Kigo cy'Igenzura kandi atandukanye no guhindura dosiye z'ibikorerwa kuri disiki.

data.name: Content.C3732C45553C69AA02C1
data.value:
Hitamo Gushyiraho seriveri ikiriho, cyangwa ukoreshe idirishya ryo gushyiraho igihe urimo kuyishyiraho. Jya uhindura imirima ikoreshwa mu mukino wawe gusa.
INTEGO N'IBIKURU BYAGENZE Uburyo bwo gutangiza bushimangira imiterere rusange n'ubuyobozi bwatanzwe bwo gutangiza. Uburyo bwateye imbere bwerekana ibindi bikoresho by'ubugenzuzi by'ikoranabuhanga, harimo RCON ishyigikiwe n'amahitamo yo gutangiza ku giti cyabo. Guhindura imiterere ntabwo bihanagura ibiciro byabitswe. Amabwiriza ya Discord ashobora kuboneka muri buri buryo.
Icyo buri paji isuzuma • rusange: Izina rya seriveri, umukino, inyandiko / verisiyo, n'amahitamo y'imiterere y'umukino ashyigikiwe. • Umutekano: Password n'ibindi byiciro byo kwinjira bishyigikiwe n'igishushanyo. • Urubyiruko rw'isi: Izina ry'isi, imbuto, uburebure n'ibisubizo byatanzwe ku isi. • Ikoranabuhanga & RCON: Inkino zashyigikiwe, ikibazo, mugenzi/API, n'ibice by'imperuka by'ubuyobozi. • Automation: Backup/update-on-start n'ubwiteganyirize buteganyijwe. • Discord: Ibice byo gutangariza n'uburyo bwo gutangiza ibitaramo. • Gushyiraho & Gutangiza: Folda yo gushyiramo n'amahitamo yo gutangiza ashyigikiwe.
Imirimo y'imikino yihariye itemewe n'amategeko ni ku bushake. Umukino ushobora kuba ufite uwo mubumbe cyangwa ukaba udafite ubufasha; Gushyiraho imvugo y'inyongera ku buyobozi si uburyo bwiza bwo kubusimbuza.
IBIBAZO BYA BINE Amakuru ya seriveri → Amabwiriza asabwa → Gusuzuma → Kurinda seriveri
Ibyo bigaragaza ko imiterere y'ibikoresho biteguye, ariko ntibigaragaza uko gukuramo cyangwa gushyiramo byateye imbere. Iyo imiterere ikenewe imaze kwemerwa, Synix ifungura intambwe 3 kugirango ushobore gusuzuma amahitamo yawe, hanyuma ukingura Save Server. Guhindura imiterere y'ibikoresho by'imashini Gukuraho kugeza igihe amahitamo yavuguruwe agaragaye muri Review. Ugomba guhitamo kurokora ubuzima bwawe; Gufungura Review ntibizigera bifasha. Jya usoma ubutumwa buri hasi ku ipaji igihe hari ikintu gikeneye kwitabwaho.
Mu gihe utegura seriveri, ujye uyireka mbere na mbere niba iryo hinduka ryangiza dosiye cyangwa amahitamo asomwa mu gihe cyo gutangiza. Kurinda impinduka bivugurura imyirondoro yayo; nta gihamya y'uko umukino w'umukino wo kwiruka washyize mu bikorwa ayo mahame. Jya usubira muri Synix igihe umukino ubisaba.

data.name: Content.CBFC11B8C03869110CF7
data.value:
Ibuka Gushyiraho → Automation kugira ngo seriveri yatoranijwe ihitamo akazi kagenda mbere yo gutangira gushyigikirwa.
Gusubiza ibintu mu buryo Jya ukoresha ubwo buryo kugira ngo ushyireho seriveri yahagaritswe mbere yo gutangira gukora. Shyira inkomoko ya sauvegarde n'ibikoresho byo kubika muri porogaramu Imikorere → Backup.
Gusubiza ibintu mu buryo bitagenze neza bitangira gutinda ku bikorwa bisanzwe by'ubufasha. Ibikoresho by'ububiko byikora byo gutangiza ntabwo bisimbura gukomeza ibisubizo byigenga mbere y'impinduka zikomeye.
UPDATE KU ITANGIRIRO Jya ukora ibi kugira ngo ukore igenzura ry'iminsi mikuru y'umukino ushyigikiwe mbere yo gutangira. Ivugurura dosiye za seriveri y'umukino, si porogaramu ya Synix.
Gusuzuma amakuru y'ubutaha si isezerano ry'uko buri muntu wese ubanza gukuramo dosiye. SteamCMD n'umushinjacyaha w'umukino barafata umwanzuro w'icyo gikenewe.
AMAKURU N'AMAFOTO y'ABAGENZI Igikorwa cyo kwemeza gitangwa ku bushake gishobora gusana cyangwa kongera gukuramo dosiye zikorerwamo n'ishyirahamwe. Gukomeza guhindura ibintu mbere yo kubishyira ahagaragara cyangwa kubishyira mu bikorwa; ntutekereze ko dosiye z'umuntu ku giti cye zihora zitagira icyo zigeraho.
GERAGEZA ibyo wahisemo Jya ucungura imiterere maze ukore intangiriro yifashishijwe. Soma ibisubizo by'ibikorwa kugira ngo ushobore kubikoresha, kubisuzuma no gutangiza. Iyo umukino urangiye gukuramo, ntibigaragaza ko warangije kuwukoresha neza.
Jya utanga umwanya uhagije wo kubika inyandiko, kuzishyira kuri interineti, dosiye z'agateganyo n'umukino washyizweho. Niba akazi gatangiye mbere yo gutangira kavuze ko hari ikibazo, ujye usuzuma impamvu yagaragajwe aho gutangiza seriveri imwe hanze ya Synix kugira ngo uyirenge.

data.name: Content.CD4007BB408F0C6825C6
data.value: Fungura Documents\American Truck Simulator\config.cfg maze ushyire g_console "1". Tangira umukino usanzwe wa American Truck Simulator, wikorere imyirondoro yawe n'ikarita, ukande ~ kugirango ufungure console, hanyuma ukore export_server_packages. Funga umukino, hanyuma ukande kuri Synix kongera gutangira. Synix izinjiza dosiye zakozwe byihuse.

data.name: Content.CEBB295EB1521FABB36D
data.value:
Gufungura witeguye kuri seriveri yatoranijwe mbere yo gutangira cyangwa igihe hari icyo kitagenda neza. Igereranya ibyo bigenzurwa n'iyo porogaramu, urugero nka dosiye, igihe cyo gukora, imiterere, umwanya wa disiki, ibyambu, imiterere y'imikorere, n'ibitabo bijyanye.
Sobanukirwa uko byagenze • Gushyiraho imihati: nta kibazo cy'ubudahangarwa cyabonetse mu byiciro byagenwe. • Gusuzuma: Soma ibyo wabonye maze uhitemo niba hari icyo ukeneye gukora. • Barahagaritswe: Mbere yo gukomeza, jya ukemura ikibazo cyavuzwe.
Kuba witeguye ntibikora buri gikorwa cyo gusana giteganyijwe. Gusuzuma igikorwa giteganyijwe n'uko cyemejwe.
Nyuma yo guhindura imyirondoro yawe Intangiriro ya mbere irashobora gukuramo dosiye, gushyiraho igihe cyo gukora gifashishwa, gukora imiterere, no gutegereza ko umukino utangira. Jya ukurikiza amabwiriza yo gutangiza bwa mbere na Activity & Diagnostics aho gufata inyandiko ya dashboard yabitswe nk'umukino wishyizweho.
Imikino imwe n'imwe ikeneye amasezerano, kwemezwa ko ari ukuri, cyangwa gushyiraho uburyo bwo gusaba / kwicara mu mukino mbere yuko umuntu wese yifatanya. Kurangiza iyo ntambwe aho umukino usaba.
GUTEGURWA kw'ubushyize mu gaciro Synix yagaragaje ibikorwa byo kwinjiza, gutangiza, guhagarika no gukurikirana. Nta gihamya igaragaza ko ibivugwa muri iyo raporo ari ukuri; ibyo ntibishatse kuvuga ko umukino uzwiho kuba warasenyutse.
Igisubizo cyiteguye cyangwa igenzura rirangwa n'ibyishimo mu karere si gihamya y'uko umuntu ashobora kugera kuri interineti, ko afite uburyo bwiza bwo gukoresha cyangwa ko ashyikirana na buri mukiriya. Hanyuma, ujye ugerageza kureba aho ugiye guhuza abantu n'isi.

data.name: Content.D04B8B2F340C3B82596E
data.value:
Igikoresho cy'ububiko cya seriveri yatoranijwe kirinda dosiye ziri muri dosiye yo gushyiraho iyo seriveri. Reba aho umukino uhungira isi mbere yo kuwushingiraho.
Jya usubira inyuma 1. Jya uhagarika seriveri ukoresheje Synix maze utegereze ko inzira zayo zivaho. 2. Hitamo igikorwa cy'ububiko bw'umwirondoro muri Server Options. 3. Suzuma aho uherereye, aho uherereye, urugero rw'aho uherereye n'aho uri ku disiki. 4. Wemeze kandi utegereze ko ibyo birangira. 5. Hitamo dosiye y'ububiko (Open Backup Folder) kugira ngo urebe aho ari. Jya ujyana icyangombwa cy'ubudahemuka.
GUSHYA Ibikoresho by'ububiko birimo dosiye y'ishyirirwaho, aho kuba subfolder nto yo kubika gusa. Imikino mikuru ishobora gusaba igihe kinini no kubika ibintu.
Amabiko yo muri AppData, Documents, indi disiki, cyangwa imashini y'umukino ushobora kuba uri hanze y'iyo dosiye. Jya ushyigikira izo nkunga ukoresheje uburyo umukino ushyigikiye.
AHABAYEHO N'AHO BACUMIYE Umuzi usanzwe w'ububiko ni C:\Synix\BackupGames. Imikorere → Backup igufasha guhitamo umuzi wundi no gushyira imipaka yo kubika.
Icyerekezo kigomba kuba hanze y'inkoramutima ya seriveri y'ibanze. Guhindura inkomoko y'ububiko ntibihindure cyangwa ngo bice inyandiko z'ibikoresho biriho; gerageza kureba aho hantu ha kera kugira ngo urebe uko byagenze.
Gucungura bivanaho inyandiko za kera igihe imipaka yashyizweho irenze mu gihe cy'irema ry'ibikoresho by'ubufasha. Jya urinda ahantu ho kuvura burundu hanze y'aho bakorera.
Gushyiraho kopi y'ibindi bintu by'ingenzi mu bubiko butandukanye. Disiki idakora neza ishobora gusenya seriveri n'ibikoresho by'ububiko byabaga kuri disiki imwe. ZIP yikarita yo kwimura hanze ntabwo ari icyangombwa gihoraho cya VM cyangwa ububiko bw'amakuru.

data.name: Content.D2EE952679F0F36E81E6
data.value:
Soma neza ubutumwa bwa Windows mbere yo guhitamo icyo ugomba guhindura. Igikoresho cyagenwe, ikosa ryo kubona dosiye n'igihe cyo gukina umukino wabuze ni ibibazo bitandukanye.
SYNIX ntizashyirwaho cyangwa ngo ifungurwe Jya ukoresha inyandiko yemewe cyangwa igitabo cya WinGet ubidzz.Synix. Niba usimbuye dosiye uvuze ko kugera kwabujijwe, gufunga icyitegererezo cya Synix ukoresheje iyo nzira bisanzwe maze wongere ugerageze. Suzuma uburyo bwo kugera mu makarita n'ubutumwa bw'ibikoresho by'umutekano niba ikibazo cyakomeje.
Ntuzice data ya seriveri cyangwa ngo uhagarike kurinda nk'igikorwa cyo gusana rusange.
IGIHIMBA cy'urusobe (Smart screen) Umuburo w'icyubahiro ushobora gutanga amakuru menshi → Kwiruka uko byagenda kose, bitewe n'amategeko ya Windows. Kuba hari ubwo buryo ntibigaragaza ko dosiye ifite umutekano. Jya ugenzura aho isoko ry'ibanze ryavuye kandi ugire ubushakashatsi ku muburo mbere yo gufata umwanzuro w'uko wakomeza.
UBUGENGE bwa porogaramu ya SMART Ibi bishobora kubuza porogaramu iyo Windows idashobora gushinga icyizere gihagije. Mu by'ukuri, nta buryo bwo gusimbuka bwa buri porogaramu bushobora kugereranywa na Run ya SmartScreen. Ntukemere ko ibintu by'umutekano bya Windows bikoreshwa gusa mu gutangiza Synix.
Ibirwanisho bya virusi cyangwa hash Sobanukirwa neza uko byagenze. Ntutekereze ko iyo raporo ari iy'ibinyoma kuko dosiye yitwa Synix. Hash SHA-256 ihuriyeho igaragaza dosiye yakuwe; ntabwo ishyiraho icyizere cyangwa gushyira umukono kuri code.
Tanga raporo y'uburyo butunganye bwo kuburira no gushyiramo, ukuraho ibisobanuro by'ibanga. Kwirinda gutandukanya abantu n'abandi cyangwa kwirengagiza igenzura rya hash y'abashyiramo.

data.name: Content.DEF7504305FCA62C7644
data.value:
Koresha Imyitozo → Ibikoresho by'ubudehe kugira ngo usohore Synix yose. Ibyo bitandukanye no kwandikisha dosiye imwe y'umukozi uriho.
REBA icyo ugomba gukora Igiti cy'ibanze cya C:\Synix ni cyo gikoreshwa mu kohereza ibicuruzwa. Seriveri yihariye cyangwa amabanki y'ububiko hanze yayo n'ibikoresho byo hanze by'umukino bikenera gukoreshwa byihariye. Kora urutonde rw'inzira zabo mbere yo gutangira. Imyanya isanzwe ya Windows ishobora no gukenerwa gusuzumwa ku cyerekezo.
GUTUMWA mu mahanga 1. Jya uhagarika seriveri kandi urangize imirimo yo kubungabunga, gukuramo no kuvugurura. 2. Hitamo gucuruza mu buryo bwashyizwe muri koderi cyangwa mu buryo busanzwe. 3. Hitamo icyerekezo kiri hanze y'igiti cy'ibanze maze usuzume ibipimo n'ibisabwa ku mwanya by'agateganyo. 4. Kugira ngo usohore ibicuruzwa byashyizwe muri kode, hitamo ijambo ry'ibanga rikomeye ryo kwimura maze uririnde mu buryo butandukanye. 5. Jya utegereza ko igitabo cya .synixbackup kirangiza, hanyuma ugisuzume.
Hitamo uburyo bukwiriye bwo kurindwa Gushyira hanze kwashyizwe muri kodegisi birinda ipaki kandi bigashyigikira kwimura ibyangombwa byemewe kuri konti Windows iteganyijwe.
Ubucuruzi busanzwe bw'ibyo bihugu ntibuhurizwa muri za code. Ibitabo by'imikino n'ibitabo biri muri byo bishobora guhishura amabanga. Gukopera indangagaciro za Windows zashyizwe muri encrypt ntabwo ubwabyo bituma zishobora gukoreshwa mu yindi konti.
Kwinjiza mu mahanga 1. Mbere na mbere, kora kopi y'amakuru ya Synix y'aho ugiye. 2. Fungura ibipimo byo kwinjiza/gushakisha maze uhitemo igihombo cyateganijwe. 3. Tanga ijambo ry'ibanga ryo kwimura iyo usabye kandi wemeze ko ibyangombwa byatanzwe. 4. Jya usuzuma aho ugiye, ibyo disiki ikenera, kandi usubireho imiburo. 5. Jya ureka ibikorwa byo gushyira ibintu mu mwanya wa mbere, kubishyira mu bikorwa no kubigorora birangire. 6. Mbere yo gutangira ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose, jya ugenzura inzira za seriveri, inzugi, imiterere y'akazi, ahantu hashingiwe, n'amazina y'icyubahiro.
Shyira Satisfactory ku murongo niba ubwenegihugu bwayo bwo mu karere cyangwa ikoranabuhanga ryihariye ritakiriho. Jya urinda ako gatabo k'umwimerere n'amakuru ya kera kugeza igihe abaserveri bavuye mu mahanga bazageragezwa.
Kwimuka kw'amakuru gushyigikiwe kurinda kopi y'urubuga rw'ibanze rwa data mbere yo kwimuka. Niba kwinjiza cyangwa kwimuka bitagenze neza, komeza iyo kopi n'ubutumwa bwo kugarura aho gusimbuza urubuga rw'amakuru rukora mugihe Synix ikora.

data.name: Content.E03D856AEDD6B1B81DFD
data.value:
Install & Launch ikubiyemo dosiye ya seriveri yatoranyijwe n'amahitamo yayo yo gutangiza ashyigikiwe. Jya ukurikiza itegeko ryatanzwe keretse niba usobanukiwe imvugo y'ikiganiro cyo muri uwo mukino.
IBIBAZO byo gusesengura Koresha uburyo bwateye imbere igihe hakenewe impaka zidakemutse. Jya ureba ibivugwamo, inzira ushobora gukoresha n'amazina y'amahitamo asabwa n'umukino. Synix yamaze gutanga ibitekerezo byashyigikiwe n'ubuyobozi; kongera kopi y'ikindi gitabo bishobora gutuma habaho imiterere itandukanye.
Ntugahindure ibyoherereza cyangwa ngo usimbure agaciro k'ikoranabuhanga riteganyijwe n'itangazo ryacyo ryasobanuwe. Ntuzigere wongera amazina y'uruhererekane ku itegeko kugira ngo woroshye kurikopera.
Imyandikire y'ibitabo by'imfashanyigisho Kubijyanye na porogaramu zifashishwa, Serveur Options → Create Batch File yandika itegeko ryo gutangiza ryatorewe umuti kuri script.
Iyo dosiye ishobora kuba irimo amagambo y'ibanga cyangwa ibimenyetso by'umurimo bishobora gusomwa kugira ngo ishobore gukoreshwa mu buryo bwigenga. Jya ubishyira mu mwanya wawe kandi ubisuzume mbere yo kubishyira hamwe cyangwa kubimura.
Gukoresha inyandiko hanze ya Synix ntabwo bitanga imfunguzo zose z'imikorere ya Synix, guhuza imbwa y'umurinzi, kubika cyangwa kwitabwaho kuri gahunda. Ntimukagikorere mugihe Synix ifite uwo mushakisha urimo gukora.
INTEGO z'ubucuruzi zo hanze Hari imyirondoro y'imikino ishyiraho ibikoresho byayo byo gushyira mu bikorwa aho gukoresha seriveri imwe isanzwe. Ibyo bikoresho bishobora gusaba uruhushya rwihariye kandi ntibishobora gushyigikira kohereza dosiye yo gutangiza. Jya ukurikiza igitabo cy'imikino cy'uruhererekane aho gusimbuza ikindi gikoreshwa cyangwa igipfunyika.

data.name: Content.EA307763F93AA4306555
data.value:
Jya ukoresha uburyo bwemewe bwo gutanga umusanzu. Rikubiyemo igihe cyo gutangiza .NET gikenewe na Synix; seriveri z'imikino zishobora kuba zikeneye ibisabwa.
Hitamo uburyo bwo gushyiramo • MSI: Vanaho SynixSetup.msi, uyikorere, hanyuma ufungure Panel yo kugenzura Synix muri menu yo gutangira. Aho hashyiriweho porogaramu isanzwe ku mukoresha ni %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. • WinGet: Koresha ifunguro ryuzuye ubidzz.Synix. Ingingo ya WinGet Gushyiraho no kuvugurura ikubiyemo amategeko. • Igikoresho cyikora ku giti cyacyo: Shyira kopi y'igitabo cyanditse ku giti cyacyo muri dosiye ishobora kwandikwa maze uyishyiremo. Kwimura icyo gikoresho cyagenzurwa si uguhereza seriveri zawe burundu.
Amajwi y'ibitabo byashyizwe ahagaragara: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases/latest
GUSUBIRA APPLICATION 1. Jya urangiza gukuramo ibitabo, gukora kopi z'ibikoresho by'ububiko no kubitaho. 2. Jya uhagarika seriveri z'imikino yawe ukoresheje Synix maze ufunge Synix nk'uko bisanzwe. 3. Jya ukoresha imashini yo kuvugurura cyangwa yo gushyiramo ibikoresho mu buryo wahisemo bwo kubishyiraho. 4. Jya wongera gufungura Synix maze urebe niba inyandiko za seriveri yawe n'inzira zawe ari ukuri.
Niba usimbuye porogaramu ya kera ishingiye kuri EXE na MSI, jya ubanza ukuraho porogaramu ya kera. Jya ubika amakuru y'ikipe n'ibikoresho by'ikipe. Ntukamareho C:\Synix kugira ngo uheruke porogaramu.
Iyo porogaramu iherutse kuvugururwa ntishobora kuvugurura imikino mukinisha. Koresha igikorwa cyo kuvugurura kuri seriveri yatoranyijwe kugira ngo ukore ibyo.
Niba Windows ivuga ko igihe cyo gusimbuza icyangombwa cy'ikoranabuhanga cyanze, reba niba kopi isimbuzwa itakiri gukora. Ntukandikeho porogaramu irimo gukoreshwa cyangwa ngo ukureho amakuru ya seriveri kugira ngo ukemure ikosa.

data.name: Content.F77CEDCB39BB6AFDDB17
data.value:
Synix igenzura umuvuduko w'umutungo mbere yo gutangiza bimwe mu byo ikora kugira ngo igabanure ibyago byo kurenza ubushobozi bwa host. Niba gutangira byatinze cyangwa byarahagaritswe, soma ikibazo cy'umutungo cyavuzwe.
Jya uha icyumba nyir'inzu Jya wemera kwibuka Windows n'ibikoresho by'imbere ndetse n'umukino. Jya ukoresha disiki kugira ngo ushobore kubona amakuru agezweho, dosiye z'agateganyo, amacapiro n'ibikoresho by'ububiko.
Umutungo wo kwibuka Minecraft washyizweho ugira ingaruka ku mukino / igihe cyo gukora. Ntabwo ari iherezo ry'ibanze ry'imikorere yose yatangijwe n'umukino wose.
Kugenzura umutungo ntibituma seriveri ishyirwa muri konteyini ya CPU/RAM cyangwa ngo byemeze ko Windows itazigera irangira umutungo. Jya ukoresha imboneshakure y'ibikoresho n'ibigereranyo by'ibikoresho byose bya PC kugira ngo usobanukirwe umutwaro nyawo.
UMURINZI W'Umurongo Igishushanyo cyo kuburira ikoranabuhanga kigenzura imiterere idasanzwe ya bandwidth/ibikoresho kandi gifata ibikorwa bizwi bya SteamCMD kugirango bigabanuke imiburo y'ibinyoma.
Si urukuta rushinzwe kurinda abantu, filtre y'umuhanda cyangwa serivisi yo kurinda DDoS. Ibitekerezo by'abantu bitanga amakuru ntibigaragaza uwakoze igitero cyangwa ngo bigaragaze ko habaye igitero.
Iyo ugiye kubimenya, gereranya ibyo ukora n'ibikoresho ushobora gukuramo, ibyo ukoresha mu buryo bw'ububiko n'ibindi bikoreshwa. Jya usuzuma inyandiko zifite aho zihuriye mbere yo guhindura imiterere y'umutekano cyangwa imiterere y'umuyoboro.

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Hitamo imyirondoro ya Rust hanyuma usuzume isi yayo, ubwiyandarike, umukino, ikibazo, n'ibishushanyo bya mugenzi we mbere yo gutangira.
UMWANZUZI WA SERVER Synix itanga agaciro ka +server.identity gashyigikiwe kuva kuri seriveri. Jya ukoresha imiterere itandukanye n'ibimenyetso bitandukanye kugira ngo ibyo bimenyetso bitabaye ngombwa ko bihuza isi cyangwa imiterere.
RUST+ Shyiraho Porogaramu yihariye ya Porogaramu ishyigikiwe kuri serivisi y'umufatanyabikorwa, hanyuma ukurikize ibyo Rust isaba guhuza no gukora imbuga. Icyiciro cya nyuma cyayo gitandukanye na gameplay y'umukinnyi n'ubuyobozi bwemewe bwa RCON.
Jya ureba inzugi z'ukuri zashyizweho aho gukoporora itegeko ku wundi mushakisha wa Rust. Kurinda impamyabumenyi za RCON kandi ntuzashyirwe ahagaragara kugira ngo ufashe abantu kwifatanya.
VANILLA NA OXIDE Vanilla akoresha dosiye za seriveri zemewe. Guhitamo Oxide yongeyeho uburyo busanzwe bwemewe nyuma ya dosiye Steam. Gushyiraho Framework ntihitamo cyangwa gusuzuma plugins zinyuranye.
Koresha imikorere y'imikorere ya Mod & Plugin Manager ifashwa mu cyiciro cy'akazi ku ishyirwaho rya Oxide / uMod ryamenyekanye. Ibikoresho by'imfashanyigisho biracyakeneye verisiyo zihuza n'ibisubizo by'ukuri.
Synix yongeye gushyira mu bikorwa igihe cy'ikoranabuhanga rya Oxide cyifashishijwe nyuma yo kuvugurura Rust cyangwa kwemeza iyo sisitemu yatoranyijwe. Kugira ngo usubire muri dosiye za Vanilla zemewe, hindura ihitamo ry'igiterane maze ushyire mu bikorwa gahunda yo kuvugurura cyangwa kwemeza.
Mbere y'uko ihuriro cyangwa umukino uhinduka, jya urinda isi, imiterere n'amakuru ya plugin. Gusuzuma ibitabo by'umukino na Oxide nyuma yo kongera gutangira; gukuramo igishushanyo mbonera neza ntibigaragaza ko buri plugin yashyizwe mu buryo bukwiriye.

data.name: Content.F89E75BB7B8DECBE4C2B
data.value: ServerModSetup inyandiko muri dedicated_server_mods_setup.lua download Workshop mods; modoverrides.lua irabashoboza hamwe n'amahitamo yabo ku isi/shard. Jya ukoresha seriveri ikora neza n'inzira za cluster. Mods z'abakiliya gusa ni izitandukanye; koresha kopi z'ibikoresho bya cluster mbere yo guhindura mod ya seriveri.

data.name: Content.F94C68FF92382707E0C1
data.value: Igishushanyo cya seriveri yihariye ya Community Nuclei gikoresha mod loader yihariye ku mukino. Kugenzura umuyoboro wo kwinjiza, verisiyo ya plugin n'amabwiriza yo gutangiza seriveri; mod zisanzwe za client ntabwo ari ibimenyetso bihagije.

data.name: Content.F98EB917B82734969B03
data.value: Synix igenzura urutonde rwa mod ID iteganyijwe; ARK ikuramo ibintu by'ukuri bya CurseForge hanyuma ikabisubiramo igihe seriveri itangiye.

data.name: Content.FAB3F6D90467A47EBA5C
data.value: Bisaba uburyo buhuza Metamod:Source na SourceMod yubatse kuri iyi verisiyo ya seriveri. Plugins za .smx zashyizwe hamwe zigenda muri doi/addons/sourcemod/plugins; inyandiko z'ubuhinduzi, amakuru y'imikino n'inyongera biherekejwe na byo bigumana imiterere yabyo.

data.name: Content.FBD81544AC3A1FEB96C9
data.value:
IGIHAMBA CY'UBUGENGE cyasabwe:
1. Jya ukoresha seriveri rimwe kugira ngo ushyireho 'GameUserSettings.ini', hanyuma uyihagarike.
2. Hindura imiterere ya INI kugirango urebe ibipimo byo gusarura no kugenzura ubuyobozi.
3. Inyandiko z'ibanze: https://darkandlight.wiki.gg/wiki/Dedicated_Server

data.name: Content.FC0C7D5D72BB74B7579E
data.value: Jya usuzuma amategeko y'uruhushya mbere yo kwemerera seriveri gutangira.

data.name: Content.FC8AD725F17E1C50CF67
data.value: Seriveri ikubiyemo PCServer-AFFGame.ini. Synix ibika dosiye yose yashyizweho kandi ishyiraho amakuru yemejwe gusa, izina rya seriveri, ijambo ry'ibanga ry'umuyobozi, n'ikirango cy'umukinnyi.

data.name: Content.FD78F49EF26709238B47
data.value: Ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga byo mu bwoko bwa Minecraft, iby'isi n'ibyakoreshwaga mu kuvura

data.name: Content.FE08796B9B27C2F7036C
data.value: ATLAS ni seriveri y'amatsinda kandi ntishobora gukora izi dosiye mu gutangiza seriveri. Jya ukoresha Grapeshot Games ServerGridEditor yemewe kugira ngo ushobore gukora no kohereza hanze urubuga. Andika ServerGrid.json na ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json muri dosiye ya ShooterGame yo kuri seriveri. Mbere yo gutangiza ATLAS, jya ukoresha AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat maze ureke Redis ikore. Gushyira Redis ku murongo wa 127.0.0.1; ntukagaragaze porote 6379 kuri LAN, router cyangwa Internet. Umwanditsi wemewe: https://github.com/GrapeshotGames/ServerGridEditor

data.name: Content.FE8445D560EC3691D1E1
data.value: Reba uko Synix yubaka itegeko ryakoreshejwe mu gutangiza seriveri.

data.name: Content.FF6EEAB0A9848FC8CD5C
data.value: Synix irema imiterere yuzuye ya serverconfig.xml yakozwe na seriveri kandi igenzura izina rya seriveri, ijambo ryibanza, icyambu, imipaka y'umukinnyi, isi, imbuto n'ubunini bw'isi. Indi mibare y'umukino ikomeza guhindurwa mu muhanga w'imiterere.

data.name: Language.Description
data.value: Hitamo ururimi rukoreshwa na Synix. Amategeko y'umukino n'ibiciro byabitswe ntibihinduwe.

data.name: Uninstall.AppOnly
data.value: Jya ukuraho porogaramu gusa (witegereze seriveri n'amakuru)

data.name: Uninstall.Everything
data.value: Jya ukuraho porogaramu, seriveri zigenzurwa n'amakuru ya Synix

data.name: Uninstall.Keep
data.value: Ikuraho ibyifuzo bya porogaramu ya Synix, cache, dosiye z'agateganyo n'inyandiko zo gutangiza porogaramu. Ibika C:\Synix yose, seriveri z'umukino, sauvegarde n'ibikoresho byo kugarura. Urutonde rw'abakozi n'ibishushanyo biri muri SynixData\servers.json birarindwa kandi bigasubikwa igihe ushyiramo Synix.

data.name: Uninstall.Review
data.value: Reba dosiye n’ububiko bizasibwa biri hasi aha. Ahazagumishwa ntihari ku rutonde. Gusiba dosiye ntibisubirwaho, nubwo gukuramo porogaramu byananirana nyuma.

data.name: Uninstall.Confirm
data.value: Nafashe kopi y'ibyo nkeneye, kandi nifuza gusiba burundu izo dosiye.

data.name: Uninstall.Stop
data.value: Funga Synix kandi uhagarike seriveri zose z'umukino mbere yo gukuraho amakuru ya seriveri.

data.name: Uninstall.Changed
data.value: Ibitabo by'abakozi byahindutse. Ongera usuzume izo dosiye mbere yo gukuraho ikintu icyo ari cyo cyose.

data.name: Uninstall.Failed
data.value: Gukuramo byarahagaritswe. Hari dosiye zishobora kuba zaramaze kuvanwaho. Synix iracyashyizweho. Jya usuzuma impapuro zisigaye mbere yo kongera kugerageza.

data.name: Uninstall.BackupsOption
data.value: Ujye uhanagura n'ibikoresho by'ububiko bya seriveri biri ku rutonde

data.name: Uninstall.BackupsDelete

data.value: Imirongo y'imikorere (uretse imikorere ya backups yatoranijwe mu buryo bweruye hejuru):

data.name: Uninstall.CloseApp
data.value: Funga Synix mbere yo kuyikuramo. Iyo hakuweho porogaramu gusa, seriveri z’imikino zishobora gukomeza gukora.

data.name: BackupHealth.Notice
data.value: Bishingiye ku dosiye n'amasezerano, ntabwo ari ukwihanganira ubudahemuka bushya. Ibikoresho by'ubudehe biruta iminsi ya 7 birashimangirwa.

data.name: Appearance.Description
data.value: Hitamo umutwe, ibara ry'amajwi n'uburyo bwo kugenzura. Ivugurura riba ryihutirwa kandi rikandikwa mu buryo bwikora.

data.name: Settings.Privacy.ActivityCount.Description
data.value: Icyemezo: kohereza kode y'icyumweru ku buryo bw'impanuka kuri synix.info buri minota 10 mugihe Synix ikora, harimo na nyuma. Nta makuru ya seriveri yoherezwa. Imibare irarangira nyuma y'iminota 15. Byemewe n'amategeko. Ushobora kuwuzimya hano.

data.name: RemoteManager.Description
data.value: Huza iyi mudasobwa kugira ngo urebe, utangize, uhagarike, wongere utangize kandi ukore kopi zo kubika za seriveri ukoresheje urubuga rwa Synix. Kugera kuri mudasobwa uri kure bikomeza kuba bifunze kugeza wemeje uku guhuza hano.

data.name: RemoteManager.Instructions
data.value:
Jya ku rubuga maze wandikire iyi code. Jya wemera gusa izina ryawe ry'umukoresha hano.
Jya ufungura Synix cyangwa uceceke. Iyo umuntu ahumekewe, aba yumva ibyo ashaka kuvuga. Ibisobanuro bya seriveri bisubirwamo buri masegonda 10. Gukuraho seriveri bituma umuntu adashobora kugera kure atabanje guhagarika seriveri.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryInstructions
data.value: Kora ijambo ry’ibanga ry’agateganyo hano. Injira ku rubuga ukoresheje iryo jambo hamwe n’uburyo bwawe bwa 2FA cyangwa urufunguzo rwo kwinjira (passkey) usanganywe, hanyuma uhitemo ijambo ry’ibanga rishya. Iyo uburyo bwombi busabwa, bwombi bukomeza kuba itegeko. Ijambo ry’ibanga ry’agateganyo rikora rimwe gusa kandi rirangira nyuma y’iminota 10. Ijambo ry’ibanga ryawe rya mbere rikomeza gukora kugeza kugarura konti birangiye.
